Relumi (formerly Repairit) is an AI photo restoration and photo enhancer app for scanned prints, faded
bluejetty:00153765:ios.description:
Restore old photos, repair damaged pictures, unblur faces, colorize black and white photos, and bring memories back to life with Relumi.
Relumi (formerly Repairit) is an AI photo restoration and photo enhancer app for scanned prints, faded family snapshots, damaged wedding photos, blurry pictures, and early digital photos. Powered by advanced AI technology, Relumi has processed millions of photos and is trusted by users for its high-quality, natural, and consistent results.
Relumi comes with ready-made restoration styles and instructions, so you do not need to write a long or complicated prompt. Upload a photo, choose a style, and let AI restore it in one tap. If one detail still needs work, describe the change in a sentence and refine the result without starting over.
NEW FEATURE: MEMORY FILM GENERATOR
Turn a single photo into a 15–60s memory film. Add a few optional words about the moment if you want to guide the result, then let AI turn your photo into a short film with connected shots, natural motion, and emotional pacing.
• AI handles photo restoration, story planning, characters, scenes, and shot scripts in one flow.
• Shape your film by editing the outline, title, characters, scenes, and shot scripts.
• Choose the duration, resolution, and aspect ratio, then preview, save, and share your film.
RESTORE OLD PHOTOS NATURALLY
• Repair scratches, creases, stains, fading, and damaged areas.
• Unblur faces and enhance low-resolution photo details.
• Colorize black and white photos with natural-looking tones.
• Compare the original and restored photo with a before-and-after slider.
Relumi is designed to preserve recognizable faces, expressions, and the character of the original image.
FIX ANY DETAIL WITH A SIMPLE PROMPT
Need a more precise repair? Tell Relumi what to change without starting over:
• “Remove the crease across the child’s face.”
• “Repair the damaged corner and keep the rest unchanged.”
Add an optional reference photo when clearer facial details are needed.
ANIMATE OLD PHOTOS AND MEMORIES
After restoration, bring a still photo to life with Photo Animation. Choose templates for family moments, gentle waves, celebrations, pets, and trending effects, or enter your own prompt for custom motion.
SAVE IN HIGH QUALITY & SHARE EASILY
• Export restored photos in high resolution.
• Preserve facial details, colors, and restored textures when saving.
• Save photo animations and AI videos to your device.
• Share to supported social platforms and messaging apps.
MORE AI PHOTO AND VIDEO TOOLS
• AI Retake for expression, scene, and angle retakes.
• Text to Photo for creating images from your ideas.
• Text to Video for turning prompts and photos into custom videos.
• Remove for erasing unwanted people or objects.
• Photo Enhance for clearer, sharper everyday pictures.
HOW TO RESTORE A PHOTO
1. Upload a scanned print or digital photo.
2. Choose a restoration style.
3. Add a reference image or simple instruction if needed.
4. Start processing and compare the before-and-after result.
5. Save, share, or animate the restored photo.
HOW TO CREATE A MEMORY FILM
1. Open Memory Film, then scan or import a photo.
2. Add an optional description and choose duration, resolution, and aspect ratio.
3. Tap Generate Outline. Review the restored photo and edit the story outline.
4. Tap Build film plan. Review and edit the title, characters, scenes, and shot scripts, then tap Create film.
5. Preview your film, save it, and share with family and friends.
From black and white portrait prints and faded color photos to blurry point-and-shoot pictures and early digital camera files, Relumi helps you restore, enhance, colorize, edit, and animate memories from every era.
— HOW TO FOLLOW AND CONTACT US —

• Privacy Policy: https://www.wondershare.com/privacy.html
• Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

• 50 000 новых объявлений о продаже и аренде ежедневно,
• подробная информация о квартирах в новостройках,
• тепловые карты комфорта жизни в разных районах — транспортная доступность, каршеринг, инфраструктура (магазины, супермаркеты, развлечения), рейтинг школ.
• возможность отсеивать квартиры с «уставшим» ремонтом.
Приложение поможет максимально быстро и с минимумом усилий разместить объявление, купить или снять квартиру и комнату без посредников, найти земельный участок, загородное жилье. В его базе собраны объявления о продаже и аренде недвижимости в Москве и области, Санкт-Петербурге (СПБ), Краснодарском крае, Ростове и других городах России: Красноярск, Краснодар (Краснодарский край), Воронеж, Иваново, Ярославль, Волгоград, Сочи, Саратов, Самара, Пермь, Новосибирск и другие.
Если вы ищите квартиру в определённом районе, просто выделите область поиска прямо на карте. bluejetty:00061624:ios.name: RPR Mobile™
bluejetty:00061624:ios.summary: RPR® (Realtors Property Resource®) is the nation’s largest property database, exclusively for REALTORSⓇ. It puts data, tools and reports literally at your fingertips so you can respond to questions and requests instantly and position yourse
bluejetty:00061624:ios.description:
RPR® (Realtors Property Resource®) is the nation’s largest property database, exclusively for REALTORSⓇ. It puts data, tools and reports literally at your fingertips so you can respond to questions and requests instantly and position yourself as an essential part of every transaction. 
RPR Mobile™ can transform, simplify and optimize your daily business tasks. The RPR app offers on-the-go access to a powerhouse platform of real estate data. Easily search residential and commercial properties, run comps, create and send colorful reports, and view local market activity and trends… anytime, anywhere. 
RPR is a member benefit of the National Association of REALTORS®.
As a REALTOR®, use RPR Mobile to...
 • Instantly create and deliver colorful, client-friendly reports
 • Access residential and commercial properties
 • Quickly search on- and off-market properties
 • Review leases, open houses, home valuations, maps, schools, and market trends
 • Build CMAs on the go
 • Set up and share a Buyer Tour
 • Immediately respond to client inquiries and leads
 • Seamlessly connect with synced reports, recent searches, favorites and notes
>> RPR Mobile: For every facet of your real estate business...
Prospecting
While talking to a homeowner, instantly pull up everything there is to know about their property and area, including valuations and recent sales. Then, within seconds text or email them an RPR Seller's Report. 
Listing Presentations
Don’t get blindsided by a seller’s questions during your listing presentation. Use the RPR app to pull up other properties, view property facts, photos, sales history, mortgage details, and create reports.
Open Houses
With the right amount of prep and planning, and the RPR Mobile app at your side, your next open house will surely be a success.
Buyer Tours
Build a start-to-finish, successful buyer experience using RPR’s dynamic data and impressive reports with the mobile-exclusive Buyer Tour tool.
>> Exciting features
Create & send reports
Want to immediately respond to a client inquiry about a property, school, neighborhood, etc.? Creating and sending reports via RPR’s app is as easy as 1-2-3.
Comp analysis 
Use your device to build a CMA, then create and text/email a colorful Seller’s Report to your client. Best of all, if you’ve selected comps on the RPR website, they will sync and can be viewed on mobile and vice versa.
Location-based school information
Search for homes in a school attendance zone, get driving directions and create school reports, all from your phone.
>> RPR REPORTS… anytime, anywhere
Seller’s Report
Used for listing presentations, this report includes subject property, local market conditions, comparable properties, pricing strategy and seller proceeds.
Property and Mini Property Report
Summarizes the overall characteristics of a property. Includes values, foreclosure activity, market statistics, demographics, property history, taxes and school information.
Market Activity Report
A snapshot of changes in a local real estate market. Includes active, pending, sold, expired and distressed properties, open houses and recent price changes.
Neighborhood Report
An in-depth portrait of your target area. Includes job growth, unemployment, cost of living, commute times, median list and sales prices, listing and sales volumes and per square foot pricing on sold homes and more.
Buyer Tour Report
This mobile feature enables the user to select properties, set up a tour itinerary and then create colorful, client-friendly reports to share with buyers.
School Report
An overview of student population, testing outcomes, parental reviews, ratings and contact information about public and private schools.
Property Flyer
A handy tool for open houses, listings, and even that new lead that you want to respond to right away, the Property Flyer is a quick and easy way of marketing any property.

Crew Access Mobile is a part of Flightscape Crew Management platform, offering Crew Members real-time access to their roster and personal information. 
Flightscape’s flagship crew-facing app provides self-service tools such as auto-process
bluejetty:00180610:ios.description:
Crew Access Mobile is a part of Flightscape Crew Management platform, offering Crew Members real-time access to their roster and personal information. 
Flightscape’s flagship crew-facing app provides self-service tools such as auto-processed duty swaps, leave requests, open time, and our innovative Crew on Flight Chat® to keep teams connected on the go.
Witt Crew Access Mobile, Crew Members can access information from Crew Management anytime, anywhere, empowering them to focus on delivering exceptional passenger experiences!
Description of each service:
 • View Rosters: Access and view published roster information, including both flying and non-flying activities, even when offline or in areas with poor connectivity.
 • Real-time Notifications: Receive immediate notifications when there are changes to your roster and acknowledge them directly within the app.
 • Duty Swap: Initiate and accept duty swap requests with other crew members.
 • Trade Board: Post and search for swappable duties on a central platform.
 • Leave Manager: View leave balances and submit leave requests through this service.
 • Chat: Connect with other crew members scheduled to be on your flight, facilitating communication.
 • Open Time: Service that allows crew members to send requests directly to airline for schedule changes.
 • Request Forms: Service allows crew members to create customized forms for efficient communication with schedulers such as submitting documents or requesting sick leave.
 • Pairing In Advance: Set preferences for future destinations and flights and send request to admin before the schedule is published.
 • Off-Days: Submit requests to the admin for days off due to reasons such as weddings or sickness.
 • Biometric Login: Securely log in to the app using Face ID or Touch ID for quick and convenient access.
These services aim to streamline crew management processes, improve communication, and enhance efficiency within airline operations.
Crew Access Mobile is seamlessly integrated with Flightscape’s Crew Manager, Crew Control and CrewTrac.

bluejetty:00136759:ios.description:
Get ready to embark on a vibrant journey with Flag Painting Puzzle, the ultimate game for flag enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike! If you have a passion for national flags and a flair for colors, this hyper-casual game is tailor-made for you. 
A Global Challenge of Colors and Flags:
Welcome to the Colorful World of Flag Painting Puzzle! In the Flag Painting Puzzle, your mission is to paint the national flags of the world with the right colors. This isn't just about painting; it's about testing your knowledge and memory of different national flags. Can you remember the colors of each flag and recreate them accurately?
Why Flag Painting Puzzle is Irresistibly Fun:
Test Your Flag Knowledge: Challenge your recognition skills by drawing and painting various national flags. It’s a fun way to learn and remember the flags of the world!
Easy Gameplay, Challenging Memory Test: While the gameplay is straightforward, remembering and correctly coloring each flag offers a satisfying challenge.
Engaging Levels: With a multitude of flags to color, each level presents a new opportunity to test your memory and painting skills.
Perfect for All Ages: Whether you’re a geography buff, a casual gamer, or a curious learner, Flag Painting Puzzle is suitable for players of all ages.
Are you ready to put your flag knowledge to the test and have loads of fun while doing it? Download Flag Painting Puzzle now and start your artistic and puzzle journey around the globe! Embark on a colorful exploration of national flags with the Flag Painting Puzzle! Download now and start painting!

bluejetty:00082401:ios.name: Orange Zones Workout Tracker
bluejetty:00082401:ios.summary:
Train Smarter with Orange Zones
Turn your heart rate into a better workout.
Orange Zones gives you real-time heart rate zone tracking on your iPhone and Apple Watch, helping you understand your effort while you train and see exactly how yo
bluejetty:00082401:ios.description:
Train Smarter with Orange Zones
Turn your heart rate into a better workout.
Orange Zones gives you real-time heart rate zone tracking on your iPhone and Apple Watch, helping you understand your effort while you train and see exactly how you performed when you're done.
Use the Orange Zones model, choose from other popular heart rate zone models, or create your own custom zones. Whether you're in the studio, running, cycling, lifting, rowing, doing HIIT, or simply working toward better fitness, Orange Zones adapts to the way you train.
YOUR ZONES. YOUR WORKOUT.
Orange Zones automatically calculates personalized heart rate zones based on your maximum heart rate.
Prefer another approach? Choose from supported industry-standard zone models or customize your own heart rate zones to match your training goals.
Your zones are displayed with clear colors and real-time heart rate data, so you can see your intensity at a glance.
EARN POINTS FOR YOUR EFFORT
Turn intensity into something you can see.
Orange Zones awards points based on time spent in your higher heart rate zones, giving you a simple way to measure effort 
across workouts and challenge yourself over time.
APPLE WATCH + iPHONE
Work out your way.
Start a workout from your iPhone or Apple Watch and follow your heart rate, zones, workout time, points, and other key stats in real time.
Leave your iPhone behind and work out directly from your Apple Watch, or use your iPhone as a larger live workout display.
AIRPODS HEART RATE SUPPORT
Have supported AirPods with heart rate sensing? Orange Zones can automatically detect them and use their heart rate data during your workout.
No setup hassle, put them on and start moving.
BLUETOOTH HEART RATE MONITORS
Orange Zones also works with standard Bluetooth heart rate monitors, including compatible chest straps and armbands from brands such as Polar, Wahoo, Garmin, and OTBeat.
Choose the heart rate source that works best for you.
UNDERSTAND EVERY WORKOUT
After your workout, see more than just how long you exercised.
Review your:
* Heart rate and zone performance
* Time spent in each heart rate zone
* Points earned
* Workout intensity
* Calories and other available workout stats
* Workout history
ORANGE ZONES PRO
Go beyond individual workouts and see the bigger picture.
Orange Zones Pro adds deeper workout insights, including:
* Comparative Workout Stats See how a workout compares with your previous performance.
* Trends Follow changes in your workouts and training over time.
* Week in Review Get an easy-to-understand look at your training week and how it compares with previous weeks.
* Email Workout Summaries Automatically receive a workout summary by email after you finish training.
APPLE HEALTH
Orange Zones integrates with Apple Health to personalize your experience and save your workouts.
When permitted, Orange Zones can read relevant health and fitness information and save completed workouts to Apple Health. Eligible workouts contribute to your Apple Activity rings.
BUILT FOR ALL KINDS OF TRAINING
Use Orange Zones for running, walking, cycling, HIIT, strength training, rowing, hiking, elliptical workouts, and more.
You don't need to train like anyone else. Pick the zone model that works for you, set your goals, and let your heart rate guide your workout.
PRIVACY
Your health and workout information is personal. We do not sell your personal information.
APPLE WATCH REQUIREMENTS
Requires a compatible Apple Watch and supported version of watchOS.
INDEPENDENT APP
Orange Zones is developed by independent app company PK Fitness Apps. Orange Zones is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Orangetheory Fitness, OTF, or Ultimate Fitness Group, LLC.
Terms of Service: https://www.workoutcompanions.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.workoutcompanions.app/privacy-policy

This app is exclusively for the FUJIFILM instax Link WIDE™ and instax Link WIDE2™ printers. Connect your printer to the app via Bluetooth to enjoy the following features:

Select, edit, and print your photos directly from your smartphone.

Print your photos just the way you like — choose "instax-Natural Mode" for a classic instax™ look, or "instax-Rich Mode" for extra-vibrant colors.

Add a QR code to your print to link it with web content, audio, maps, or messages — making every memory more interactive.
6. Frame Print 
Add stylish frames to personalize your instax™ photo prints and make them even more fun.
7. Collage Print
Combine multiple photos into a single print using a variety of collage templates.
[Supported OS] 
iOS 17.0 or later

bluejetty:00172669:ios.description:
Drive smart and save big. The USAA DriveSafe App can help you build safe driving habits and earn discounts off your auto insurance premium. This app is for USAA members with an active auto insurance policy in select states who’ve enrolled in either our USAA SafePilot® or USAA SafePilot Miles™ programs.
Benefits of the USAA DriveSafe App:
Automatic trip data: The app uses GPS and other sensors to map your trips and understand when and how you're driving.
Driving insights: Keep track of your driving habits — like how much you drive, phone usage while driving and harsh braking.
Crash assistance: If a crash is detected, we'll check if you're OK and help you with next steps.
Quicker claims process: If you choose to file a claim after an accident, your driving information from the app could help move along the claims process.
To learn more about how to set up the app, visit: https://mobile.usaa.com/support/insurance/auto/safepilot/enable-permissions/

bluejetty:00114838:ios.description:
Run for your life in the sweetest escape adventure ever!
Meet Bob, the gingerbread cookie who refuses to be eaten! Just moments before being served to two hungry kids, Bob makes a daring escape from the pastry shop. Now he needs your help to outrun danger and stay alive!
Dash, jump, slide, and tilt your way through colorful candy worlds filled with delicious—but deadly—obstacles. But beware: the baker’s evil rolling pin is on your trail, ready to flatten anything in its path!
Can you help Bob avoid being turned into crumbs?
Game Features:
- Intuitive swipe & tilt controls
- Endless runner gameplay with jump, turn, slide mechanics
- Bright, vibrant 3D graphics & smooth animations
- Collect colorful chocolate balls as you run
- Dodge tasty traps: croissants, biscuits, pancakes, dynamite(!) and more
- Challenge your reflexes and set high scores
- Fun for all ages – no sugar crash required!
Everything may look sweet, but it’s a dangerous world out there.
Fall into hot milk and Bob melts like butter. One wrong move and it’s game over.
So sharpen your reflexes and start running—because once the rolling pin starts, there’s no turning back!
Ready to escape? 3, 2, 1... GO!
Help Bob survive the ultimate bakery breakout in one of the most delicious runner games on mobile.
Warning: May cause cravings. Not recommended during strict diets.
Can you beat your high score 100+ times? Find out!

bluejetty:00088775:ios.summary: Dive into the chilling depths of "Mind Echoes: The Lost Mysteries," the fusion of murder mystery and mystery hidden object games. Step into the shoes of Emily Rivers, a gifted forensic investigator and medium, as she embarks on a journey to
bluejetty:00088775:ios.description:
Dive into the chilling depths of "Mind Echoes: The Lost Mysteries," the fusion of murder mystery and mystery hidden object games. Step into the shoes of Emily Rivers, a gifted forensic investigator and medium, as she embarks on a journey to solve the mystery of her family's disappearance. Explore the haunted Starlight Dreams Hotel, packed with cryptic clues, eerie secrets, and unspeakable dangers. Can you navigate the hotel’s shadowy halls and uncover the truth, or will you succumb to its unsolved mysteries?
Emily Rivers, a forensic investigator and medium, receives devastating news: her long-missing parents have been declared officially deceased. Returning to her inherited esoteric shop, Eternal Memories, Emily stumbles upon her mother's journal, detailing eerie events at the abandoned Starlight Dreams Hotel. Drawn by the mystery, Emily ventures into the hotel's haunted halls, encountering restless spirits, cryptic clues, and a malevolent entity known as the Lurker. Will she unravel the secrets of the 13th floor and the truth behind her family's disappearance, or will the echoes of the past consume her?
- Haunting Hidden-Object Scenes!
Enjoy richly detailed and atmospheric locations as you search to find hidden objects crucial to solving the mystery. Each scene is a masterpiece, capturing the tension of a gripping murder mystery and offering thrilling discoveries for fans of mystery hidden object games.
- Intricate Puzzles & Mini-Games!
Test your forensic investigator skills with a diverse array of challenging puzzles, including logic riddles, object finding games, and creative ciphers. Relax with soothing unsolved mysteries games, search for hidden objects and solve crimes and mysteries!
- Supernatural Collectibles & Achievements!
Explore every corner of the haunted hotel to uncover hidden collectibles such as spectral artifacts, journal entries, and mysterious trinkets. Unlock achievements for solving complex puzzles, finding hidden objects, and progressing through this murder mystery!
- Shape Your Own Destiny!
Every decision you make impacts Emily’s journey. Explore different endings and paths, ensuring endless excitement for fans of unsolved mysteries games and mystery hidden object games. Replay the story to make new discoveries and completely solve the mystery!
Discover the perfect blend of suspense, supernatural intrigue, and puzzle-solving. In "Mind Echoes: The Lost Mysteries" with the free trial!

This Application will make your life easy and will support your health needs. Using this App will allow you to have the option of either having your food delivered to your door step “Food delivery” or simply ordering your fav. meals before reaching the closest branch to you “Pre-Order. 
Choosing our delivery option will allow you to save time and effort while you are hungry for some healthy and delicious meals. On the other hand, Our pre-order service will allow you to skip the waiting line and save time. You will also have the option of either Arrive to our restaurant to find your order ready to be picked as a take away order or you can choose to enjoy your ready order inside our branch.
This Application is designed to be your number one Application. Altazaj goal is not to only offer food but to help you move forward with your life style. We are planning to establish a whole lifestyle improvement categories “coming soon”. Starting with reminding you to drink 8 cups of water daily, suggestion daily exercises, Providing you with healthy tips and creating competitions between App users to maybe help you loose weight or maintain a healthy life style.

bluejetty:00114378:ios.name: Jits AI: BJJ Coach & Tracker
bluejetty:00114378:ios.summary:
Analyze your rolls with our new video analysis coach. Log your rounds + lessons with voice. 
Most people roll the same way every night, then wonder why they've stalled.
JitsAI gives your jiu-jitsu a system: one focus for the week, a coach
bluejetty:00114378:ios.description:
Analyze your rolls with our new video analysis coach. Log your rounds + lessons with voice. 
Most people roll the same way every night, then wonder why they've stalled.
JitsAI gives your jiu-jitsu a system: one focus for the week, a coach that remembers every round you've logged, and proof you're getting better that you can actually point at.
ONE FOCUS A WEEK 
Escape mount. Sweep from closed guard. Pass with the knee cut. You get one job for the week so you walk into every class knowing exactly what you're hunting, instead of rolling on autopilot.
LEARN IT FROM A WORLD CHAMPION
Every focus pins lessons from IBJJF No-Gi World Champion Henrique Rezende, head coach of Alliance Jiu Jitsu London taught in the order the skill actually builds, not a feed to drown in. One video before class is enough. Extra videos by world champions included in the app. 
TALK YOUR ROUNDS. THE COACH DOES THE REST. 
30 seconds of voice on the way home. The coach debriefs the session: what landed, what slipped, exactly what to drill next. It knows your guard-passing rate, your sweep numbers, and which partners give you trouble - because it was there for all of it.
PROVE IT, DON'T JUST COUNT IT 
Every skill has a nine-level ladder, from lighter lower belts up to heavier higher belts. Land a move once and it's marked. Land it three times across two different sessions and the level goes solid - proven. No points for showing up. Progress you can defend. Progress you see between stripes and belts. 
YOUR SAVES COME BACK WHEN YOU NEED THEM 
Found a technique video on TikTok, Instagram or YouTube? Share it straight to JitsAI. It gets filed by technique and position and resurfaces the week you're actually training that move. No more bookmark graveyard.
EVERY PARTNER GETS A SCOREBOARD 
Submissions, sweeps, passes, dominant positions tracked per training partner. Watch the rivalries develop. See which belts give you problems. Log competitions and put the medals on your wall.
ALSO IN THE KIT 
• Weekly review every Sunday, your rounds, your rates, where the ladder moved
• 60 second story lessons on the method, the history and the mindset 
• Class log - what you drilled and how it felt 
• Whoop sync, weekly schedule, gym program
WHO IT'S FOR 
White belts who are tired of drowning: walk in knowing the one thing to work on. Blue belts and up who want a real game: pick your weapons and prove them, level by level. Purples and beyond that want to keep proving their game. 
One focus a week. Proof on the mat. A coach in your corner.

bluejetty:00162279:ios.description:
Discover the latest in women’s fashion – shoes, bags, jewelry and accessories 
BE INSPIRED
Discover new designs weekly
SHOP FAST
Enjoy a quick and easy checkout experience 
SHOP EXCLUSIVE
Be the first to get your hands on online exclusive items
KEEP TRACK
Create a wish list with your favorite looks
ENJOY PERKS
Enjoy free standard delivery and receive alerts on exclusive promotions and sales 
STAY IN THE KNOW
Get the latest fashion news and useful style tips from our online magazine and product descriptions 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Much more than an online store, CHARLES & KEITH is an essential guide for the fashion-forward modern woman who takes style seriously.
Our app makes shopping a breeze with its intuitive browsing and category filters. View our New Arrivals weekly to check out the latest drops, or shop specific styles from our main categories: Shoes, Bags, Sunglasses, Jewelry and Accessories. Our Kids’ collections for babies and little girls offer practical shoes and bags in charming designs. Drop by our Online Exclusives to browse one-of-a-kind designs you will not find at retail stores, or stock up at our Sale section where the prices are just right.
Need some outfit inspiration? Browse The Edit, a treasure trove of fashion editorials and trending style-related content. We also keep you updated on our latest seasonal campaigns and global collaborations, plus showcase celebrities and fashion insiders who have been spotted in our designs.
Download our app today to stay ahead of the fashion curve, and never miss out on special sales and exclusive online promos.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Features on this app include:
Weekly New Arrivals
Be notified of weekly new arrivals – including trending designs and classic comebacks – under our main categories.
24/7 Shopping: Browse By Category, Colour and Size
Treat our app as your one-stop-shop for the latest in women’s fashion accessories. Browse handbags, wallets, shoes, sunglasses, jewellery, belts and bag straps. We also have children’s accessories, plus our luxurious signature line. Use the filter to shop according to style, price, size and colour.
Product Advice & Personalised Styling Tips
All our online products come with a detailed description, so you know exactly what you are purchasing. As an added bonus, we also provide style tips and pictures to show you how to incorporate the item into your daily ensembles. 
Easy Shopping & Tracking
Add your desired pieces to the cart, insert your delivery address and purchase it immediately. Track your order until it reaches you. 
WishList
Create a wishlist of the looks you love and the key pieces that have caught your eye. 
Push Notification
Get instant alerts once a new sale starts. You will also never miss another special promotion or new collection update.
Seamless In-Store & Online Shopping Experience
Like an item in our physical store, but it is not available in your size or preferred colour? Or, saw a piece you like on the app and want to try it on? Use the Find In Store function to locate your preferred product at our physical store. Find the full list of CHARLES & KEITH retail stores on our app. 
Free Standard Delivery
Enjoy free standard delivery with a minimum spend. Only available in selected locations. Terms and conditions apply.
Manage Your Account
Sign up for an account to store important information (e.g. delivery address) for faster checkout. Become a privilege member and enjoy exciting discounts and special promotions. 
Stay Current
Browse our online magazine to keep yourself on top of your fashion game. Receive our weekly newsletters to pick up style tips, and be the first to know about exclusive promotions. 
Love the app? Rate us! Or send us your comments and suggestions at customers@charleskeith.com.

bluejetty:00156434:ios.description:
FMCSA-APPROVED CDL ENTRY LEVEL DRIVER TRAINING (ELDT)
Individuals who obtain a commercial learner’s permit (CLP) on or after February 7, 2022 will need to complete this course before they will be permitted to take their CDL skills or knowledge test. Upon completion of this course the results will instantly be submitted to the FMCSA Training Provider Registry. Prior to providing any testing services CDL testing centers will retrieve these results from the FMCSA Training Provider Registry to confirm that the student has completed the required ELDT theory training.
This course covers all units for ELDT as mandated by the FMCSA.
Follow the steps below to begin your journey to a new career.
1. Register For The Course - Registration is simple and only takes a few minutes. You can begin the course immediately after registration. No classrooms, no lines.
2. Begin The Course - The course can be taken from any device, any place, anytime. We keep track of your progress. All you have to do is login and complete each section of the course when it fits your schedule.
3. Complete The Course - The moment you complete the course we report the completion to the Federal Registry. You can then begin the behind-the-wheel training.

bluejetty:00027564:ios.description:
Ever dreamed of having your own shopping mall? My City: Mall is the coolest shopping mall you will ever see. 
Go and visit lots of shops with your pets. watch a movie, play games, dress up and eat fast food.
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
This game is a fully interactive digital shopping mall game in which you can interact with every object you see.The My City: Mall: game includes detailed and fun rooms that the kids can role-play as a shopper or even as the manager of the mall!
Shop,design and play with your pets and friends!
We packed this game with amazing new features:
*Lots of shops to play and interact.
■ Cinema - Buy tickets and enjoy movies with your friends while eating fast food like burger, hot dog, sandwich and of course popcorn.
■ Hair Salon - Play makeover games, change your hair color and hairstyle. Pamper yourself with the best makeover in the hair salon spa.
■ Arcade - Enjoy different funny games. Explore and design the arcade room.
■ Clothing Store - Bring your friends, animals and dress up with lots of clothing choices and use the boutique to shop for glasses, shoes and hats.
■ Food Court - Do you love yummy food like cake, sandwich and a lemonade? You can also visit the fast food area for some hot dog, burgers and popcorn.
■ Pet Store - Bring your cute pets in the mall. Adopt a cat, dog, parrot or hamster. Take care, wash them and interact with other cute animals in the pet store.
Over 100 million kids have played our games world wide!
Creative Games Kids Love to Play
Think of this game as a fully interactive dollhouse in which you can touch and interact with almost every object you see. With fun characters and highly detailed locations, kids can role-play by creating and playing out their own stories.
Easy enough for a 5-year old to play with, exciting enough for a 12-year old to enjoy!
- Play as you want, stress-free games, Extremely high playability.
- Kids Safe. No 3rd party Ads and IAP. Pay once and get free updates forever.
- Connects with other My City games: All My City games connect together allowing kids to share characters between our games.
More Games, More Story Options, More Fun.
Age group 4-12: 
Easy enough for 4 year olds to play and super exciting for 12 year to enjoy.
Play Together: 
We support multi touch so kids can play together with friends and family on the same screen!
We love making children games, if you like what we do and want to send us ideas and suggestions for our next games of My City you can do so here:
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/mytowngames
Twitter - https://twitter.com/mytowngames
Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/mytowngames
Love our games? Leave us a nice review on the app store, we read them all!
Terms of Use: https://www.my-town.com/EULA
Customer Support contact: support@my-town.com

bluejetty:00060807:ios.description:
Run your own grocery shopping & delivery business from your phone. Dumpling Boss provides you with a credit card to shop your orders, a personalized webpage, a community of business owners, tech support, and mobile apps for you and your clients. This includes everything you need to run your own grocery shopping & delivery business, including:
Client Management
•Quickly find & manage contact information for all of your clients
•Invite new clients to connect directly with your business
•Chat with clients via in-app chat or SMS
Order Management
•Save and upload grocery receipts
•View client's shopping list, re-order items on the list, and check off items as you go
•Edit client's shopping lists and add items they forgot to add
•Charge clients and adjust invoices
•Manage client order status and delivery date/time
Business Management
•Choose stores & services offered in your app
•Set pricing per store, including a minimum fee
•Choose either a flat rate or percentage based pricing structure
•Select who pays the credit card processing fees, you or your client
•Customize gratuity options
•Setup direct deposit
•Communicate directly with the dumpling support team
•Access the dumpling help center in the Boss app 
Business Insights 
•View earnings, order, and client statistics
•Manage client reviews 
With Dumpling Grocery | Boss, you're in control of every aspect of your business, from who your customers are to where you shop.

bluejetty:00067769:ios.description:
Simple Pomodoro Timer is a free simple and minimal Pomodoro timer.
With a design that does not disturb your thoughts, it will overwhelmingly increase your study and work efficiency.
- Overwhelmingly simple!
No unnecessary functions. No unnecessary functions to support your concentration.
- Start with one tap!
Just start the app and press the start button to start the timer.
- Switch between three timers.
You can switch between three timers with a swipe: Pomodoro Timer (25 minutes), Short Break (5 minutes), and Long Break (15 minutes).
This allows you to efficiently practice the Pomodoro Technique.
- Timer time can be freely changed.
Each of the three timers can be changed.
- Notification of end of timer by push notification
The timer will continue to run even when the app is closed or goes into the background, and a push notification will let you know when the timer ends.
You will never miss it again.
- Finish time is also displayed
Simple Pomodoro Timer shows the time your alarm will finish so you don't need to calculate when the timer will go off any more.
- Minimal design
The minimal design will not disturb your thoughts.
- The sound when the timer ends can be changed. Silence is also supported.
This is a good option for libraries and other places where no sound can be produced.
- Supports vibration
You can also change the on/off setting.
- Supports dark mode
Supports eye-friendly dark mode. It is automatically applied according to the device settings.

Privacy Policy: https://tinylab-apps.web.app/PrivacyPolicy/ja.html

bluejetty:00120540:ios.description:
This is the most feature packed Sabbath School quarterly on the market. Use it to enhance your lesson study. This is the app for true lesson study. It is the only Sabbath School app with these exciting and useful features:
• You can highlight portions of text, so they pop out in Sabbath School.
• You can write notes just like in the paper copy.
• Notes and highlights can sync between your devices.
• Bible references are turned into weblinks for quick viewing.
• The teachers edition for the week can be viewed with a simple click.
Sabbath School Quarterly app allows you to take your Seventh-Day Adventist Biblical studies wherever you bring your phone. Most Seventh-Day Adventist churches teach on the same topic or reading in a given week, as each quarter of the year has a different theme that reflects Bible, doctrinal, or church lifestyle teachings. Thus the lesson booklet is called quarterly.
This app provides you with all of the Sabbath School quarterlies for the current and previous three quarters. It lets you take notes, and it remembers the notes for later when you are taking part in the discussion during Sabbath school. The app allows you to hone in on the specific week and day of study and enables you to move from one day to another with a tap or swipe of your finger.

bluejetty:00069443:ios.description:
Blend photos, glitch them, distort them and turn them into trippy abstract art. Trigraphy gives you 116 generative effects, layers with blend modes, masks, text and AI Edit, so every image is yours to shape. Then export it in high resolution.
Make album covers, posters and art prints, give ordinary photos an artistic twist, or build complex digital artwork on your iPhone or iPad.
FEATURES
• AI Edit: describe a change in your own words and watch your layer transform
• 116 generative art presets, each with its own settings: low poly, circles, strokes, pixel sorting, distortion and more
• Layers: photos (JPG or transparent PNG), text, adjustments, FX overlays and solid colors
• Blend modes and opacity for double exposures and photo blends
• Text in bold display fonts, ready for any effect
• Masks on every layer: paint them, or mask the subject or the background in one tap
• Tap to select objects for masking (iOS 27)
• Color filters, duotones and material textures
• Curated FX overlays: fractals, lights, liquids and abstract textures with ready-made settings
• Hue, contrast, brightness and saturation
• Undo and redo, auto save, and projects you can re-edit any time
• Import from Photos, Files, Unsplash and Pixabay
• Export in high resolution, including transparent PNG
• Share your art straight to your favorite apps
• Featured artists feed for inspiration
TRIGRAPHY PRO
Full use of Trigraphy requires Trigraphy Pro, a monthly or yearly subscription. The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial.
Pro includes AI credits: 15 a month with the monthly plan or 180 a year with the yearly plan. Each AI Edit uses 1 credit, and credits never expire. Credits are added when your paid subscription starts. Credit packs are available as in-app purchases.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.
COMMERCIAL USE
Allowed with Trigraphy Pro.
Terms of Use: https://trigraphyapp.com/termsofuse/
Privacy Policy: https://trigraphyapp.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00098307:ios.description:
Create Perfect Passport Photos at Home with the Ultimate Passport Photo Maker App for iPhone
Tired of spending time and money at photo studios for your passport or ID photos? Now you can take high-quality, compliant passport photos right from your iPhone using our powerful Passport Photo Maker app. Whether it's for a passport, visa, ID card, green card, or license, this app gives you all the tools you need to create official photos that meet the latest requirements in minutes.
This all-in-one ID Maker app allows you to take, edit, resize, format, and save or print your passport photo with ease. Designed for travelers, professionals, students, and families, the app supports photo formats for over 100 countries and works offline, so you can use it anytime, anywhere.
Key Features :
Note: Some of the features are only available after taking paid subscription plan.
Create passport and ID photos instantly. Capture a new photo or select one from your gallery. The app automatically detects your face and crops the photo to fit official specifications.
Supports over 100 passport photo formats worldwide. Choose from the most commonly used passport photo sizes for countries including the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Australia, Japan, China, and European Union nations. All formats are based on the latest government standards.
Advanced background removal tool. The app uses AI to remove the background and replace it with plain white, light gray, or other solid colors required by government regulations for passport and visa photos.
Export for digital submission. Save digital versions of your passport photo optimized for online applications. No need for scanning or third-party editing.
Offline functionality. All major tools work without an internet connection. Your passport photos are saved securely to your device, ensuring full privacy and convenience.
Easy sharing options. Send your finished passport photo via email, messaging apps, or upload it directly to government websites and online forms.
Perfect for Every Official Photo Need
This Passport Photo Maker is ideal for:
Passport photo creation
Visa application photos
ID cards and student ID photos
Green card and immigration photos
Work permit photos
Driving license and exam form photos
Digital ID badges
Travel documents and international forms
Whether you're renewing your passport, applying for a visa, or filling out job or school paperwork, the Passport Photo Maker app helps you get it done accurately and efficiently.
Why Choose This Passport Photo App?
Simple and intuitive interface for all ages
Unlimited photo retakes until you're satisfied
No appointments, no waiting, no studio fees
One-time purchase or subscription for full resolution exports
Trusted by global travelers, remote workers, and international students
Updated regularly to ensure compliance with changing regulations
Supported Photo Sizes Include
US Passport Photo (2 x 2 inches)
UK Passport Photo (35 x 45 mm)
Canada Visa Photo (50 x 70 mm)
India Passport Photo (51 x 51 mm)
EU Schengen Visa Photos
Australia, Japan, China, and many more
Custom photo size options available
Subscriptions:
To access all the premium features and content, you need to subscribe or pay once for lifetime access. The cost of the purchase is charged to your iTunes account.
Subscriptions automatically renew and are billed at the rate and period you choose based on your subscription plan. User accounts are charged for auto-renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off in iTunes Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

InstantSave makes it easy to save reels, repost and grow faster with built-in AI tools. Organize your favorite social content and create posts that perform - all in one app.
Loved by creators, marketers, and influencers who want to save time and post smarter - without juggling five different apps.
Features you'll love:
▸ AI Caption Generator
Write engaging, on-brand captions in seconds. Perfect for reels, posts, and stories when you don't have time to think of the right words.
▸ Trending AI Hashtag
Suggestions Help your content reach more people. Get the right mix of popular and niche tags for every post, picked from what's working right now.

See what helps your reels grow. Find out which topics, lengths, and styles get the most reach — and post smarter, not harder.

Save and share posts as clean PDF files. Great for archiving, sending to your team, or keeping a tidy record of every idea.

Save high-resolution reels and videos in seconds, not minutes. Sharper quality, quicker speeds.
▸ Repost with Proper Credit

Organize favorites by mood, project, or platform. Find anything in one tap and keep your inspiration always within reach.

bluejetty:00024033:ios.description:
Photo Editor, is one of the most powerful design studios that fits in the palm of your hands. With over 50 million installs, Photo Editor is the premier all-in-one editor to fulfill all of your photo editing needs. If you're looking for an easy way to create unique looking pictures and convey a message, this is the way to do it!
Easily edit photos of any kind - selfies, food, architecture, scenery, and fashion. Use items like masks, captions, quotes, watermarks, and memes that you create in the app. Add beautiful typography & artwork, apply stunning filters and photo effects, and add an ever-growing collection of shapes, light FX, textures, borders, patterns, and more to your photos and share them to your favorite social networks. 
The beauty of Photo Editor is that you don't have to be a professional photographer or a graphic artist to create professional looking results. This app is designed to be easy and quick to use so anyone can benefit from it.
Photo Editing Features:
Stickers & Artwork
• Choose from a delightful collection of stickers, overlays & artwork to add onto your photos. - Expressing yourself has never been more fun!
Photo Filters
• Apply one of our 50+ gorgeous photo filters - with more on the way.
• Enable the Photo Editor photo extension in the iOS Photos app to natively apply Photo Editor filters when editing in your Camera Roll.
Photo Effects
• Choose from our carefully crafted blends of light leaks, film grains, textures, gorgeous gradients, magical effects, and more! 
Image Overlays and Masks
• Impress your friends by applying a collection of hundreds (and growing) of shapes, borders, overlays, textures and more to add that extra flair to your photos. 
Magazine Templates
• Choose from incredible magazine-style templates to create your own custom cover story. Announce your birthday party, baby shower or job promotion with magazine templates inspired by publications like Time, Forbes, People, Bon Appétit and many more!
Custom Artwork
• Import custom artwork or your own logo, and use it in your photos as a fully editable layer. This is perfect for the mobile creative, and a big plus to branding efforts everywhere.
Drawing Tool
• Perfect for those who want to draw some rough notes, instructions, captions & more on their photos. 
Crop Photos
• Easily crop photos using our preset ratios - including the popular 1:1 ratio - perfect for Instagram, or drag cropping tool to your desired width and height. 
Collage Tool
• Choose from our great selection of unique and fun collages. 
Photo Booth
• Endless fun awaits in the Photo Editor Photo booth. You'll never get tired of sharing your awesome photos with your friends.
Sticker Pack
• Fun set of iMessage stickers included with each download, with the option easily share images created with Photo Editor. 
This robust photo editing app for iPhone or iPad allows you to create unlimited fun, quirky, or professional photo edits. After installing this app, you will have access to the perfect photo editor for Instagram and for creating beautiful and unique pictures right at your fingertips. Easily upload, edit, and share as many photos as you want, whenever you want. No previous design experience or knowledge is needed to use our photo editing app. 
View our Terms of Service at: https://maplemedia.io/terms-of-service/
Download. Create. Share. 
We can't wait to see your creativity in action with Photo Editor! 
Support: contact@maplemedia.io
Happy Editing, 
The Photo Editor Team

Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. User
bluejetty:00082342:ios.description:
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”

bluejetty:00095697:ios.description:
In today’s digital world, KJV Solitaire - Daily Bible stands out as a unique and creative game, offering believers a spiritually enriching experience. By combining the timeless wisdom of the Bible with the beloved game of Solitaire, it creates a space for relaxation, entertainment, and spiritual growth.
How to Play
- Drag cards onto a card of a different color with a higher number
- Sequence cards from Ace to King on Foundation piles
- Complete hands by collecting all four suits
- Only Kings can occupy empty columns
- Click the Deck to reveal new cards
Game Features
- Daily Prayer
Start each session with prayers, dedicating wins and joys to God while seeking His guidance.
- Track Mood
Record daily reflections to express life’s celebrations and challenges.
- Bible 365
Read scripture daily and track progress through the integrated calendar.
- Postcards to God
Send messages of praise and gratitude through virtual postcards.
- Daily Quiz
Answer three faith-based questions daily to receive blessings.
- Hint Feature
Get gameplay advice infused with biblical wisdom.
- Undo Feature
Correct mistakes instantly for a smooth hand.
More than a game, KJV Solitaire is a spiritual journey. Every card move becomes an act of devotion, helping players find peace and purpose through prayerful engagement.

bluejetty:00073672:ios.description:
Magic Life is a face special effects editing application. With powerful artificial intelligence technology, you can swap faces with the characters in the video and try amazing photo effects.
Main Features：
Face Swap Video
We have prepared a wealth of materials for you through user preferences. You can replace your face with the character in the video or photo to generate unique content and share it with your friends.
Cartoon Effect
It is interesting gameplay that can make your photos fully personalized. After uploading or taking a photo, you can cartoon yourself or any photo with just one click.
Back to Young
With AI technology supported by Magic Life, it's possible to go back to your childhood again. You can easily get younger and look like a teenager after applying this effect.
Life Journey
See the changes over a long period of time on your face. Use this aging effect and have a quick check of your future appearance after 30 years.
Hand Analysis
People’s hand lines usually reveal individual personalities and character traits. Read your palm line and explore the mystery hiding in them.
Gender Switch
Have you ever imagined what you would look like after changing to the opposite sex? Tap the toggle button to check your brand new face.
Baby Prediction
What will your future baby look like? Will your future baby be more like a father or a mother? Upload your face image and it will help you generate photos of your future baby.
Personal Test
Take the magic test to reveal your unique talents and special skills. Magic Life provides interesting quizzes. We hope that by taking the quiz, you can understand yourself better.
Payment&Subscription:
Choose from the following subscription options for unlimited access to all features:
• Weekly Subscription
• Monthly Subscription
• Annual Subscription

The cancellation must be done 24 hours before the end of a free trial or subscription period to avoid being charged. It will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period, and you will be downgraded to free service.

FREE forever. Also check out the PRO features for 14 days.
NO Subscription! Get PRO to gain the full power of Sorted³ once and for all. PRO iOS and macOS are separate purchases. You can choose to buy the bundle or separately.
Sorted³ has been featured by Apple as [App Of The Day], [Apps We Love Right Now] & [Get Stuff Done] in 130+ regions.
We've now rebuilt the app from the ground up to make it even easier (and more fun) to hyper-schedule your entire day from a single place.
As you start integrating Sorted³ into your daily workflow, you'll notice 3 foundational benefits:
● Unified Timeline
Sorted³ seamlessly integrates your calendar events and tasks into one timeline so you can manage your entire day from a single place. To make things even more delightful, you can take formatted notes, attachments and drawings on both your events and tasks inside the app.
● Effortless Scheduling
Sorted³ helps you easily set a schedule for your day, and decide what’s important, what can wait, and what you reasonably have time for. You can use Auto Schedule to figure out what you can realistically get done in a day. Instead of feeling underproductive, Sorted³ helps you set attainable goals that you can accomplish.
● Built-in Flexibility
Even when properly scheduled in advance, days don’t always go as planned! Sorted³ is built with that flexibility in mind to adjust to your changing schedule. It's as dynamic as your day, with smart features such as Magic Select and our signature Time Ruler to help you shift things around with a few taps.
On top of all these, there are various other functionalities to make your experience more fun and seamless across all your devices:
- New Widgets for iOS 16 & macOS Monterey
- Auto Backup
- Timeline view
- iCloud Sync
- Powerful repeat rules
- Light & Dark Themes
- Natural Language Processing
- URL Scheme
- Siri Integration
- And much more!
● Get Sorted³ Today
If you've ever struggled with to-do lists or managing your day, then you need to try hyper-scheduling with Sorted³.
- Sorted³ for macOS is now available on the Mac App Store!
- Sorted³ PRO is also available for Mac (sold separately)
To learn more, check our website and blog (sortedapp.com)
We love hearing from our users about how much clarity and focus Sorted³ brings to their day.
We can't wait for you to try it out and see for yourself!
● Community & Support
Join our Slack community by visiting: bit.ly/sorted-slack
Twitter: @SortedHQ
Email: hello@sortedapp.com
Support Center: support.sortedapp.com

bluejetty:00162142:ios.description:
Looking for a shopping experience that’s exciting, affordable, and refreshingly unpredictable? OneDayOnly is your go-to online shopping destination, offering BIG brand deals up to 80% OFF, with new deals every 24 hours! Our shopping app brings you unbeatable prices on everything from fashion to fitness gear, homeware to tech, and toys to travel must-haves.
Every single day, you’ll discover something new to add to your cart. Whether you’re doing some casual shopping or hunting down specific products, you’ll love the endless possibilities that come with our ever-changing deal lineup. We’ve made shopping more thrilling than ever.
Why choose OneDayOnly for your online shopping?
- Daily shopping deals that expire in 24 hours – get them before they’re gone
- Extra Time Deals for those can’t-miss bargains you just need a little more time for
- Lunchtime deals that drop daily at 1pm – limited time, limited quantity
- Regular shopping events, surprise campaigns, competitions and flash sales
- Easy category filters to streamline your shopping experience
- Push notifications so you never miss a shopping drop
- Exclusive shopping updates via our proudly South African daily newsletter
This is more than just a shopping app, it’s a new way to shop every day. With our clever mix of fun, humour, and great value, OneDayOnly brings a fresh spin to mobile shopping in South Africa. It’s spontaneous, it’s rewarding, and it’s always worth checking in.
Have questions about your order or need help with the app? Our friendly customer support team is here to make sure your shopping journey runs smoothly from start to finish.
Download the OneDayOnly app now and transform the way you shop. From home to on-the-go, from midday sales to midnight scrolls, there’s never a dull moment in your daily shopping routine.
OneDayOnly – your favourite online shopping app, reimagined.

bluejetty:00029910:ios.description:
Spark: Your Ultimate Shift Calendar App
For over 15 years, Spark has been the go-to app for simplifying shift work. Loaded with powerful, user-friendly features, Spark helps you balance work and personal life in one place—trusted daily by fire, police, EMS, healthcare professionals, and shift workers worldwide. With Spark’s unique "Cloud Connect" system, you can sync and share your schedule across all devices, keeping you and your loved ones in the loop anytime, anywhere.
Why Spark? Here’s why your colleagues love it:
Full Customization
Spark is designed for you. Track and log anything you need—vacation, sick time, comp time, overtime, trades, and more. Can’t find something? Add it with ease! Spark’s sleek, intuitive design lets you personalize everything to suit your work style.
Secure & Reliable
Your data is safe with us. Spark’s "Cloud Connect" syncs your encrypted calendar across devices, linked to your email. Lose or upgrade your phone? Just log back in, and it’s like you never left.
Comprehensive Shift Coverage
From pre-loaded schedules to custom department setups, Spark supports thousands of shift calendars. Don’t see yours? Easily create it, and it’s saved for you and your team.
Streamlined Shift Trades & Swaps
Manage and track all your trades and swaps down to the individual. Spark’s “Trade Board” lets you request and confirm trades within the app, automatically updating your calendar and stats—no extra steps.
Instant Visual Cues
Color-code shifts, events, and stats for at-a-glance planning. With Spark, you’ll know exactly what’s on the agenda without extra clicks.
Unmatched Customer Support
Our app thrives on user feedback. We’re committed to fast, helpful support, with most emails resolved in under two hours. Spark evolves with your input, making it the app you can rely on for years to come.
Try Spark free for 30 days, and experience the app that’s helping shift workers around the world stay organized. Visit www.LeakyNozzle.com to learn more!

bluejetty:00187803:ios.description:
The EventPilot conference app gives you instant paperless access to your entire meeting or event program.
Depending on the event and app configuration, features may include:
• Native universal app: Great for iPad and iPhone. No wifi connection required to access the conference program, schedule or animated maps.
• Personal Schedule: Build your personal daily schedule with an intuitive color coded daily agenda view.
• Dynamic Now: Stay informed about hot issues, program changes, your upcoming sessions, activity feeds and organizer notifications.
• Networking: Message other attendees directly in the app.
• Program: Browse the entire event program to create your personal schedule, take notes, rate sessions or speakers and more.
• Global Search: Find what you are looking for with a boolean global search that includes options such as exact match and exclusion terms.
• PowerPoint slide viewer: Download presentations and take notes on slides during a session.
• Expo Planning: Mark and take notes on exhibitors you visit or search the highly interactive maps.
• Email Notes: Instantly create a trip report with all bookmarks, notes, and contacts you have made during the event.
• Contact Sharing: Easily share digital business cards via QR Code.
Note: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00148238:ios.description:
The Civil Service Commission continues to be the leader in the GCC countries to use and adapt the newest technologies. 
Since the Civil Service Commission establishment, it provided nothing but the best services and technologies to help all Kuwait's government's employees with their daily jobs.
Today, the Civil Service Commission stride to make all the government services to be paperless, online, and more reliable than ever before.
Therefore, the Civil Service Commission are pleased to announce the newest system to provide them all news and announcements announced by Civil Service Commission, and all Kuwait's employees to provide them all the information about their daily jobs.
Some of the services we provide in this application are: 
• Civil Service Commission News 
• Announcements and Tenders
• Contact us
• The ability to sign up for the government sectors' employees
• The user can review his personal, job, and financial data
• Daily attendance and absence data
• Vacations details and balance
• The user can receive messages about his job, vacation, salary, …etc.
• The user can receive alerts, announcement, ads, …etc.

bluejetty:00024690:ios.description:
"Time Trap" got a long-awaited sequel! Explore this post-apocalypse world in all-around locations!
The experiments of the Ring of Time corporation didn't end after the incident in the Abandoned City. 
 Following a mysterious electromagnetic surge, the anomalous zone was transformed into Timeless. It is a unique world where space and time are distorted, but also new opportunities open up to heroes! Everyone who entered this zone became a shadow of his old self. The only way to escape from Timeless is to put together the Sphere of Singularity! So far no-one managed to gather all the Fragments of the Sphere. Now it's your mission to prove it is possible!
The game is TRULY FREE, the whole adventure is open to you without any additional purchases - it's entirely up to you to buy optional tools.
Game features:
- A variety of tasks: searching for items, spotting the differences, puzzles, restoration of disassembled objects
- Look for items in 360-degree panoramic scenes. Unusual 3D effects and colorful animations.
- Enjoy the exciting gameplay as the "Time Trap" storyline continues!
- Build your collection. Go through scenes again to try new quests and get new rewards!
We'll be happy to stay in touch with you at www.facebook.com/CrispApp - make comments, ask questions, get news about coming games!

bluejetty:00032050:ios.name: GOLFTEC
bluejetty:00032050:ios.summary:
The GOLFTEC App is equipped with performance-enhancing tools, leveraging its on-course GPS and game-tracking features to provide insightful analysis of your play.
On-Course Performance
Play Golf with On-Course GPS
Our precise GPS tool cal
bluejetty:00032050:ios.description:
The GOLFTEC App is equipped with performance-enhancing tools, leveraging its on-course GPS and game-tracking features to provide insightful analysis of your play.
On-Course Performance
Play Golf with On-Course GPS
Our precise GPS tool calculates exact yardage distances to any point on the golf course. See the course in extreme detail with adjustable distances, Club selection recommendations, Coach strategy, infographic overlays and more
Green Views
Know the best place to land your approach shot or line up your putts with detailed heat map showing Elevation Change and Slope for every green.
Stat Tracking and Performance Insights
Improve your game with GOLFTEC's Performance insights. The platform helps you gather and analyze performance data from a variety of sources, such as on-course stats, launch monitor numbers, and swing motion measurements.
Improvement Tools
Record Your Swing
Use your phone with the GOLFTEC App to record or upload your swings from the front or side anywhere you want. The app automatically trims, automatically centers, shows club path and body motion. 
Review Lessons & Drills
Dive deep into your previous lessons with videos of your swings, coach analysis and drills from any of your previous lessons. You'll never miss the tips and tools you need to work on your game with the GOLFTEC App in your pocket!
My Game Management with Skills Challenges, Bag Mapping & More
See your club fittings, Skills Challenge results and make a digital catalog of your golf equipment where you can add your clubs and keep track of their distances. Just a few of the tools you can use to improve your game!
Book & Change Lessons
The app makes it easy to book your lessons, club fittings and practice sessions. With monthly views and easy-to-see availability, managing your schedule is easy.
Access to the Pro Shop
You'll have access to the GOLFTEC Pro Shop in the App where you can find curated golf products that help you play and enjoy the game even more. Current students and plus subscribers will also have special discounted pricing exclusive to GOLFTEC that can't be found anywhere else!
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00168648:android.description:
Stand up for survival in a devastated world where zombies rule! Zombie Apocalypse" is a tower defense type game in which players defend a shelter in a desperate situation. A key feature of the game is that players can move freely through the field, constructing turrets, walls, and traps to protect themselves and their shelters from zombie attacks.
Players use real-time strategy and resource management skills to counter zombie attacks. Set in devastated cities and wilderness areas, players must repel the oncoming waves of zombies through skillful placement and tactics. They then rescue survivors, expand their shelters, and acquire new resources to keep their hopes of survival alive.
In addition, players can unlock special abilities and upgrades to enhance their own characters. And choices change the story, with players' actions affecting the outcome.
Zombie Apocalypse" offers an exciting experience of battling overwhelming zombie hordes, strategic construction, and bonding with survivors. Will you be able to survive in this desperate world?"

bluejetty:00152072:ios.name: Kegel Prime: Men's Health
bluejetty:00152072:ios.summary:
The foundation of lifelong men’s health starts with the ultimate Kegel Prime app – guided pelvic floor strengthening. Strong inside, confident outside.
No matter what age you are, healthy pelvic floor muscles are essential: they form a ham
bluejetty:00152072:ios.description:
The foundation of lifelong men’s health starts with the ultimate Kegel Prime app – guided pelvic floor strengthening. Strong inside, confident outside.
No matter what age you are, healthy pelvic floor muscles are essential: they form a hammock or sling for your organs, enhance blood flow, and support men's health in all areas. A weak pelvic area can lead to problems in controlling the bladder or bowels, or other common issues that affect confidence. You can prevent that by strengthening the pelvic region through Kegel exercises.
Kegel Prime is an exclusive men’s health app designed to help men enhance their pelvic floor, improve stamina, core strength and uplift mental wellbeing through guided Kegel-exercise training with immersive features for all levels.
I. Personalised Guided Kegel Training
Whether you’re new to Kegels or looking to refine your technique, Kegel Prime evolves with your progress, offering adjustable difficulty levels and precision guidance based on initial assessment. Train with step-by-step videos and perfect your technique using real-time feedback, ensuring every rep is effective.
Explore a range of targeted Kegel exercise variations combined with breathing techniques: Long Holds, Quick Flicks, Elevator Kegels, Reverse Kegels, Kegel Pulses.
Each technique is crafted to help you gain control, endurance and responsiveness in your pelvic-floor muscles. Choose the programme that suits your needs, learn from leading men’s-health experts, and grow in all aspects of your life. With only 10 minutes per day, you can expect results within a few weeks to a few months.
II. Stay Inspired with Progress Tracking
To sustain the benefits of Kegels, track and integrate these exercises into your daily routine. Use the progress-tracking dashboard to monitor your journey and training milestones. Log daily metrics to understand the connection between your lifestyle and pelvic health: water intake, sleep quality, nutrition habits. Our intelligent AI-analysis engine uses your training and health data to generate personalised insights and suggestions, helping you optimise results based on your habits.
III. Motivation Tips & Story Unlock System
After each training session, unlock a piece of a story, extra health-content or complementary workout like core workout, gain strength or build other muscles.
We understand how personal this journey is. That’s why Kegel Prime is built with privacy at its core:
- Phone-Free Mode: enable vibration and audio cues or switch to smartwatch integration for on-the-go training
- Discreet Appearance
- Your data is secure
Get ready to strengthen pelvic-floor muscles and command your wellness. Download Kegel Prime and start your daily training for decades of vitality.

- Annual subscription: US $99.99

bluejetty:00130897:ios.description:
Introducing Wicca - Your Ultimate Magical Companion!
Unleash the power of ancient wisdom and embrace the mystical world of Wicca with our all-inclusive app - Wicca! Whether you're a seasoned Wiccan practitioner or a curious soul seeking to explore the realm of magic, Wicca is your gateway to harnessing the energies of the universe and casting powerful spells.
Key Features:
Wiccan Spells: Explore a vast collection of meticulously crafted spells for love, prosperity, protection, healing, and more. From simple rituals to complex incantations, our app guides you step-by-step in performing powerful spells to manifest your desires.
Magical Herbs, Candles, and Crystals: Delve into the properties and uses of various magical herbs, candles, and crystals. Discover the art of combining these elements to enhance your spellwork and connect with the natural forces around you.
Wicca Glossary: Deepen your understanding of Wiccan terminology with our comprehensive glossary. From essential rituals to sacred symbols, this feature acts as your personal reference guide on your magical journey.
AI Wicca Practitioner: Meet your digital Wiccan mentor! Our AI-powered practitioner provides personalized guidance based on your interests and intentions. Ask questions, seek advice, and receive tailored recommendations for your magical endeavors.
Wheel of the Year Guide: Immerse yourself in the Wiccan Wheel of the Year - a sacred calendar marking the cycles of nature and the eight Sabbats. Stay attuned to the changing seasons, celebrate the festivals, and honor the divine energies that govern the universe.
Lunar Calendar: Work in harmony with the moon's phases and harness its energy for your rituals and spells. Our lunar calendar keeps you informed about the moon's cycles, empowering you to align your magic with the ebb and flow of the cosmic tides.
Why Choose Wicca?
Beginner-Friendly: Whether you're new to Wicca or an experienced practitioner, our app caters to users of all levels with easy-to-follow instructions and informative content.
Knowledge at Your Fingertips: Access a treasure trove of ancient wisdom, folklore, and practical tips within a single app. No need to scour various sources; everything you need is right here!
Empower Your Intentions: Unleash the power within yourself and discover the art of manifesting your desires through the transformative practices of Wicca.
Enhance Your Spiritual Journey: Embrace a deeper connection with nature and the spiritual realm as you embark on a journey of self-discovery and personal growth.
Are you ready to tap into the mystical forces that surround us and unlock your true potential? Download Wicca now and become the master of your destiny with the power of magic and Wiccan wisdom in the palm of your hand! Blessed be! 
Disclaimer: The Wicca app is intended for educational and entertainment purposes only. While we strive to provide accurate and reliable information, we make no warranties or representations regarding the effectiveness or results of any spells, rituals, or practices mentioned in the app.

Terms: https://wicca.ardasen.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00086153:ios.name: MyBP - Blood Pressure App
bluejetty:00086153:ios.summary: Take control of your cardiovascular health with MyBP App. This comprehensive app is designed to help you manage and monitor your blood pressure. Lower your blood pressure and maintain healthy levels with this trusted companion by your side.
bluejetty:00086153:ios.description:
Take control of your cardiovascular health with MyBP App. This comprehensive app is designed to help you manage and monitor your blood pressure. Lower your blood pressure and maintain healthy levels with this trusted companion by your side. 
Key Features:
1. Blood Pressure Monitoring Made Easy: MyBP App allows you to effortlessly track and record your blood pressure readings. Use the app to log your measurements and view a detailed history of your readings over time. Keep an eye on your progress and identify patterns to better understand your cardiovascular health.
2. Personalized Health Insights: Gain valuable insights into your blood pressure trends with the app's intelligent analysis. MyBP App uses advanced algorithms to identify patterns and provide you with personalized recommendations to help you achieve optimal blood pressure levels. Understand the factors that contribute to your hypertension and make informed decisions about your health.
3. Medication Reminders and Management: Never miss a dose again with the app's medication reminder feature. Set reminders for your medication schedule, doctor appointment and blood work and receive timely alerts to ensure you stay on track with your treatment plan. 
4. Lifestyle Tracking and Guidance: Achieve a healthier lifestyle with MyBP's comprehensive tracking and guidance system. Get personalized recommendations on blood work, health screenings and specialty medical assistance to complement your blood pressure management plan.
5. Secure Data Storage and Backup: Your health data is precious, and we take its security seriously. MyBP App ensures the utmost privacy and protection for your personal health information. Safely store and backup your data, and easily share it with your healthcare provider during appointments for a more informed discussion.
6. Educational Resources and Support: Stay up to date with the latest information on hypertension, treatment options, and lifestyle modifications through the app's rich library of educational resources. Access articles, videos, and expert tips to expand your knowledge and empower yourself to make healthier choices.
Download MYBP App today and take charge of your cardiovascular health. Start managing your blood pressure effectively, making positive lifestyle changes, and working towards a healthier future. Remember, every small step counts on the journey to a healthier heart.
Note: MyBP App is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for personalized guidance and treatment plans.
