bluejetty:00179446:ios.summary: Welcome to Astrology+ – your all-in-one astrology companion. Dive deep into your birth chart, enjoy personalized daily, weekly, monthly, and annual horoscopes, receive daily tarot readings, explore romantic compatibility, and so much more!
bluejetty:00179446:ios.description:
Welcome to Astrology+ – your all-in-one astrology companion. Dive deep into your birth chart, enjoy personalized daily, weekly, monthly, and annual horoscopes, receive daily tarot readings, explore romantic compatibility, and so much more!
With Astrology+ Premium, you unlock a premium experience that elevates your cosmic journey. Access detailed natal chart analyses, uncover insights about your personality, career opportunities, soul alignment, and ideal romantic matches. Stay in tune with the stars with monthly horoscope readings and moon reports. Immerse yourself in a beautifully designed, ad-free experience that offers valuable insights and wisdom from the cosmos.
For astrological insights, cosmic advice, or daily interpretations, download Astrology+ today!
Personalized "Yourscope" Horoscopes
We provide free daily, weekly, and monthly horoscopes for all zodiac sun signs. We also offer:
Free horoscopes (for today, tomorrow, weekly, monthly, and annually)
Premium, in-depth love, career, and destiny astrology reports
Premium, detailed annual horoscope readings to see what the year has in store for you!
Daily Tarot Card Readings
Astrology+ offers daily tarot card readings for insightful and engaging advice. Explore a variety of free tarot readings for fun and intriguing glimpses into your life's events and relationships.
Love Compatibility
Wondering if they're the one? Use the stars to calculate your romantic connection and find out if your match is made to last! Astrology+ provides free Love Match readings for all signs and daily love compatibility horoscopes.
Astrology+ Subscription:
What's Included:
Birth Chart: Discover your unique identity with a map of the planetary alignment at your birth.
Personalized Horoscopes: An in-depth reading showing how the month's and year's aspects will affect your life.
Monthly Moon Reading: An exclusive lunar report available only to premium members.
Astrology+ offers a monthly premium subscription.
You won't be charged until the end of the 7-day trial period, at which point you will then be charged $4.99 per month or $49.99 if you choose the annual plan.
Astrology+ premium subscription purchases will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription will automatically renew unless the auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the subscription period ends. Your premium subscription auto-renew can be turned off or managed in your iTunes account settings. The subscription will be managed by you, the user, in your iTunes account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Prices are equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines is the equivalent subscription price in $USD
By using Astrology+, you agree to our Terms of Service: https://www.astrology.com/tos.html and Privacy Policy: https://www.astrology.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00021258:ios.description:
Easy Life is the #1 Translation and Object Recognition app available in the store. Translate text in images instantly by just pointing your camera. 
We believe in constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible. That's why we're excited to introduce our latest creation: an all-in-one app that does it all.
Relax and unwind with our selection of meditational sounds and horoscopes. Our horoscopes are fun and easy to read, so you can learn more about what the stars have in store for you.
Magical camera for your all needs. You will be surprised at how accurate and intelligent it is! 
Most advanced AI is integrated into Easy Life. Easy Life identifies and translates everything!
** Features
- New feature Scanner module is added. You can scan and send documents in pdf's.
- New feature Sign documents by hand.
- New feature OCR images and send them by share kit.
- New feature biometric document security added.
- New feature face filters added.
- New feature horoscope service is added.
- New feature meditational sounds added.
- New feature cartoon filters added.
- The most advanced object recognition.
- Celebrity and face recognition.
- Translate any documents to the desired language.
- Export to TXT.
- Auto language detection, no need to know the source language.
- Supports 100+ Languages.
- Instant camera translation.
- Photos: Take or import photos for higher quality translations (90 languages)
- Country Prediction
- Text pronouncing: Let your translated text be pronounced by the App.
- Import images from google photos or apple photos app.
Note: The Free version may be subject to limitations.
*Parts of service translated by Microsoft ®. Parts of service translated by Google Translate TM. Parts of service translated by Amazon Translate TM.
*  Translations between the following languages are supported:
Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Azerbaijani, Basque, Belarusian, Bengali, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Catalan, Cebuano, Chichewa, Chinese (Simplified), Chinese (Traditional), Corsican, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, English, Esperanto, Estonian, Filipino, Finnish, French, Frisian, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hausa, Hawaiian, Hebrew, Hindi, Hmong, Hungarian, Icelandic, Igbo, Indonesian, Irish, Italian, Japanese, Javanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer, Kinyarwanda, Korean, Kurdish, Kyrgyz, Lao, Latin, Latvian, Lithuanian, Luxembourgish, Macedonian, Malagasy, Malay, Nepali, Norwegian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Romanian, Russian, Samoan, Scots Gaelic, Serbian, Sesotho, Shona, Sindhi, Sinhala, Slovak, Slovenian, Somali, Spanish, Sundanese, Swahili, Swedish, Tajik, Tamil, Tatar, Telugu, Thai, Turkish, Turkmen, Ukrainian, Urdu, Uyghur, Uzbek, Vietnamese.
**Subscription Benefits**
- Text translation service requires a premium subscription.
- You can identify unlimited objects.
- Enjoy the app without ads.
- OCR only available in the premium version.
- Continuously updated face filters may require a subscription.
- Some of the photo filters requires a subscription or an rewarded ad view.
- Unlimited OCR Exports.

bluejetty:00166122:ios.name: Arcadia Dominoes for Seniors
bluejetty:00166122:ios.summary: Welcome to Arcadia Dominoes, the ultimate way to enjoy the classic board game of dominoes anytime, anywhere, play for free and without an internet connection. With multiple game modes: Draw Dominoes, Block Dominoes, and All Fives, a user-fr
bluejetty:00166122:ios.description:
Welcome to Arcadia Dominoes, the ultimate way to enjoy the classic board game of dominoes anytime, anywhere, play for free and without an internet connection. With multiple game modes: Draw Dominoes, Block Dominoes, and All Fives, a user-friendly interface, customizable options, and challenging opponents, you’ll never run out of ways to enjoy this classic board game.
Arcadia Dominoes is more than just a game, it's a whole journey that brings the classic tile-based board game experience to your fingertips. Whether you’re at home, on a break, or traveling, you can play Arcadia Dominoes at your convenience. This domino game is designed for everyone, speciall for seniors, making it easy to pick up and play, but challenging enough to keep you engaged for hours!
Why Choose Arcadia Dominoes?
Dominoes has been a beloved board game for centuries, providing entertainment, challenges, and a way to connect with friends and family. Our Arcadia Dominoes offers a perfect blend of strategy, fun, and competition, ensuring that you can enjoy the game with no Wi-Fi, data connection, or distractions necessary.
Key Features
- Offline Play: Enjoy the full dominoes experience with no Wifi—perfect for those moments when you're on the go, or simply want to relax and play without distractions.
- Multiple Game Modes: Choose from classic modes like Block, Draw, and All Fives, each with its own unique challenges and strategies. Whether you’re in the mood for a quick match or a longer, more strategic game, we have a mode that fits your needs.
- Leaderboard Competition: Even though you’re playing offline, the competition doesn’t stop. Compete to climb the ranks and become the top player or master in world and your area. Challenge yourself to beat your own records and achieve new milestones.
- Customizable Gameplay: You can not only choose from different domino sets, table styles, and tile themes to make the game visually appealing, but also personlize your experience with various skins and avatars to keep the game fresh and exciting.
- User-Friendly Interface: Our app is designed for all aged , especially seniors with simplicity and ease of use in mind. The intuitive interface ensures that you can navigate the game effortlessly, with clear buttons and easy-to-read text. 
- Free to Play:Access all features with optional in-app purchases.—play for free!
- Multilingual Support: Arcadia Dominoes is available in multiple languages, making it accessible to players from all over the world.
Multiple Game Modes
- Draw Dominoes: If you can’t make a move, you’ll draw from the boneyard until you find a playable piece. This mode adds an extra layer of challenge, keeping the game exciting and unpredictable.
- Block Dominoes: In this mode, the goal is to be the first to play all your dominoes or block your opponent from making any moves. It’s a game of strategy and planning, where every move counts.
- All Fives Dominoes: Score points by making the ends of the domino chain add up to multiples of five. This mode tests both your strategic thinking and math skills, offering a unique twist on the classic dominoes game.
Whether you’re a Domino enthusiast or just looking for a fun and challenging game to pass the time, Arcadia Dominoes has everything you need. Download now for free and start playing this classic board game!

• One-finger control.

bluejetty:00015439:ios.name: Math 24 - Mental Math Cards
bluejetty:00015439:ios.summary: Math 24 - Mental Math Cards is a classical math puzzle game. The game is designed to help people of all skill levels improve their arithmetic abilities and mental math skills. Elementary school students can also play it. But you may not sol
bluejetty:00015439:ios.description:
Math 24 - Mental Math Cards is a classical math puzzle game. The game is designed to help people of all skill levels improve their arithmetic abilities and mental math skills. Elementary school students can also play it. But you may not solve some questions even you are a graduate student!
■ How To Play
The rules are simple. Combine 4 numbers into 24 by addition(+), subtraction(-), multiplication(×) and division(÷). For example, try to use these 4 numbers: 2048 to make 24. The answer is (2+0)×(4+8)=24. The question is easy, but some questions are much more difficult. You can try this: 6 6 5 9 to make 24. 
■ Stage Mode
15 stages and 300 well designed levels in total. The stages are from "Baby" to "King of Math", from easy to difficult. Touch the help button at the top-right corner if you can't solve a question. There are 3 chances to use help button in each stage.
■ Speed Mode
10 random questions! Make 24 as fast as you can! Touch the garbage can button at the top-right corner to change a question. There are 3 chances to change a question in each game.
■ Game Center
"Math 24" is fully integrated with Game Center - providing both Leaderboards and Achievements. The Game Center features allow you to test your skills against the rest of the world and to share your scores and accomplishments with friends.
■ Features
- Well-designed levels
- Best user experience and graphics
- Exciting speed mode
■ The App is suitable for you
- If you like sudoku, brain training, math game or puzzle game.
- If you want to play with friends or family.
- If you want to improve you math skills, especially the mental math skills.
Have fun!

• Choose to sync light to a basic color or a dynamic scene or even the colors extracted from your photo

bluejetty:00015949:ios.description:
ADD SPEECH BUBBLES TO YOUR PICTURES!
Bring everyone’s thoughts and words to life. 
Make your pictures talk!
*** Make Your Photos Talk with Pic Talk! ***
Turn your photos into fun, engaging stories with speech bubbles! Bring everyone’s thoughts and words to life with Pic Talk. Perfect for capturing funny moments, creating memes, or adding personal messages to your favorite pictures. With Pic Talk, your photos aren't just static images – they become lively conversations!
Features:
- Comic-Style Captions: Create unique, comic-style captions to add personality and humor to your photos. Whether it's a witty remark or a heartfelt message, Pic Talk lets you express yourself creatively.
- Customizable Speech Bubbles: Choose from a wide range of fonts, colors, and bubble styles to perfectly match the tone and style of your photo. From serious quotes to silly dialogues, make your speech bubbles as unique as your moments.
- Multiple Bubbles for Group Photos: Capture everyone’s words in one frame by adding multiple speech bubbles to group photos. Perfect for friends' gatherings, family events, or any photo where everyone has something to say!
- Easy Editing: Drag, rotate, and adjust bubbles with ease using simple finger gestures. Customize the placement and size to fit your photo perfectly. Pic Talk is designed to be user-friendly, so editing your photos feels natural and fun.
- Versatile Photo Options: Choose any photo from your library or snap a new one directly within the app. Pic Talk supports high-resolution images to ensure your photos look great no matter where you use them.
- Gallery Access: Easily edit your photos at any time from the gallery. Save your creations to revisit and modify later, keeping your memories fresh and flexible.
- Seamless Sharing: Share your customized photos instantly on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, or send them directly via email and text. Connect with friends and family by bringing your photos to life in a whole new way.
Subscription Pricing and Terms:
Pic Talk offers two auto-renewing subscription options:
$2.99 per week
$12.99 per year
These prices apply to United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and charges may be converted to your local currency depending on your country of residence.
Your Pic Talk subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term, and your credit card will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time in your iTunes account settings. Refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term.
Make your photos speak volumes with Pic Talk – download now and start creating your own comic stories today!
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/speechbubbleios/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://zipoapps.com/speechbubbleios/terms/

bluejetty:00125447:android.name: Idle SWAT Academy Tycoon
bluejetty:00125447:android.summary:
rain up the most elite SWAT team in the entire world! This isn’t your normal police squad. Invest in your academy and soon your recruits will be ready for the toughest dispatch missions!
Earn cash and gold to spend on more training areas.
bluejetty:00125447:android.description:
rain up the most elite SWAT team in the entire world! This isn’t your normal police squad. Invest in your academy and soon your recruits will be ready for the toughest dispatch missions!
Earn cash and gold to spend on more training areas. Idle your time away while your recruits work and train. Become a rich SWAT tycoon billionaire while building up your base of operations!
There are several training areas where your recruits need to train to get ready for action. They include:
Breach Training - knock down doors and get ready for action
Firearms Training - get down to the shooting range and perfect your aim
Obstacle Course - you’ve got to be fit to be be the best
Close Quarter Combat Training - sometimes you’re going to have to face up
Canine Training - Police dogs are your best friend, so let their nose do the work
Tech Training - It’s the 21st century, so get robot and drone tech to help solve the crime
Shoot House - the classic hostage situation training - storm buildings or planes, clear rooms and find the enemy
Bomb Squad - a steady hand is needed here to defuse bombs and save. The day
Rappel Training - you’ve got to be able to quickly get down ropes to access windows and elevator shafts
Car Pursuit - hone your driving skills so you’re ready for the craziest getaway drivers on the road
Car Ramming - sometimes you’re going to have to take the enemy off the road
Sniper Training - a steady arm and a deep breath to take out the baddies at long distance

Qobuz, a unique approach to online music.

Access an unparalleled wealth of content: 
. Over 100 million tracks in lossless in high resolution & CD quality
. More than 500,000 original editorial articles written by experts
. Thousands of human-curated playlists in rock, classical, jazz, electronic, pop, funk, soul, R&B, metal, and more 
QOBUZ is the only platform to offer both music streaming and downloads in Hi-Res.
Listen to your music where you want, when you want: Qobuz is available on all your devices, even without internet connection in offline mode. 
▶ Discover and experience a high quality, authentic listening experience by trying Qobuz SOLO FREE and WITHOUT COMMITMENT for 30 days directly in the app.
• EXPERIENCE AUTHENTIC SOUND
- Enjoy an exceptional listening experience with high quality music, straight from the studio
- Enjoy new releases and reissues in lossless, in CD (FLAC 16-Bit /44.1 kHz) and Hi-Res quality (24-Bit encoded sound up to 192 kHz) 
• DISCOVER THE LATEST MUSIC 
- Explore the new Discover page for a simpler and more rewarding experience
- Take advantage of a plethora of unique editorial content for free: 
. News articles 
. Panoramas: deep dives on an artist, album, genre, period or label
. Artist interviews
. A Hi-Fi section to enhance your listening with the best audio equipment
- Design and features directly accessible from the magazine:
. A clean interface and simplified navigation
. A search bar dedicated to the magazine to filter your searches and quickly access the content you crave
. Instant access to recent articles and your latest listening sessions from your home screen via Qobuz widgets
• ENRICH YOUR MUSIC EDUCATION
- New: Lyrics now available and the player, redesigned to match the music.
- Access to digital booklets with liner notes, and all of the details behind your favorite albums.
- (Re)discover new and iconic artists and albums. Discover the most promising new talents and listen to thousands of regularly updated playlists, thanks to our team of music experts.
• BENEFIT FROM HI-RES COMPATIBILITY 
Qobuz is supported by the main wireless listening devices (Chromecast, Airplay, Roon, etc.) and is compatible with all types of audio equipment from the biggest and most prestigious Hi-Fi brands.
• TAKE ADVANTAGE OF QOBUZ CONNECT
Take full advantage of QOBUZ features on our Hi-Fi partners' equipment without any loss in quality.
Transfer and import all your playlists and favorites from another streaming platform onto the Qobuz app quickly and easily with Soundiiz.
Enjoying QOBUZ? Follow us:
- Facebook: @qobuz
- X: @qobuzUSA
- Instagram: @qobuz

bluejetty:00077897:ios.description:
PicMeet is a photo-powered community where you can express yourself, discover people with similar interests, and share moments through photos. Explore the community, start conversations, and use creative tools to make every post feel more personal.
DISCOVER PEOPLE AND CONTENT
Browse profiles and posts shared by the PicMeet community. See who is active, explore different interests and creative styles, and use discovery preferences to find content and people relevant to you. When location access is enabled, approximate distance can help surface profiles and moments from your area.
SHARE YOUR MOMENTS
Post edited photos, creative ideas, and everyday updates. Browse recent activity, like and comment on posts, and connect naturally through shared interests and experiences.
CONTINUE THE CONVERSATION
Use private messages to stay in touch with other users. Send text, share photos, exchange reactions, and continue conversations that begin with a post or common interest.
CREATE YOUR LOOK
PicMeet also brings together a complete collection of easy-to-use photo tools. Create personalized avatars, turn words or photos into artwork, explore anime, comic, sketch, and color styles, try different ages, hairstyles, and hair colors, change photo backgrounds, apply artistic filters, blend multiple exposures, and give every photo a distinctive look.
Whether you are sharing a moment, exploring the community, or expressing your creativity, PicMeet gives you more ways to discover, share, and connect.

• And more…

Learn biohacking techniques and protocols to improve your mental health & athletic performance:
• Why mouth breathing is sabotaging your sleep & health
• How to use functional breathing to improve endurance

• How to use diaphragmatic breathing to reduce anxiety
• The proper way to breathe during cardio & strength training
• And more…
LEARN PROPER BREATHING WITH AN IMMERSIVE 7-DAY COURSE

bluejetty:00079879:ios.description:
Welcome to Jigsaw Master, the ultimate jigsaw puzzle app that sets a new standard in puzzle gaming! Developed by a top-tier developer, our app offers an unparalleled puzzle experience that has captivated millions of players worldwide.
Immerse yourself in a vast collection of over 10,000+ stunning HD pictures, carefully curated to provide hours of addictive and relaxing gameplay. With Jigsaw Master, you'll never encounter missing pieces or gimmicks. Simply enjoy the pure pleasure of piecing together beautiful jigsaw puzzles.
Created by game experts, our app not only entertains but also exercises your short-term memory and concentration. Say goodbye to cluttered puzzle boards and enjoy the convenience of solving real jigsaw puzzles right on your device.
Indulge in the enchanting world of HD jigsaw puzzles and discover new vibrant puzzles every day. Our puzzle game for adults features a wide range of difficulty levels, from easy to hard, ensuring a satisfying challenge for puzzle enthusiasts of all skill levels.
Immerse yourself in the stress-relieving and captivating world of Jigsaw Master. Escape the mundane routine and experience the joy of solving daily jigsaw puzzles designed to relax and entertain.

- Enjoy over 20,000 jigsaw puzzles for free, featuring beautiful high-quality pictures across various categories such as Colors, Flowers, Nature, Animals, Art, Landmarks, and more.

bluejetty:00032833:ios.description:
Step into the world of “Go Climb!” – a puzzle game that will test your mind and thrill your senses. Your mission is simple but challenging: untangle ropes and connect climbers to safety. As you dive deeper into the game, each puzzle grows more complex, keeping you hooked as you discover new ways to master the knots and guide your climbers to their goal.
Every level brings a fresh, exciting challenge, offering you the chance to conquer new puzzles, earn trophies, and reach the highest ranks in the Trophy League. Do you have what it takes to rise through the ranks, collecting trophies and proving yourself as the ultimate puzzle-solving master? The journey is filled with obstacles, but victory is within your reach if you stay sharp!
With the clock ticking, you’ll need to think fast, but there’s no need to worry – special features like the Time Freeze Booster and Hypercharge are there to help you when the pressure is on. As you progress, the puzzles will push your strategic skills to the limit, but with practice and patience, you’ll climb to new heights and unlock even more thrilling challenges.
Join the adventure today! Download “Go Climb!” and experience the joy of untangling ropes, collecting trophies, and climbing to the top of the Trophy League. With regular updates, new events, and endless levels, there’s always something new to explore. The climbers are counting on you – can you solve the puzzle and lead them to victory?

bluejetty:00080790:ios.description: Get ready to embark on a colorful journey of blocks and blasts in "Tap Master" – your new puzzle obsession!Each level presents a unique 3D puzzle where your mission is to tap the blocks smartly and watch them disappear with satisfying effects! The intuitive controls make it easy for anyone to pick up and play, yet mastering the art of Tap Master will keep puzzle enthusiasts intrigued for hours on end. Whether you're waiting in line or lounging at home, Tap Master offers a perfect blend of relaxation and mental stimulation.No timers, no pressure – just you and a universe of blocks waiting to be tapped away. With hundreds of levels, each burst of color brings you one step closer to becoming a tap master. And for those seeking glory, challenge your friends on a race to complete first 1000 levels.Features include:• Simple yet addictive tap-to-clear game play• A multitude of levels with increasing complexity• Vibrant graphics and satisfying sound effects• Play at your own pace without any stress• Compete with friends for level achievementsReady to test your tapping skills? Download Tap Master now and join the tapping frenzy that's captivating puzzle lovers worldwide. Tap your way to triumph and experience the joy of watching blocks vanish right before your eyes – one tap at a time!Are you up for the challenge? It's time to tap, solve, and shine!

bluejetty:00100471:ios.name: Pair Pop: Solitaire Match
bluejetty:00100471:ios.summary:
Step into a calm and charming world where emojis align, patterns reveal themselves, and every match brings a soft spark of satisfaction.
Pair Pop: Solitaire Match offers a relaxing visual puzzle experience wrapped in cute designs, gentle fl
bluejetty:00100471:ios.description:
Step into a calm and charming world where emojis align, patterns reveal themselves, and every match brings a soft spark of satisfaction.
Pair Pop: Solitaire Match offers a relaxing visual puzzle experience wrapped in cute designs, gentle flow, and simple yet rewarding interactions.
There’s no rush and no pressure—just the quiet joy of discovering hidden connections and watching the board clear in a smooth, satisfying rhythm. Each level invites you to slow down, observe carefully, and enjoy the moment when everything clicks into place.
Relaxing & Easy-to-Play
Play at your own pace with intuitive tap and swap controls.
Group emoji cards that share a hidden visual connection—whether it’s color, expression, shape, or a subtle little detail you might miss at first glance.
Rearrange, think ahead, and clear the board step by step in a calm, cozy flow.
A Gentle Layer of Logic
Every puzzle is a small visual challenge.
Look closely, spot clever patterns, and plan your moves with care.
The difficulty grows naturally, keeping your mind engaged while maintaining a soothing, stress-free experience.
Cute Visuals & Satisfying Interactions
Bright, expressive emojis bring every level to life.
Each correct group creates a clean, pleasing pop as tiles disappear.
Watch the board transform from scattered to perfectly organized in a calming rhythm that feels both rewarding and peaceful.
Features You’ll Love
• Relaxing emoji-based visual puzzle gameplay
• Simple tap-and-swap controls
• Hidden visual connections that train focus and observation
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels
• Helpful hints when you need a little guidance
• Smooth animations and satisfying feedback
• No timers, no pressure—just pure puzzle enjoyment
Whether you’re taking a short break or settling in for a cozy play session, Pair Pop: Solitaire Match offers the perfect balance of relaxation and mental stimulation.
Sharpen your focus, enjoy the adorable emojis, and experience the simple joy of finding the perfect match.
Download now and start popping the perfect pairs.

bluejetty:00124480:android.description:
d3D Sculptor is a digital sculpting tool that combines 3D modeling, texturing and painting. d3D offers tools to push, pull, extrude, move, rotate, stretch, or otherwise manipulate a digital object as if it were made of a real-life substance such as clay. Tweak UV coordinates - Scale, Rotate, Translate UV, and revert to the original state at any point. Import OBJ for further detailing or texturing. OBJ export and load your 3D Model into 3D design programs! 
Features:
• Import and Export formats OBJ
• OBJ for universal
• Face Extrude and Intrude
• Modify Vertices, Faces and Edges
• Dynamic Topology
• Sculpt with alpha textures
• Paint and Texture (Export Textures)
• Load your own custom MatCaps
• UV Editor
 - Unwrap Modifier - AI UV Unwrap
• Boolean operations
 -Intersect, Subtract, Union
• Subdivide By Edge/Center/Curve
• Decimate model to reduce polygon count
• Draw Mask
• Share your creations in the d3D Sculptor gallery
Free Version Limit :
 Unlimited export for models with up to 65k vertices
5 undo and redo limit

bluejetty:00030512:ios.description:
Fun Merge: Fruity Fusion Frenzy
Get ready to embark on a delectable journey filled with juicy challenges and fruity rewards! Fun Merge: Fruity Fusion Frenzy is a tantalizing puzzle adventure where you drop and combine mouthwatering fruits to reach the ultimate goal: a giant, succulent watermelon!
Game Features:
Fruit Dropping Delight: The core of Fun Merge revolves around dropping identical fruits onto each other to create bigger and more exotic varieties. Strategically position your fruits for maximum merging potential!
Watermelon Quest: Your ultimate destination is the majestic watermelon, but the path is paved with puzzles and obstacles. Merge strategically to overcome each challenge and get closer to your prize.
Food Chain Reaction: Every successful merge triggers a chain reaction, sending fruits tumbling down in a delightful cascade. Plan your drops carefully to maximize combos and unlock special bonuses.
Luscious Levels: Progress through a series of vibrant levels, each filled with unique challenges and juicy surprises. Discover hidden power-ups and secret recipes along the way!
Appetizing Art: Feast your eyes on a visually stunning world bursting with vibrant colors and mouthwatering fruit designs. The game's delicious visuals will leave you craving more.
Squishy Satisfaction: Experience the satisfying squish of merging fruits thanks to realistic physics and tactile feedback. It's a feast for your senses!
Join the fruity frenzy and satisfy your cravings for puzzle fun with Fun Merge: Fruity Fusion Frenzy. Download now and let the merging madness begin!

Watermelon Quest: Your ultimate destination is the majestic watermelon, but the path is paved with puzzles and obstacles. Merge strategically to overcome each challenge and get closer to your prize.
Food Chain Reaction:  Every successful merge triggers a chain reaction, sending fruits tumbling down in a delightful cascade. Plan your drops carefully to maximize combos and unlock special bonuses.
Luscious Levels: Progress through a series of vibrant levels, each filled with unique challenges and juicy surprises. Discover hidden power-ups and secret recipes along the way!
Appetizing Art:  Feast your eyes on a visually stunning world bursting with vibrant colors and mouthwatering fruit designs. The game's delicious visuals will leave you craving more.
Squishy Satisfaction:  Experience the satisfying squish of merging fruits thanks to realistic physics and tactile feedback. It's a feast for your senses!

Join the fruity frenzy and satisfy your cravings for puzzle fun with Fun Merge: Fruity Fusion Frenzy. Download now and let the merging madness begin!

bluejetty:00125884:ios.description:
Ready for the ultimate kitchen clash? Food Gang is a fast-paced online multiplayer brawler where crazy food heroes fight with powerful weapons in explosive arena battles. Jump into real-time PvP matches against players worldwide, or invite your friends for a private match in Party Battle.
CHOOSE YOUR BRAWLER
Unlock and upgrade 16 unique food heroes, each with their own weapon, combat style and special ability. Find the one that matches your playstyle:
- Bro: The gangsta broccoli rocking a rapid-fire Uzi.
- Tom: The military tomato packing a heavy-duty bazooka.
- Nori: The stealthy maki ninja slicing through the competition.
- Pepe: The explosive Mexican chili bringing the heat.
- Leon: The croissant emperor charging in with his bayonet.
- Rob: The mischievous apple archer poisoning foes from a distance.
DOMINATE THE ARENA
Fight across seven game modes, from tactical team play to chaotic free-for-alls:
- Gang Battle (2v2): Team up and outplay the rival squad.
- Food Battle (Free For All): Every food for itself in a chaotic arena.
- Last Gang Standing & Last Food Standing: Survive the chaos and be the last one remaining.
- Fast Gang & Fast Food: Ultra-speedy action for non-stop excitement.
- Boss Rush: One player becomes a giant, and the rest of the gang must team up to bring it down.
UPGRADE & CLIMB THE TROPHY ROAD
- Unlock over 60 skills to power up your combat abilities in every match.
- Progress through the Trophy Road and earn rewards as you win battles.
- Level up your favorite heroes to boost their stats and dominate the arena.
COMPETE AND CONNECT
- Play with friends or challenge them directly in Party Battle.
- Sync progress with iCloud, unlock 42 Game Center achievements, and compete on leaderboards.
- Enjoy smooth, precise combat at up to 120 FPS, with full controller and keyboard support.
Join the ultimate food fight today! Food Gang is free-to-play and requires an internet connection.

- You can subscribe to the VIP PASS to unlock KING, an exclusive epic fighter.

- The VIP PASS is a weekly subscription that costs $4.99. This price is for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary, and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
- Payment will be charged to the iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews at the same price unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Subscriptions can be managed by the user; auto-renewal can be turned off after purchase via the user’s iTunes account settings.
- No cancellation of the current subscription period is allowed.
- You may cancel a subscription during its free trial via your iTunes account settings. Cancellation must occur at least 24 hours before the trial ends to avoid being charged. Please visit https://support.apple.com/HT202039 for more information.

bluejetty:00073912:ios.description:
The official jakdojade.pl app for iOS - an essential application for all public transport passengers in Polish cities. Thanks to the app, you can easily check the timetable and buy a ticket. Travel easy and fun 
Jakdojade is: 
• trip planner for intercity train connections in Poland
• current public transport timetables (ZTM, MPK, MZK, SKM, PKP, …)
• the most accurate and popular search engine of public transport connections
• convenient buying of public transport tickets (available in selected cities)
• real-time feature - shows the actual location of buses and trams (available in selected cities) - the position of the vehicle on the map, the current and expected delay, and the exact time when it will arrive at the stop.
• maps of stops, connections, and routes for trams, buses, regional railways, trolleybuses, and metro
• easy and intuitive navigation
Ticket purchases are available in the largest cities in Poland! Timetables from saved stops are also available offline

bluejetty:00031926:ios.name: Runestone Text Editor
bluejetty:00031926:ios.summary:
A plain text editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers, search and replace, page guide, and much more. It's like TextEdit but more powerful and optimised for iPhone and iPad.
Runestone is made by a single person with a love for text ed
bluejetty:00031926:ios.description:
A plain text editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers, search and replace, page guide, and much more. It's like TextEdit but more powerful and optimised for iPhone and iPad.
Runestone is made by a single person with a love for text editors and a vision of building the most lightweight text editor for iPhone and iPad that still has the core features for editing code.
Features:
- Syntax highlighting of many languages including HTML, JavaScript, JSON, Markdown, Swift, Python, PHP, YAML, and many more.
- Select one of the twelve standard themes including popular themes like Tomorrow, Dracula, Solarized, and One Dark Pro.
- Innovative find and replace for searching and modifying text while still viewing your file.
- Choose font and font size, including support for custom fonts imported using another third-party app.
- Show the line and column the cursor is located on.
- Uses the standard document browser for an experience similar to the Files app.
- Quickly navigate to a specific line.
- Automatically close opening brackets and quotes.
- Multiple windows on the iPad.
- Format code using Prettier.js. Supported languages include CSS,HTML, JavaScript, JSON, PHP and more.
- Choose text encoding between popular encodings like UTF-8, UTF-16, ISO Latin 1, and many more.
- Enable or disable autocorrection, autocapitalization, and smart punctuation.
- Set default file extension of new files.
- Open files in Runestone from the Share Sheet.
- Print documents.
Premium features:
- Choose between eight app icons.
- Show line numbers.
- Highlight the selected line.
- Increase line height and letter spacing.
- Disable line wrapping to allow horizontal scrolling.
- Show tabs, spaces, and line breaks using a selected symbol.
- Enable page guide at a specific column to easily tell when lines are getting too long.
- Add vertical and horizontal overscroll.
- Remember the selected language per file.
- Save file extensions and filenames that should always be treated as plain text files.
- Enable soft tabs and choose the width of the tab character.
- Specify whether pressing the tab key should insert a tab or indent the line.
- Adjust the scaling of Markdown headings and disable highlighting of code blocks in Markdown.
Runestone was built on the open-source framework with the same name. Find more information on the Runestone framework at github.com/simonbs/runestone

bluejetty:00099567:ios.description:
Start Your Farm Adventure with Doralie on Hugisland! 
Join Doralie, the cheerful and adventurous spirit of Hugisland, as you set out on an exciting farm adventure! Explore mysterious islands, uncover hidden secrets, and build the farm of your dreams. From solving intriguing puzzles to designing stylish outfits, every moment on Hugisland is a new experience waiting to be discovered!

Farm – Grow, Harvest & Create
Plan and cultivate your farm, from sowing seeds to harvesting bountiful crops.
Raise adorable animals and craft delicious farm-fresh products.
Expand your farm creatively, turning it into a paradise of your own design.
Build – Design & Decorate Your Perfect Island
Create & arrange buildings and decorations to make your dream farm come to life.
Choose from a wide variety of furniture to decorate your home and express your imagination.
Assemble structures like building blocks, designing a space that’s both stylish and functional.
Adventure – Explore, Discover & Uncover Mysteries
Embark on thrilling expeditions with Doralie, unlocking new areas and secret treasures.
Interact with unique characters and uncover their heartwarming stories.
Solve mysteries hidden in each map and reveal the island’s ancient secrets.
Dress Up – Mix, Match & Customize Your Look
Express yourself with a variety of fashionable outfits and accessories.
Mix and match styles to create the perfect look for every occasion.
Customize Doralie’s wardrobe to showcase your unique personality.
Join Doralie & Friends on an Unforgettable Journey!
Every day on Hugisland is a new farm adventure—explore, create, and connect in a world full of wonder! Are you ready to begin your journey?

The Classic • Party Animal • Spy Codename • Superhero Name

QUICK, FUN AND EASY

bluejetty:00097570:ios.description:
An ordinary young man is reborn into the world of his favorite comic—only to find himself as a bit-part villain doomed to die. To escape his fate, he must rise as a true villain, gathering allies, defying heroes, and carving a new destiny in this dark fantasy isekai JRPG. Experience a story of survival, betrayal, and ambition where good and evil clash in a pixel-art world.
Fight strategic turn-based battles that blend classic RPG command systems with modern mechanics. Exploit enemy weaknesses, trigger chain attacks, and unleash powerful break attacks. Earn notoriety through misdeeds to rank up and unlock unique arts via a skill tree. Explore dungeons, gather resources, and develop your own evil base with a smithery, lab, smuggling, and more. Packed with pixel-art charm, immersive story, and tactical depth, this parallel world RPG is a must for fans of JRPGs, anime-style games, and fantasy adventures.
* This app contains ads in some screens. The game itself can be played in its entirety for free.
* Ads can be removed through in-app purchases by purchasing the Ad Eliminator. Please note that the Ad Eliminator of the freemium edition does not include the bonus 150 Evilstones.
* A premium edition with 150 bonus Evilstones is also available. Search for "Isekai Villain"!
(Save data cannot be transferred between the premium and freemium editions.)
* This app supports devices newer than iPhone 8 and iPad 7th with iOS 15 and up. User support on non-supported devices is not guaranteed.

bluejetty:00078989:android.description:
Embark on a spiritual journey with our FREE and easy-to-use app, featuring the soulful recitation of the Holy Quran by Sheikh Maher Al Muaiqly. This user-friendly app is designed for seamless navigation, allowing you to immerse yourself in the divine wisdom of the Quran at your convenience and without the need for an internet connection.
🌟 Key Features 🌟
✅ Offline Listening : Access the entire Quran offline. Enjoy Sheikh Maher Al Muaiqly recitations without needing an internet connection, ensuring your spiritual journey is uninterrupted. 
✅ HD Quality Audio : Enjoy the highest quality MP3 audio that brings each verse of the Quran to life with clarity and precision. 
✅ Listen and Read Simultaneously : Experience a multi-sensory engagement with the Quran. Listen to Sheikh Maher Al Muaiqly’s recitation while reading the Arabic text or translation, enhancing understanding and retention. 
✅ Advanced Search Functionality : Quickly locate specific verses or surahs with a few taps, making your Quran study more focused and efficient. 
✅ Shuffle Play : Mix up your daily Quran listening with our shuffle feature, which randomly plays different surahs, offering a refreshing way to engage with the Quran. 
✅ Background Play : Our app ensures that the recitation continues even when you use other apps or lock your screen, perfect for continuous listening without interruption. 
✅ Bookmarking & Highlights : Mark your favorite verses for easy access and highlight sections for deeper study and reflection.
Our app is designed to be straightforward and accessible for everyone, from beginners to those who regularly recite the Quran. 
Share the beauty of Sheikh Maher Al Muaiqly’s recitation with friends and family, and don't forget to rate and review us on the store. Your feedback is invaluable in helping us improve and expand our offerings.
✅Explore More on Our Developer Page : Delve deeper into the Quran with other renowned reciters like Maher Al Muaqly and Abdelbaset Abdessamad available on our developer page. Expand your recitation library and enrich your spiritual practice with diverse and revered voices.
Download now and immerse yourself in the soothing recitation of the Quran, available anytime, right at your fingertips !

bluejetty:00040803:ios.description:
Consulte, acompanhe e entenda seu processo judicial de forma prática e inteligente.
Com o Escavador, você pode consultar, acompanhar e entender informações processuais relevantes citadas em Diários Oficiais e tribunais de todo o Brasil para você, sua empresa ou seu cliente de forma rápida e organizada.
Como o app do Escavador funciona?
- Encontre informações processuais detalhadas realizando consultas por nome, número do processo, CPF ou CNPJ;
- Monitore seu processo judicial e receba notificações de atualizações diretamente no seu dispositivo, com verificações diárias.
- Visualize documentos relevantes do seu processo judicial;
- Conte com o EscavAI, seu assistente jurídico inteligente, especializado em descomplicar o juridiquês e fornecer orientação personalizada: entenda as movimentações, peça resumos inteligentes com histórico e próximos passos, e tire dúvidas sobre seu processo via chat;
- Tenha sempre a confiança de estar atualizado: o Escavador é referência nacional na estruturação de dados jurídicos, com mais de 450 milhões de processos e uma IA treinada e sempre atualizada com as últimas leis e jurisprudências brasileiras.
Quais são as fontes oficiais?
- Diários Oficiais (Imprensa Nacional): www.in.gov.br
- Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF): portal.stf.jus.br
- Tribunal de Justiça de São Paulo (TJSP): www.tjsp.jus.br
- Tribunal de Justiça do Rio de Janeiro (TJRJ): www.tjrj.jus.br
- Tribunal Regional Federal da 1ª Região (TRF1): www.trf1.jus.br
[Lista completa disponível em: ajuda.escavador.com/cobertura]
_______
[AVISO LEGAL: APLICATIVO NÃO-GOVERNAMENTAL]
Este é um aplicativo independente, NÃO OFICIAL e sem qualquer afiliação ou vínculo com entidades governamentais. O Escavador é uma ferramenta de busca que facilita o acesso a informações públicas disponibilizadas pelos órgãos oficiais listados abaixo.
Transparência e fontes confiáveis atualizadas
O Escavador obtém dados judiciais de fontes governamentais oficiais, seguindo sua Política de Privacidade para garantir segurança e transparência, mesmo não sendo afiliado a nenhuma entidade governamental. Estruturamos e republicamos de forma independente informações de processos de Diários Oficiais e tribunais de justiça, promovendo a acessibilidade e transparência das informações públicas.
O Escavador facilita o acesso e o entendimento de informações jurídicas com soluções que conectam você ao que realmente importa.
Para saber mais sobre como cuidamos dos seus dados e das nossas regras, acesse nossos Termos de Uso: https://www.escavador.com/termos-de-uso

- Quickly modify and add food to your cart

· 사과, 고구마, 양파, 계란, 바나나, 포도, 아보카도, 오렌지, 당근, 커피까지
· 키울 수 있는 작물이 계속 늘어나요.
▶ 물·비료만 주면 되는 쉬운 농사
· 매일 물과
bluejetty:00087598:ios.description:
▶ 폰으로 키운 작물, 진짜로 집까지 배송돼요
· 올팜에서 물과 비료를 주고 작물을 다 키우면, 키운 작물을 집으로 보내드려요. 배송비도 없어요.
· 매일 100만 명이 올팜에서 작물을 키우고 있어요.
▶ 농작물부터 생필품까지, 키울 작물을 골라요
· 사과, 고구마, 양파, 계란, 바나나, 포도, 아보카도, 오렌지, 당근, 커피까지
· 키울 수 있는 작물이 계속 늘어나요.
▶ 물·비료만 주면 되는 쉬운 농사
· 매일 물과 비료를 주면 작물이 쑥쑥 자라요. 어려운 규칙 없이 누구나 할 수 있어요.
▶ 친구와 같이 하면 더 빨리
· 친구와 함께 키우면 작물을 훨씬 빨리 받을 수 있어요.
▶ 누적 후기 2,000만 건 이상
· 올웨이즈 구매 후기 2,000만 건, 그중 올팜 작물 후기만 130만 건이에요.
· 실제로 받아본 분들의 생생한 후기를 확인해보세요.
▶ 100원만 사도 무료배송, 쇼핑 혜택까지
· 올웨이즈는 365일 모든 상품이 무료배송이에요.
· 매일 출석체크로 포인트를 받고, 쿠폰으로 바꿔 쓸 수 있어요.
· 쇼핑 사이사이 올툰과 숏드라마도 즐겨보세요.
▶ 올웨이즈는 꼭 필요한 권한만 요청합니다.
정보통신망 이용촉진 및 정보보호 등에 관한 법률 제 22조의 2에 따라 아래와 같은 목적으로 '앱 접근 권한'에 대한 동의를 이용자에게 받고 있습니다.
[선택 접근 권한]
· 연락처 : 연락처를 통한 팀구매 및 선물하기
· 알림 : 올웨이즈에서 전달하는 푸시 메시지 수신
· 카메라 : QR 코드, 프로필 등록에 필요
· 사진 : 구매 후기 등록 시 필요
· 위치 : 현 위치 확인 및 표시
· 신체 활동 : 만보기 서비스에서 걸음 수 측정
· 저장 : 프로필 사진 설정, 구매 후기 작성을 위해 이미지를 업로드하고자 할 때 필요
* 선택 권한은 허용하지 않아도 서비스를 이용할 수 있으나, 일부 기능 사용에 제한이 있을 수 있습니다.
▶ 올웨이즈 고객센터
· 카카오톡 : @alwayz
· 이메일 : help@ilevit.com

bluejetty:00146618:ios.description:
Powerful Wisdom, distilled in quotes. 
Wisdom is all about mastering what the best have already figured out, or as Sir Isaac Newton said "Standing on the shoulders of giants". 
Wisdom is the ultimate app for learning the big ideas, quotes and mental models from the world's greatest thinkers. With Wisdom, you'll have access to a vast library of insights and perspectives from fields such as philosophy, psychology, business & investing, science, relationships, and leadership.
In addition to browsing for quotes and mental models by category, you can also explore the ideas and works of specific authors and thinkers. Enhance your understanding of any quote by swiping up to access more information about it and its author.
But that's not all! With Wisdom, you can also create your own personalized collection of quotes and mental models, reference them, and reflect upon them whenever you need. Plus, a widget that gives you a daily dose of wisdom right on your home screen.
With its user-friendly interface and wealth of knowledge, Wisdom is the perfect companion for anyone looking to cultivate a deeper understanding of themselves and the world around them.

1. Browse quotes and mental models by topics or author
2. Save quotes you like
3. Explore collections of quotes based on topics and authors
4. Get the home screen widget, with new insights delivered to you every hour, you'll constantly be growing your knowledge and wisdom just by glancing at your phone.
Enhance your personal and intellectual growth with Wisdom - download the app now and take the step towards a lifetime of learning and self-improvement.

bluejetty:00135664:ios.description:
"Try before you buy" - Download the FREE App, which includes sample content. In-App purchase required to unlock all content.
Ten chapters of NGN style questions with the NCSBN Clinical Judgment Measurement Model (NCJMM) included throughout with case scenarios that integrate the six clinical judgment cognitive skills. Plus in-depth rationales include both correct and incorrect answers and NGN tip boxes highlight important nursing concepts for exam success.
Master NGN test-taking skills and prepare for the Next Generation NCLEX® exam! Strategies for Student Success on the Next Generation NCLEX® (NGN) Test Items includes stand-alone and unfolding case studies and the new item types that appear on the NGN, helping you develop the clinical judgment skills emphasized on the exam. To enhance your learning, each practice test item includes a detailed test-taking strategy and rationales for both correct and incorrect answers. Case studies let you strengthen key cognitive skills, and additional questions are provided. Written by NCLEX experts Linda Anne Silvestri, Angela E. Silvestri, and Donna D. Ignatavicius, this NCLEX preparation resource ensures that you are NGN exam-ready!
Key Features
- Next Generation NCLEX®–style practice questions of all types are illustrated through stand-alone case studies and unfolding case studies directed toward each of the six cognitive skills.
- Detailed test-taking strategy for each question provides clues for analyzing and uncovering the correct answer option.
- NCSBN Clinical Judgment Measurement Model (NCJMM) is included throughout with case scenarios that integrate the six clinical judgment cognitive skills.
- In-depth rationales include both correct and incorrect answers.
- NGN Tip boxes highlight the most important nursing concepts needed for exam success.
- Mobile app allows you to interactively engage with each question from the book plus additional questions.

bluejetty:00119466:ios.summary:
Capture punch list items, markup drawings, log daily reports, view the latest sheets, and review 3D models from the jobsite with the Forma mobile construction app.
The Forma mobile app puts the tools and project information you rely on in
bluejetty:00119466:ios.description:
Capture punch list items, markup drawings, log daily reports, view the latest sheets, and review 3D models from the jobsite with the Forma mobile construction app.
The Forma mobile app puts the tools and project information you rely on in your hands. Stay connected to your crews on site, manage projects, and keep work moving.
Make critical decisions faster with the Forma mobile construction app:
• Forma Build Essentials for efficient, focused field execution
• Forma Build for connecting field execution and project management
Forma Build Essentials:
Built for lean crews and growing jobs. Projects are quick to set up, easy to access, and designed for everyday work on site.
• Capture punch list items and issues from the field
• Complete daily reports, logs, and forms
• View current construction sheets, drawings, files, and models
• Open project files and documentation
Latest sheets, files, and models
View and mark up sheets directly from the jobsite. Access project files and review 3D models to understand design intent and context. Confirm the latest versions before work begins.
• View and mark up drawings
• Open project files, sheets, and construction documents
• Review 3D models
Punch list and issue tracking
Capture punch list items and issues as you walk the jobsite. Track quality concerns. Log safety observations, near misses, and good catches. Assign responsibility and track work from open to closed.
• Log issues with photos, locations, and references
• Assign owners and due dates
• Track progress from open to closed
Daily reports, checklists, and forms
Capture daily activity and site conditions, complete quality or safety inspections, and attach photos, signatures, and supporting files.
• Complete daily reports and logs
• Record site conditions and project information
• Attach photos and signatures
Fast mobile workflows
Open a project and jump straight into work.
• Access sheets, issues, forms, photos, and models quickly
• Use shortcuts for common field actions
• Keep project information accessible as connectivity changes
Forma Build:
With Forma Build, bring the office and field together to keep projects aligned and on track with connected project management workflows.
• Includes core field capabilities
• Review project schedules and work plans
• Manage RFIs and track responses
• Access approved submittals
• Capture meeting notes and manage correspondence
• Track project assets
• Manage document and package reviews
Connected across Forma:
The Forma mobile app connects you to your Forma project information, construction documents, files, and 3D models across Forma Build Essentials, Forma Build, PlanGrid, Forma Design Collaboration, and Forma Data Management, while providing access to files created in Autodesk tools like Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD.
See what our customers have to say:
"The ability to access 3D models from the field eliminates confusion and allows us to come to a real-time resolution for any issues onsite. This capability reduces risk and provides cost and time savings while ensuring we deliver high-quality projects to our clients."
Briana Mitchell, Project Manager, Boldt Company
"We have about 460 field employees and for them to access documents in real-time directly on their iPhone or their iPad is priceless."
Ken Mabe, Director of Field Operations, Eckardt Group

bluejetty:00045122:ios.name: Walkingspree
bluejetty:00045122:ios.summary:
Walkingspree: Making Workplace Wellbeing Engaging, Rewarding, and Fun
Walkingspree partners with employers, health plans, and sponsoring organizations to help members build healthier habits through activity, wellbeing, and rewards programs
bluejetty:00045122:ios.description:
Walkingspree: Making Workplace Wellbeing Engaging, Rewarding, and Fun
Walkingspree partners with employers, health plans, and sponsoring organizations to help members build healthier habits through activity, wellbeing, and rewards programs designed to increase participation and long-term engagement.
Important: Walkingspree is available exclusively through participating employers, health plans, and sponsoring organizations. Individuals cannot register for or use the app independently without access provided by their organization.
Whether you're taking your first steps toward better health, participating in a team challenge, or working toward personal wellness goals, Walkingspree helps make wellbeing motivating, social, and rewarding.
Features
Activity Tracking & Goal Setting
- Set personal goals and track your progress over time. 
- View detailed activity statistics by day, week, month, quarter, year, or custom date ranges. 
- Stay motivated by monitoring your achievements and milestones. 
Connect Your Favorite Devices
Walkingspree integrates with many leading health and activity platforms, including:
- Apple Health 
- Fitbit 
- Garmin 
- Google Fit 
- Samsung Health 
- Other supported wearable devices and tracking platforms 
Challenges That Drive Engagement
- Participate in individual and team-based challenges. 
- Compete with coworkers through leaderboards and friendly competition. 
- Celebrate achievements with badges and recognition.
Points, Rewards & Incentives
Many employer-sponsored programs include points and rewards designed to recognize healthy behaviors and encourage ongoing participation.
Social Features
- Connect with coworkers and friends. 
- Encourage one another throughout challenges and activities. 
- Foster a culture of wellbeing within your organization.
Wellbeing Resources
Depending on your organization's program, members may have access to additional well-being experiences and educational resources designed to support physical, emotional, and overall wellbeing.
Multi-Language Support
Walkingspree is designed to support diverse workforces and offers multiple language options to help members engage in the language they prefer.
Notifications & Updates
Receive reminders, challenge updates, progress notifications, and important program communications directly within the app.
Member Support
Access support resources to help with device connections, program questions, and technical assistance.
Getting Started
If your employer, health plan, or sponsoring organization offers Walkingspree, simply download the app and sign in using the credentials provided by your program administrator.
If you're unsure whether your organization participates, please contact your HR team, benefits administrator, or program coordinator.
Need assistance?
support@walkingspree.com
Interested in bringing Walkingspree to your organization?
www.walkingspree.com
sales@walkingspree.com

bluejetty:00093573:ios.name: GO West Covina
bluejetty:00093573:ios.summary: GO West Covina is your go-to app for getting around West Covina. Just download the app, create an account, and tell us where you want to go. We’ll tell you the best way to get there whether it be a GO West Covina shuttle ride or a bus trip.
bluejetty:00093573:ios.description:
GO West Covina is your go-to app for getting around West Covina. Just download the app, create an account, and tell us where you want to go. We’ll tell you the best way to get there whether it be a GO West Covina shuttle ride or a bus trip.
How it works:
-Enter your pickup and dropoff locations and we’ll tell you the best journey available at that time. 
-Book GO West Covina rides directly in the app for you and any additional passengers
-Never miss your ride with live arrival times for your bus and ride tracking for your on demand journey.
-If you’re riding on demand, there may be others on board, or you may make a few additional stops along the way! 
What we’re about:
- SHARED: Our algorithm helps you see the best public transit journey available at that time. In the GO West Covina service, you’ll be matched with others headed in the same direction. This combines convenience and comfort with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a shared ride. Transit at its best.
- ACCESSIBLE: The app allows you to travel with a support person or be matched with a vehicle that meets your mobility needs. 
- SUSTAINABLE: Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make West Covina a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00184953:ios.summary:
Form as many words from the given set of jumbled letters in each round. Your score is carried forward until you are unable to form the longest word within a round. 
Simple controls and a host of features make Pow-Word a very addictive game
bluejetty:00184953:ios.description:
Form as many words from the given set of jumbled letters in each round. Your score is carried forward until you are unable to form the longest word within a round. 
Simple controls and a host of features make Pow-Word a very addictive game and a great way to improve your vocabulary.
Additional Features:
- Choose between 6 and 7 letter difficulty modes
- Separate "Mixed" mode that combines 6 and 7 letter rounds
- Choice of two dictionaries - the Students dictionary with standard English words and a more comprehensive Teachers dictionary based on the SOWPODS list 
- Option of an unlimited time mode
- Separate leaderboards for all modes for you to compare scores with players worldwide
- Lookup word meanings at the end of each round

bluejetty:00131632:ios.name: CHANI: Your Astrology Guide
bluejetty:00131632:ios.summary: CHANI is the #1 astrology app made by real astrologers — not AI. Designed to make astrology accessible and useful, it combines ancient astro wisdom with mindfulness tools to help you unlock your full potential, tap into your personal power,
bluejetty:00131632:ios.description:
CHANI is the #1 astrology app made by real astrologers — not AI. Designed to make astrology accessible and useful, it combines ancient astro wisdom with mindfulness tools to help you unlock your full potential, tap into your personal power, and live out your life’s purpose. With CHANI, you can…
GROUND INTO EACH DAY:
- Understand how the day’s astrology will land for you and get tips on how to work with it with daily horoscopes.
- Center yourself with a guided meditation highlighted to support the day’s astrological energy.
- Create lunar magic with real-time readings that update with the Moon's movements.
PREP FOR WHAT’S NEXT:
- Check the astroweather forecast and tune in to the Astrology of the Week Ahead podcast for a breakdown of how the upcoming astro is showing up in the collective and on the world stage.
- Listen to your weekly reading for a deeper, personalized look at how each week’s events will manifest in your life, and advice on how to make the most of them.
- Work with the astro as it unfolds with weekly rituals, tarot cards, personalized journal prompts, and audio offerings curated to help you meet the moment — from New Moons and Full Moons to retrogrades, eclipses, and more.
EXPLORE THE BLUEPRINT OF YOUR PURPOSE:
- Uncover each planet and point’s position in your birth chart and learn how their positions and relationships play a role in your life. Then dig into your detailed astro insights and discover the gifts and challenges that your natal placements bring to the table.
TRACK THE LESSONS OF YOUR TRANSITS:
- Keep tabs on what sign each planet is currently in, whether or not it’s retrograde, and what all of that means for you personally with timely planetary horoscopes.
- Access the wisdom that expert astrologers draw on (aka hyper-personalized transit readings) to learn how the planets are interacting with your unique birth chart at this exact moment.
RESET YOUR NERVOUS SYSTEM + MANIFEST ABUNDANCE:
- Browse our full library of guided meditations, affirmations, frequencies, and sleep stories to ground, decompress, dream, and access your inner wisdom.
GROW THROUGH WHAT YOU GO THROUGH:
- Overcome obstacles, transform your life, and reconnect with yourself through CHANI courses like the 7-part Saturn Return course and the viral 28-day Breakthrough course.
FIND OUT WHAT THE FUTURE HOLDS:
- Look ahead and unpack your year with personalized month-by-month readings, a zoomed-out astro overview, annual horoscopes for the four main areas of your life, and a collection of rituals, journal prompts, altar suggestions, and guided meditations dedicated to each of the year’s main themes.
ADD (AND READ) YOUR FRIENDS’ CHARTS:
- Access unlimited charts and save up to 100 for easy reference.
- Get to know your besties on another level with in-depth insights into their natal placements and their chart’s gifts and challenges.
- Toggle between chart and table view for an at-a-glance astro overview.
- Refresh your Astro 101 knowledge with interactive chart elements.
WHO WE ARE:
CHANI is a queer, feminist-led company that is anti-AI and not VC-funded. We’re on a mission to make astrology accessible and to support everyone in living their purpose — because we believe that astrology is a tool that can help transform us and our world for the better. We also believe that good business prioritizes personal wellbeing and promotes economic justice. No one on our team is paid less than $80K before benefits, and we offer a four-day workweek; fully covered health, dental, and vision insurance; unlimited menstrual leave; and more. In addition, 5% of all our company’s revenue is disbursed directly to survivors of gender-based violence via freefrom.org, and we’ve generated over $3.5 million for survivors to date. By choosing CHANI, you are investing in human talent, environmentally conscious technology, mutual aid, and mindful community.

Sonali e-Wallet is the mobile wallet apps of Sonali Bank Limited, the largest state owned commercial bank of Bangladesh.
Sonali Bank Limited is working alongside with the government to implement the agenda of Digital Bangla
bluejetty:00043936:ios.description:
Sonali e-Wallet
Sonali e-Wallet is the mobile wallet apps of Sonali Bank Limited, the largest state owned commercial bank of Bangladesh.
Sonali Bank Limited is working alongside with the government to implement the agenda of Digital Bangladesh by introducing various automation initiatives. These initiatives enable us to ensure operational excellence as well as meet customer expectations by providing better services. As part of our digital transformation program, we have recently developed a dynamic and secure wallet apps that cater your daily transaction needs like Fund Transfer, Mobile Airtime Recharge and Bill Payments etc.
You will get notifications on your latest activity; see your transaction history, transaction summary etc. Sonali e-Wallet is bring very exciting and innovative services in the market to meet customer needs and demands.
• Both Bangla and English Supported
• Sonali e-Wallet is a secured app. The App requires your PIN number in two phases. First for login and second, for every transaction you need to provide PIN number. For transaction purpose you also need OTP along with the PIN number.
• You can add your Wallet Account name and change your Profile picture.
• Add Money from your Bank Account to Wallet Account and vice versa
• Send Money to other Wallet or Account 
• Fund Transfer through BEFTN
• Recharge mobile or pay postpaid mobile bills for the mobile network operators below:
o Robi
o Airtel
o Teletalk
o Grameenphone
o Banglalink
• Payment of utility bill through the wallet apps is also available.
• Credit card Statement and bill payment for Sonali Bank Limited Credit Card user.
• Checking your Wallet and Account balance is very easy through a single tap on the screen
• Receive notifications for your latest transactions.

Your journey as
bluejetty:00016187:ios.description:
Ready to rule over the skies?
Are you a trainee pilot ready for a thrilling adventure in the skies? Start your journey today as a new pilot in this awesome airplane game that's been downloaded by over 100 Million players.
Your journey as a new pilot begins by choosing a plane of your choice in an airport Hangar. Don’t forget to inspect your airplane, test the controls, and make sure those engines are ready for a smooth takeoff!
It’s time for an epic takeoff! Show the world who’s the smartest, fastest, and toughest pilot around! Hurry Up Pilot! The passengers are waiting for you!.
Modes for Every Mood! 
- Classic Mode
City Explorer: Fly short routes between nearby cities with passengers
Time Challenge: Complete missions with strict time limits.
Global Adventure: Take long international flights & discover different places.
- Racing Mode
Checkpoint Dash: Fly through checkpoints in the sky to test your speed.
Aerobatic Challenge: Navigate through challenging obstacles showcasing your piloting skills
Mountain Rally: Race through rugged mountain terrains, tight turns & avoiding obstacles
-Simulation Mode 
Altitude Challenge: Navigate through high-altitude zones, & deal with air turbulence
Emergency Landing Drill: Handle emergencies and practice crash landings in tough situations
Rescue Pilot: Switch to a helicopter for water rescues, respond to distress calls to save lives
- War Mode
Ariel Battle: Engage in aerial combat, outsmart and defeat your enemy aircraft.
Ground Attack: Conduct airstrikes on ground targets, and provide support to your ground forces.
Naval Strike: Control naval aircraft, launching missiles to destroy enemy ships at sea.
Undercover Mission: Execute covert operations, sneaking past enemy defenses to deliver strikes.
Pick Your favorite flying machine! 
- Fly Mini Cessna for scenic exploration
- Perform cool tricks with precise flying with Pro ARF
- Race with Sierra P2020 for Speed & fun
- Perform tricks & stunts with Pitts 1400mm
- Annoy the hell out of your enemies with F16 Falcons
- Pretend to be a real pilot on the big Boeing 747.
- Experience realistic helicopter flying in Bell UH-1
Cool Features for Maximum Fun!
- Up to 100 Progressive levels
- Daily rewards: Play every day to earn free prizes
- Advanced flight physics experience
- Air control Support to crush your enemies!
- 360-degree movements in war mode
- Multiple control options – tilt your device or use a stick
- Fly in various weather conditions for an extra challenge
Tips for the Perfect Flying Experience!
- Learn the plane’s controls
- Understand & follow the signs on the runway
- Keep the plane straight when moving on the ground
- Lift-off at the right speed
- Follow all the checkpoints

bluejetty:00060585:android.summary: Are you crazy enough to drive a Tuk Tuk auto rickshaw during your off days? Then Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw Driving Game provides you this chance at your fingertips. It can be exuberant for you to provide pick and drop services for your dear one
bluejetty:00060585:android.description:
Are you crazy enough to drive a Tuk Tuk auto rickshaw during your off days? Then Tuk Tuk Auto Rickshaw Driving Game provides you this chance at your fingertips. It can be exuberant for you to provide pick and drop services for your dear ones in our Tuk Tuk. Auto Rickshaw driving can bring fun part in your life by driving through big city. Picking and dropping the passengers and giving them pleasure of best auto rickshaw transport facility can fulfil your desire of becoming best tuk tuk auto rickshaw driver in the town. Going through the heavy traffic in the city in this auto rickshaw and giving pleasurable ride to the passengers can be a challenging task for you. 
Uniqueness and creativity are among the special characteristics of tuk tuk auto rickshaw driving game. You have to pick more than one passengers from one stop and drop them at different destinations. You will not find this feature in any other tuk tuk games. It will give you real taste of public transport services. You must have heard about fast racing cars, crazy taxis but this tuk tuk will make you drive as fast as you can. 
Following are the key features of tuk tuk auto rickshaw driving game:
- Tuk Tuk auto rickshaw provides the best pick and drop facility to the passengers.
- It picks multiple passengers from one destination and drops them at different destinations.
- As a driver limited time will be given to complete this pick and drop mission.
- In start of the game only one level will be unlocked, then you must have to complete previous levels to move to the next level.
- You must have to play same level again if you do not complete task within allocated time.

bluejetty:00126608:ios.name: Cheap flights – WayAway
bluejetty:00126608:ios.summary:
Search for cheap airline tickets
- We analyze air tickets - we compare prices and layover options, finding the cheapest air tickets and the most convenient flight options (direct or with a comfortable layover).
- Searching for air tickets
bluejetty:00126608:ios.description:
Search for cheap airline tickets
- We analyze air tickets - we compare prices and layover options, finding the cheapest air tickets and the most convenient flight options (direct or with a comfortable layover).
- Searching for air tickets doesn't take much time - we filter and sort all the options for you. And you can buy cheap air tickets. How do you like the idea?
- You can subscribe to notifications about the cheapest air ticket, the most convenient one or the most direct flight (yes, this is possible as well). This way you can keep track of changes in the cost of plane tickets. As soon as the price changes, we will send you a notification.
- But these are not all of the subscriptions! You can also subscribe to the search for air tickets from your city and catch cheap tickets for a plane that flies in the most unexpected direction. What a surprise!
- We also have a "Price Schedule" - it helps you buy a cheap ticket if you are not tied to the departure date.
- And the "Price Map" - in case you have not yet decided on your destination. The map shows both domestic and international flights.
- We save the passengers' passport information so that next time booking a flight won't take much time.
- It's so comfortable to plan weekend trips with us, to fly on Saturday morning and to go back on Sunday evening.
- And maybe you want to see around during the stopover - we will tell you which option is the most convenient if you want to see another city during the trip (also this type of air tickets is cheaper).
- Our developers made app filters for any occasion, including for tickets with luggage and filtering for aircraft models.
- If you don't want to search for flights on exact dates, you can choose one or several months and we will find plane tickets in a given range.
By the way, it's not only plane tickets search. We can also search for:
- Accommodation with recommendations according to your interests: business trip, family, romantic, good for instagram and so on.
- Guided and self-guided tours.
- Cars and transfers to get from the airport to the hotel. And wherever else you want to go
Download the WayAway app now to start traveling and buy tickets.
*** The application from WayAway.com allows you to find the lowest possible cost of an air ticket. We do not sell anything, we help you find flights online with the best conditions.

Whether you are at work, travelling abroad, or enjoying social gatherings with international friends, Voice Translate & Translator helps you translate and communicate effortlessly between multiple languages.
Key Features:
1. Text Translation: Simply enter text to receive high-quality translations instantly.
2. Photo Translation: Instantly translate through your camera or select photos from your gallery. Menus, books, signs - just snap a photo and translate!
3. Real-Time Voice Translation: Experience seamless communication with instant translation of conversations.
4. Simultaneous Interpretation: Translate as you speak.

This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial or the current subscription period to avoid charges. After cancellation, you will continue to have access until your current period ends, then switch to the free version.
*Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends, and the cost of the renewal will be confirmed.

Privacy Policy:
