bluejetty:00062245:ios.name: Skiing Games for Kids
bluejetty:00062245:ios.summary: Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading,
bluejetty:00062245:ios.description:
Our diverse collection of games keeps kids engaged and motivates them to learn more! We've developed an extensive curriculum that covers number sense and math tasks, tracing letters and numbers, writing words, phonics, interactive reading, and more. Curated by experts, the content fosters curiosity, creativity, and confidence in young learners, assisting them as they grow. 
SKIDOS PASS: ALL IN ONE
With the SKIDOS Pass, children explore a safe and age-appropriate space with 1000+ fun and engaging activities, gaining life skills and receiving positive reinforcement for academic success. Parents can create up to 6 personalized profiles for their kids. and customize each according to age, gameplay preferences, and subjects to learn. Monitoring kids' progress is easy - learning reports in the app or via email give you a simple overview of their growth and challenges.
GAMEPLAY:
SNOW RACE
Snow Race is a new and exciting winter trial game loved by players around the world. It’s time for action!
Unlock awesome skier and snowboard characters. Race in fun and challenging single player levels or defeat your opponents in multiplayer mode!
FEATURES:
• Collect 10+ free snowboarders and skiers
• Do insane tricks
• Learn challenging downhill trial tracks
LEARNING CURRICULUM
Our curriculum mixes engaging games with learning content, improving your child's learning skills and promoting active play.
MATH: Our math exercises cover a comprehensive list of topics, including number sense, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, geometry, and more. Tasks evolve as your child progresses. Interactive design and animations help support learning - three cute SKIDOS mascots will offer assistance, encouraging kids while they work on the assignments.
TRACING LETTERS & NUMBERS: You can pick tracing letters and numbers for your child to practice. A ladybird will show your little learner how to trace with their finger, while visuals and voiceovers teach new words and counting.
READING: Children will be introduced to the world of phonics, sounds, letters, and reading. Interactive designs and smart prompts help kids make their first confident steps toward reading, while storytelling with songs keeps them engaged and curious about new learning journeys.
EMOTIONAL WELLBEING: Through engaging activities, kids learn to understand and express their emotions and nurture positive attitudes.
EDUCATIONAL VIDEOS: Our video content piques kids' curiosity in a fun and easy way. We've curated just the right mix of entertainment & learning in our video catalogue.
SAFE & AD-FREE
SKIDOS ensures an ad-free online environment, providing kids with a positive and uninterrupted learning experience. Our apps are COPPA & GDPR-compliant.
ABOUT THE SKIDOS PASS SUBSCRIPTION:
- We offer monthly, quarterly, bi-annual and annual auto-renewable subscriptions
- Every subscription starts with a 3-day Free Trial
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account only after a free trial period, wherever applicable
- Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing cycle
- The user may turn off the subscription auto-renewal in the user's device Account Settings
- Cancellation goes into effect at the end of the current billing cycle
- Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a SKIDOS pass, where applicable
Privacy Policy: http://skidos.com/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://skidos.com/terms/
Support: support@skidos.com

bluejetty:00022367:ios.description:
Meet Geeni. Your wish is Geeni's command. 
Control all Geeni smart home and smart health devices in one easy app, from ANYWHERE in the world. Geeni is easy enough for anyone to use and combines the SIMPLICITY of an on/off switch with PREMIUM features such as: 
- Easy, powerful control of each device. Choose a color or mood of our Color bulbs, schedule a smart switch, check in on your cameras, and track your weight, all from the same app!
- Group devices and control by room
- Smart Health products support tracking weight, BMI, Body fat percentage, basal metabolic rate, bone mass, visceral fat grade, and more, and track on the app or sync to Apple Health
- Set smart scenes for automated actions
- Schedule when devices turn on and off to allow more control and security
- Choose which devices your friends, guests, roommates, or your family can control thanks to account sharing
- Cloud based services so you can log in and control your home from any phone
- HealthKit functionality for our new Smart Scale: synchronize your health data with Apple Health!
- and more. 
Compatible with all Geeni-enabled smart devices. No complicated hub required; each Geeni device is smart enough to connect directly to your home wifi network.

bluejetty:00186603:ios.description:
Guide to Clinical Midwifery is a must-have resource for midwives, women’s health nurse practitioners, and all levels of healthcare providers working in the women’s health field. Organized alphabetically for easy reference, it features important concepts, diagnostic tools, algorithms, and management options, including conventional, lifestyle, and complementary therapies, all in one place.
This edition offers current evidence based references, the latest medication recommendations, and midwifery practice pearls. Also provided are recent changes to practice, such as FHR monitoring, hypertensive guidelines, contraception updates, prenatal care, LGBTQIA+ support, precepting, sexual health, and evidence-based practice.
The mobile app contains all of the content of A Pocket Guide to Clinical Midwifery: The Efficient Midwife, Second Edition as well as exclusive content, calculators, and more!

bluejetty:00126719:ios.description:
Mileage tracking app records your miles automatically for taxes, reimbursement and personal productivity. If you're a business owner, self-employed contractor or employee, this simple trip tracking app is designed perfectly for you. Save time with mileage tracker and get tax deduction or reimbursement easier.
Automatic trip tracking
• Just enable GPS on your phone to have all your trips tracked automatically.
• Tracking on the go without opening the app.
• The address of start and end points are logged, as well as all stops throughout each trip.
Accurate mileage logging
• Mileage app tracks each mile, duration, date and time.
• Value of your drives for taxes or reimbursements is calculated automatically.
• Sort and categorize trips to keep business rides separate from personal.
Other features:
• Use predefined categories: unclassified, business and personal.
• Create your own categories of rides.
• Move trips to categories with one swipe classification.
• View your trip on the map, including path, start and end points.
• Add business expanses like parking and toll fees.
• Sort tracked trips by day, week, month, etc.
• Add notes to your business rides.
• Change cars in the app.
• Delete unnecessary trips.
• Enjoy light and dark themes.
• Get push notifications when tracking starts and ends.
More features are coming soon for your tax deductions and reimbursements to increase your productivity.
Mileage Tracker is free for your business automation. Get started with a free plan, then upgrade to Pro account for unlimited tracking and additional customizable categories.
Terms of use: https://saldoapps.com/mileage-tracker-terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://saldoapps.com/mileage-tracker-privacy-policy

For optimal Wi-Fi at home, you need two Wi-Fi extenders. One that is connected to the modem and one near a spot i
bluejetty:00102652:android.description:
With the Thuis app, you can connect SuperWifi and Experia Wifi in a few simple steps. This ensures better Wi-Fi in your home.
For optimal Wi-Fi at home, you need two Wi-Fi extenders. One that is connected to the modem and one near a spot in your home where you currently have poor Wi-Fi.
No idea how to connect it? Don't worry, we'll explain that step by step in the app!
Do you have an Experia Box v10A, SuperWifi or Experia Wifi? Then you can:
- Change Wi-Fi settings
- Create a guest network
- Share Wi-Fi login via a QR code
- See which devices are / were connected to your (guest) network
- View details of the connected devices
- Switch LEDs on or off on the Experia Wifi
- Dim the LED on the SuperWifi disc
Do you have an Experia Box v8, v9 or v10? Then you can:
- Change Wi-Fi settings
- Share Wi-Fi login via a QR code
Do you have a kpn Box 12? Then you will find instructions in the app to:
- Install the Experia Box
- Install interactive TV
- Install a Wi-Fi extender
- Test your Wi-Fi via the Wifi manager
Want to know more about how to get the most out of your internet? Visit kpn.com/wifi for even more tips and tricks.

bluejetty:00128071:ios.description:
Enter the world of That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime in a new 3D battle RPG!
A new story supervised by Fuse, author of the original light novels! A mysterious girl named Shinsha appears, claiming to be Rimuru's daughter. What is her relation to Izis, the witch from the "mirror land"?
Relive famous moments from Season 1 of the anime in fully voiced cut scenes!
The star-studded vocal cast lend their talents to battle voices and interactions in town as well!
Use the nation-building system to create your ideal version of Tempest!
Build and position all sorts of buildings and facilities: your citizens' homes, restaurants, the blacksmith shop, the laboratory, magic-enhancing facilities, and more.
Walk through the town you've built and interact with your citizens to get a glimpse of their daily lives!
3D command-based battle system!
The controls are simple: just select the cards for your hand. But there's deep strategic gameplay to enjoy as you learn to effectively use abilities drawn from the original work! Enjoy dazzling finishing move animations that will make you feel like you've stepped into the anime!

bluejetty:00066058:ios.description:
Featuring your favorite heroes & villains from the Badland world. Survive epic quests in an unforgiving world & forge Alliances to survive and conquer the Badlands.
Featuring a never-before-seen, isometric, one vs. many free-flow combat experience that’s easy to play but hard to master.
COLLECT & RECRUIT SURVIVORS IN THE BADLANDS
Experience the life of Badlands survivor. Defy the odds and defeat Barons to gain their strength, each with their own specialized battle strategy.
UPGRADE YOUR FIGHTERS AND ROSTER
• Level up and customize your fighters to enhance their fighting strategies, weapons, and skills

Play & slay in the Pit, Quinn’s Fort, the Widow’s Lodge, Wall Street, the Dollhouse and other key locations. Search the lands for chests and unlock new characters via scouting.
DOWNLOAD NOW FOR FREE!

内置钢琴节拍器、吉他调音器、识谱专项训练、吉他和弦图库等工具，无需额外下载软件。
优质曲谱持续上新，精品教学视频随行
平台汇聚专业制谱达人，每日更新优质乐谱，人工审核校对，曲谱质量高。更有名家公开课、原创教学视频，跟着专业老师系统学琴，轻松进阶乐器达人。
更多实用功能
AI 自动翻谱，曲谱标注，识谱练习，听音练习，常用和弦，曲谱伴奏，吉他调音器等众多实用功能，弹琴找谱，练琴入门一个 App 全搞定。
为什么一定要选择弹琴吧？
技术先行，AI赋能全品类练琴
弹琴吧是移动互联网动态光标智能乐谱的先行者——2011年推出《钢琴谱大全》，率先把动态光标带入手机练琴场景。依托千万级用户真实练琴数据自研AI引擎，覆盖曲谱AI播放、智能指法标注、AI声音识别、AI陪练（分乐句/分手/节奏评价）、AI自动翻谱等功能，算法持续迭代，让练琴更科学。
团队双栖，专业与科技深度融合
弹琴吧教研与技术团队由一线互联网公司技术骨干、专业音乐学院背景人才共同组成——既有工程能力保障软件稳定，又有音乐专业把关曲谱。平台汇聚大量制谱达人长期入驻，上传曲谱经人工审核，谱面精准、排版美观，覆盖钢琴、吉他、尤克里里、电子琴、小提琴等全品类，满足从零基础到演奏级的全部需求。
品牌沉淀，千万琴友的共同选择
弹琴吧深耕乐器领域十余年，累计下载破亿，千万琴友活跃社区，收录超百万首曲谱。从单一钢琴社区成长为覆盖PC官网、Pad/手机App的综合练琴平台，并拓展至吉他、尤克里里、电子琴、小提琴多品类——不做“大而泛”的通用工具，只专注“练琴”这一件事。AI 陪练，AI 翻谱、曲谱移调、黑键标注、跟弹练琴、和弦谱工具……每一次更新都来自真实用户反馈，贴合你的练琴节奏。

bluejetty:00170457:ios.description:
Do you want to be a barbie, princess or a fashion star? Welcome to Girls Decoration World Simulator. In this town, a new shopping mall and a Yoyo monster high fashion show for girls is open now! Do you covet the shining nikki in this yoyo monster high fashion show? You can diy fashion clothes to dress up as a princess, have a beauty salon and barbie makeover and meet your Mr.Right. This town has popular stores all around the world such as princess clothing shops, grocery stores, furniture stores, salon stores, and more for shining nikki girls. Anything you imagine you can find here! Quickly grab your shopping bags and buy everything on your shopping list!
Features:
- You can try to drag or click anything you see to discover the hidden surprises in the town!
- Unleash your creativity and customize unique characters based on your preferences.
- High degree of freedom! No rules or restrictions in this world simulator!
- 500+ items to play and diy. The game offers thousands of possibilities for girls! - To be the best beauty in the yoyo monster high fashion show! 
How to play:
- Choose different princess hairstyles, hair colors, skin tones, facial features, and various clothing and accessories for your character.
- Dress up your favorite diy clothes and accessories at the clothing store and show off your fashion makeover skills.
- The grocery store offers many snacks, beauty salon tools, and makeover items. You can purchase household items you need.
- Just choose different styles of furniture at the furniture store to decorate your apartment! Oh Barbie style must suit you.
Come to this World Simulator now to dress up! shining nikki!
Subscription pricing and terms:
This app offers an auto-renewing week subscription at $2.99/week to provide unlimited access and other premium features.
Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Your use of this application is governed by the Terms of Service available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00115016:ios.name: Lumber Valley: Idle Chopping
bluejetty:00115016:ios.summary: Welcome to Lumbora Valley, a land of endless trees, peaceful forests, and the dream of building your very own lumber empire. Here, every swing of the axe matters. In this idle wood-cutting simulator, you will step into the shoes of a hardwo
bluejetty:00115016:ios.description:
Welcome to Lumbora Valley, a land of endless trees, peaceful forests, and the dream of building your very own lumber empire. Here, every swing of the axe matters. In this idle wood-cutting simulator, you will step into the shoes of a hardworking lumberjack, tasked with harvesting trees, unlocking new lands, and turning a small patch of forest into a bustling valley of progress. The journey starts simple: grab your axe, chop down a few trees, and collect the wood. But
soon, you’ll unlock powerful upgrades, hire helpers, and automate your lumber operations so the valley continues to grow even while you’re away. This is more than just chopping wood — it’s about strategy, planning, and creating a smooth system that transforms raw timber into a
thriving business.
Why You’ll Love Lumbora Valley: Idle Chopping
Relaxing Idle Gameplay – Perfect for casual play. Whether you have a few minutes or a whole
hour, progress continues in the background.
Chop & Collect – Gather wood, clear trees, and watch the resources pile up.
Expand Your Valley – Unlock new areas, discover hidden parts of the forest, and grow your
empire.
Upgrade & Build – Improve your tools, sawmills, and workers for faster progress.
Idle Tycoon Progression – Automate the process and enjoy watching your profits climb.
Satisfying & Relaxing – Designed to be fun, stress-free, and rewarding at every step.
As your lumber business grows, you’ll discover the joy of expanding into new territories,
balancing upgrades with strategy, and finding the perfect rhythm between chopping, collecting,
and investing. Unlike other games that demand constant attention, Lumbora Valley: Idle Chopping is designed to fit your lifestyle. Progress continues whether you are playing actively or letting the game run in the background.
Relax, chop, and build your dream lumber empire at your own pace. Enter the world of Lumbora
Valley: Idle Chopping and let the forest adventure begin today

bluejetty:00063054:ios.name: Bridge Card Game Classic
bluejetty:00063054:ios.summary:
Classic bridge. Simple, clean, free.
Sit down and play contract bridge anytime with a smart AI partner against two clever AI opponents. Play at your own pace, in the bidding system you know. And when you feel like competing, try our new Da
bluejetty:00063054:ios.description:
Classic bridge. Simple, clean, free.
Sit down and play contract bridge anytime with a smart AI partner against two clever AI opponents. Play at your own pace, in the bidding system you know. And when you feel like competing, try our new Daily Tournaments.
PLAY YOUR WAY
- Unlimited free bridge against the AI, as many hands as you like
- Four bidding systems: SAYC, 2/1 Game Force, Standard American and Basic ACOL
- Your AI partner and opponents bid the system you choose
- Easy, medium and hard AI levels, from relaxed to challenging
- Rubber Bridge and Chicago Bridge with real scoring, kept for you automatically
- Fair, truly random deals from a cryptographic shuffle. No stacked hands, no favored seats
- Clean, uncluttered design for iPhone and iPad
BID THE SYSTEM YOU PLAY AT THE CLUB
SAYC: Standard American Yellow Card, 5-card majors
2/1 Game Force: a new suit at the 2 level forces to game
American Basic: classic Standard American, the kitchen-table favorite
Basic ACOL: the British standard, 4-card majors and a weak notrump
Switch systems anytime in Settings.
CLASSIC FORMATS
Rubber Bridge: best of three games. The first partnership to score 100 or more points in successful contracts wins a game.
Chicago Bridge: four deals with set vulnerability. The highest score wins. Perfect for a quick session.
NEW: DAILY TOURNAMENTS
Want to see how you stack up? Play the same 8 deals as every other player that day and see where you rank. Duplicate-style bridge scored by matchpoints, just like at the club. No sign-up needed. It's completely optional, so play it when you like.
NEW TO BRIDGE?
Bridge is played by four players in two partnerships, North/South and East/West, seated across from each other. Partners bid for a contract, then work together to take the tricks needed to make it. With a patient AI partner and unlimited deals, it's an easy way to learn and practice at your own pace.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Bridge Card Game Classic offers an optional weekly (1 week) and yearly (1 year) subscription called Premier.
- Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm your purchase.
- Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost is shown.
- Manage your subscription or turn off auto-renewal in your Account Settings after purchase.
- If you subscribe in another currency, the price may vary slightly due to bank conversion fees.
Terms of Use: http://www.bridgecardgameclassic.com/terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy: http://www.bridgecardgameclassic.com/privacy-policy/
We love feedback, good or critical. Use Contact Us in the app's Help section. We read every message.

JOIN VIRTUAL MEETINGS

KNOW WHAT’S COMING UP

bluejetty:00041316:ios.description:
Trend Micro ID Protection shields your personal information and online accounts from identity theft, fraud, and unauthorized access. Stay ahead of identity and privacy risks. Enjoy peace of mind knowing your identity is secure and protected.
Lock down your digital security with data leak alerts, dark web monitoring, social media monitoring, and secure password management. Try it free for 7 days. Unlock Trend Micro ID Protection with Touch ID or Face ID.
Trend Micro ID Protection includes:
Personal Identity Monitoring: Monitors the internet and dark web to check if any of your personal data is leaked, reducing your risk of identity theft and account takeover attacks.
Social Media Monitoring: Monitors your Facebook, Google, and Instagram accounts for suspicious activity and potential hacks.
Anti-tracking and Privacy Controls: Prevents unwanted tracking on mobile devices and notifies you if you are in an unsafe Wi-Fi environment.
Cloud Sync: Synchronizes your information across all your devices.
Trend Micro ID Protection also offers comprehensive password management functions, including:
Autofill: Saves the usernames and passwords of your favorite websites so you can sign in with just one click.
Password Check: Notifies you when you have weak, reused, or compromised passwords.
Password Generator: Creates strong, tough-to-hack passwords.
Import Passwords: Quickly import passwords from your browser or another password manager.
Vault and Secure Notes: Stores not only your passwords but also other personal information in a secure, easily accessible location.
Smart Security: Automatically locks your ID Protection app when you are away from your device.
Trusted Sharing: Enables secure password sharing with your friends and family.
Trend Micro ID Protection safeguards you not only on mobile devices. You can use the same Trend Micro Account to access ID Protection on your computer and to download the ID Protection browser extension.

Trend Micro Incorporated, a global leader in cybersecurity solutions, helps to make the world safe for exchanging digital information. With more than 6,000 employees in 50 countries and the world’s most advanced global threat research and intelligence, Trend Micro enables organizations to secure their connected world. For more information, visit www.trendmicro.com.

bluejetty:00018932:ios.description:
The famous Braveland series returns! Destroy your enemies in online duels and uncover the secret of the king's scepter in this new turn-based strategy game.
LEAD AN ARMY: gather dozens of game creatures and create the most powerful squad in the kingdom
EXPLORE THE WORLD: defeat the most cunning villains

Use tactics to lead legions of heroes, fight the bosses and conquer other players! As you play, your army will be joined by various kinds of allies – archers, monks, demons, beasts, knights, and many others. Your journey begins in an ancient forest; you will pass through the southern lands and over the high mountains, you will encounter orcs, ghosts and mysterious nomads. bluejetty:00065845:ios.name: Call Break++
bluejetty:00065845:ios.summary: Call Break is a strategic trick-based card game similar to Spades. It's very popular in Nepal and in some places of India. It's also known as Lakdi, Lakadi or Lakadia in some places of India. The vintage game of cards features 4 players wit
bluejetty:00065845:ios.description:
Call Break is a strategic trick-based card game similar to Spades. It's very popular in Nepal and in some places of India. It's also known as Lakdi, Lakadi or Lakadia in some places of India. The vintage game of cards features 4 players with 13 cards each to offer virtual gaming experience. There will be five deals/round in a game. Starting a game with a bid/call, a player can compete against 3 computer players with effective artificial intelligence. Initiating a game by throwing a single card of any suit (club,diamond,heart,spade), the other players also follow the same suit unless they runs out of that particular suit. Absence of identical suit allows player to throw a card of another suit and the current round is won by highest card. Spade cards can be used to conquer other cards when no more cards of the same suit are there to offer.e.g. 2 of spade can conquer any higher cards of other suits. If all the players run out of both identical led suit and Spades card then the led card wins regardless of any suit. Play and have a joyful digital experience of one of the legendary game of cards on your phone or tablet.
Features:
1. Simple and minimalistic UI design
2. Smooth animations, runs decently on low end and old devices also.
3. Counter-clockwise turn rotation like in real game play
4. Game play speed controller with 3 speeds (slow, normal and fast)
5. Trump suit (colour card) can be chosen by the user, default is Spades.

On the contrary, when we read slowly, our attention gets distracted much more quickly because we give our brains the spaces to think about other things by trying to read slowly. Thanks to this application, you will be able to scan pages much faster by improving your eye muscles, you will learn to read more than one word at the same time by expanding your vision, and you will improve your concentration with concentration exercises. You will read your pdf and epub files much faster with the help of the reader with 2 different modes. 
o Do the exercises set for you every day in the speed reading course.
o Improve your eye muscles, visual angle and concentration ability thanks to the exercises.
o After doing the daily exercises, read at least 20 minutes daily with the help of the reader.
o Do extra exercises until your eye muscles get tired to improve faster.
o Track your 30-day progress with statistics.
o You will now read and understand your books much faster than before.
o It makes it easier for you to spend time reading books.
Features : 
• Speed reading and concentration exercises.
• Reading accelerator for pdf and epub files in 2 different modes.
• 30-day speed reading course.
• Exercises for the eye muscles.
• Exercises to expand the angle of vision.
• EPUB reader and PDF reader feature.
• Statistics to see your progress.
• Spritz reading mode is perfect for reading books
• Bionic reading.
Who is this app for ?
• Those who are distracted while reading a book and cannot read a book.
• Those who want to read their books faster.
• Those preparing for exams.
• Those who want to improve their concentration..
• Those who want to read their epub and pdf books in spritz form.

bluejetty:00169554:ios.description:
"Welcome to "Halloween: Echoes of Destiny" by HFG ENTERTAINMENTS, to the ultimate escape challenge! Your wit and cunning will be put to the test as you navigate through a maze of mysteries. Are you ready to unlock the secrets and escape to victory?"
Game story:
In 1950, a couple named Tom and Evelyn celebrated their first wedding anniversary on a night of celestial rarity when all the planets aligned for the first time in a millennium. Tom bestowed upon his wife, Evelyn, an antique pendant as an anniversary gift. This pendant held an extraordinary power; it could replicate the planetary alignment of that night, imbuing both angels and demons with heightened abilities. bluejetty:00121800:ios.description:
Welcome to the world of ultimate party vibes! Get ready to ignite your events with Disco Light - the app that bring dazzling visual spectacles to your fingertips. Just select an audio file from the import menu and let the app to flash your flashlight with the audio beats. Transforms your living room's environment a real disco. 
************************
**** HOW TO USE?
************************
1. Allow microphone access to this app
2. Take phone to concert or party (where music is playing)
3. The flash will turn on/off automatically. Giving a cool vibe.
4. Select from different modes how you want the flash to turn on/off
5. You can also select from stored audio files to blink flashlight
************************
**** FEATURES:
************************
* Play any audio file
* Input from microphone
* Turn On/Off Flash
* Blinks screen with beats so works in non flashlight devices
* Mute audio keeping flashlight to blink
* Five Different Modes
* Sync multiple devices
* Use External Speakers
* Audio waveform and realtime power meter
Our App can be used for free with Ads and limited features, however, you can purchase a Disco FlashLight Premium subscription for the additional advanced features, and remove Ads.
SUBSCRIPTION AND TERMS:
When you download our App you can opt in to a 3 days free trial for monthly and 7 days free trial for yearly subscription. Our App offers auto-renewing monthly/yearly subscription options for access to the app's features and content. Your Disco FlashLight Premium subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and payment will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To avoid renewal, you must cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription or trial ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING:
Premium Monthly: $0.99 / Month (3 days free trial)
Premium Yearly: $5.99 / Year (7 days free trial)

bluejetty:00068981:ios.description:
Learn every flag on Earth - and the countries behind them.
Flag Quiz covers all 196 countries: their flags, their capitals and their outlines on the map. Play a quick round, study at your own pace, or come back each day for a new puzzle.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Flag quiz: guess the country from its flag, by region or worldwide
- Capitals: learn which city belongs to which country
- Country outlines: optional map-shape questions you can switch on or off
- Daily puzzle: one country a day, guessed from its outline in six tries
- 40 levels: climb from the easy flags to expert
- Word scramble: spell the country from jumbled letters
- Time challenge: how many flags can you name in 60 seconds?
- Browse and learn: all 196 flags with capitals and populations
- Flashcards: study any region without the pressure of a score
- US states: all 50 state flags, with their capitals, as their own set
BUILT FOR LEARNING
Play offline. No account needed. Your streak and progress stay on your device.
Available in 14 languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Dutch, Polish, Russian, Hindi, Kazakh, Mongolian and Filipino.
Whether you are revising for a geography exam, preparing for a pub quiz, or just curious how many flags you actually know - start with five and see how far you get.
Privacy Policy: https://birchgroveapps.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://birchgroveapps.com/termsofservice

bluejetty:00120067:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00120067:ios.description:
Master your sense of time by practicing with a drum genius!
Created after years of research by Mauro Battisti (experienced musician and specialist in the field), Drumgenius is the choice of top players and leading music academies.
An ever-growing rhythm library to practice on — 500+ loops across 21 styles, reproducing real grooves by the best drummers and following authentic patterns of rhythms from around the world.
The loop player is packed with dedicated functions that put you in full control of every practice session. In-depth descriptions and insights offer a deeper understanding of the world of rhythm.
Plus, using Metrogenius, the smart built-in metronome — with a fully editable library of 9 meters + 22 clave patterns — you can explore everything from basic patterns to the most complex rhythmic cycles.
Easy Organization & Backup: Personalize your library by renaming loops, creating custom groups, and starring favorites. Save different practice setlists into single backup files to switch setups whenever you need, restore in a single tap on new devices, or share with friends, students, and fellow musicians.
THE LOOP LIBRARY IS CONSTANTLY GROWING AND CURRENTLY INCLUDES:
Afro-Cuban — 65
Boogaloo — 9
Brazilian — 53
Caribbean — 22
Country — 4
Disco — 3
Funky — 24
Gospel — 5
Hip-Hop — 5
Jazz — 53
Jazz – 3/4 — 9
Jazz – Ballad — 7
Jazz – Straight 8ths — 10
Jazz – Two Feel — 10
Jungle/D&B — 3
Neo Soul — 3
New Orleans — 14
Odd Time Signatures — 46
Polymeters — 17
Pop — 12
R&B — 3
Rock — 26
Shuffle — 17
Swing Lab — 24
World — 65
12/8 — 7
LOOP PLAYER TOOLS:
• Count-in: Activate it if you don't want to miss the one.
• Clave: Activate it to hear the rhythm backbone. Perfect for navigating tricky rhythms with confidence.
• Play X Cycles: Structure your practice session by setting the exact number of repetitions for each loop.
• Internal Loop Recording: Record yourself over the loop. Track your progress and share the recordings with peers and teachers.
• Silence Mode (Internalize the Time): Set intervals of silence while the tempo keeps running — the ultimate test of your internal clock.
• Time Morph (Rhythmic Elasticity): Accelerate and decelerate the loop in a continuous cycle, training you to react to the tempo in real time.
STAY MOTIVATED:
• Weekly Goals: Set practice targets, track your consistency, and share your achievements with a tap.
WHAT MUSICIANS SAY:
▶ "Mauro Battisti has made it possible for anyone to play along with the greatest drummers in the world, historical and contemporary, with the ability to alter tempo. Drumgenius is a great resource that can bring any player closer to the flame."
— Dave Liebman
▶ "Drumgenius sounds very good; I find it very handy to practice my instrument with real drums pattern that I can have always with me in my phone: thanks Mauro for this App."
— Dominique Di Piazza, electric bass player (John McLaughlin, Trilok Gurtu, Biréli Lagrène, Dennis Chambers)
▶ "Love this app: these loops sound fantastic! They are real drum loops — not MIDI or sequences — and they loop flawlessly. A fantastic groove reference for musicians of any kind."
— Damian Erskine, electric bass player (Peter Erskine, The Jaco Pastorius Big Band, Gino Vannelli, Tony Furtado), studio musician, author, adjunct professor at Portland State University
▶ "Drumgenius is a world-class teaching aid that addresses a fundamental challenge to successful performance practice for any musician: it is a virtuoso educational work by a true musical virtuoso!"
— Harold Danko, jazz pianist (Lee Konitz, Chet Baker, Thad Jones & Mel Lewis Big Band), composer, Professor of Jazz Studies & Contemporary Media at Eastman School of Music, Rochester, NY, USA

bluejetty:00061945:ios.description:
** Enjoy christmas with 36 lovely predefined mazes **
Each maze comes in lovely colors, background and characters.
Collect christmas artifacts and consume fruits as you make your way in the maze.
3 difficulty levels from easy to hard
Your kids will just love these wonderfully drawn mazes and will improve their skills while having fun! 
Our educational games are specifically tailored to fit preschool-aged kids, and encourage them to learn from each activity. We specialize in fun educational games.
Aimed for kids in the ages 1-6
*** What's New ***
* 20 Downloadable Puzzle Packs, over 1000 predefined puzzles.
* Variable puzzle size starting from 2 pieces up to 30 pieces for preschool kids and first graders!
* Play a new daily puzzle each day in 4 play variants - jigsaw puzzle, swipe puzzle, scratch card and color scratch
* Paint your own puzzles - paint by hand or import your pictures to create infinite new puzzles! 
* New Stories section - 18 first stories fit for ages 1-5.
* Create your own paintings, puzzles, stories and mazes
* New Language section with ABC letter tracing, Alphabet Sounds, Word Families, Sorting, Odd Words, Spelling and Writing 
* Dozens of games and learning activities including:
 +Learning numbers, 
 + Counting, 
 + Addition, 
 + Subtraction, 
 + Shapes, 
 + Colors, 
 + Order by size,
 + Order Numbers, 
 + Number line, 
 + Patterns, 
 + Tell Time, 
 + Matrix matching, 
 + More & Less, 
 + Great & Small, 
 + Big & Small, 
 + Long & Short, 
 + Tall & Short.
 + Bubbles shoot, 
 + Match, 
 + Memory, 
 + Domino, 
 + Maze, 
 + Cookies, 
 + Whack a bunny, 
 + Connect the Dots, 
 + Raining shapes
 + Animals Flow (New - 5 animal packs. 5x5-10x10 boards. 600 levels!)
 + Balloon Pop (New - learn colors, shapes, numbers and english ABC)
 + Animal Flow (New)
 + Letter Tracing (New)
 + Music Time (New)
Collect Stickers and a many more fun surprises! 
+ The game Does Not contain ads nor social links.
+ The game contains In App Purchases to unlock the base pack or subscribe to Tiltan Games entire educational library. 
+ The first 2 levels are open for free in each difficulty zone. Unlock all from the parents section.
Important things to know about the subscription:
• Subscription can be canceled anytime 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Payment is charged to your iTunes Account when you confirm the app purchase.
• Account is charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current billing period at the subscribed price
• You can manage your subscriptions from your account on the AppStore 
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
LEAVE US A REVIEW!
If you're enjoying the game then we'd love for you to leave us a review! Reviews help small developers like us keep improving this game.

bluejetty:00086898:ios.name: Fluidform Pilates at Home
bluejetty:00086898:ios.summary: There has never been an easier way to move your body for 20 minutes a day. Discover an extensive library of over 400 targeted workouts under 20 minutes, 150+ exclusive Fluidform challenges, recipes and seasonal meal plans in one convenient
bluejetty:00086898:ios.description:
There has never been an easier way to move your body for 20 minutes a day. Discover an extensive library of over 400 targeted workouts under 20 minutes, 150+ exclusive Fluidform challenges, recipes and seasonal meal plans in one convenient place – available at-home, on-demand.
Make movement your daily non-negotiable and wellness your priority. 
WHY CHOOSE FLUIDFORM?
- Join a global community of people in over 130 countries around the world, experiencing the transformative effect of Fluidform on the mind, body and soul. 
- All workouts and challenges are programmed and instructed by Kirsten King, an instructor with over 20 years experience teaching different bodies. Fluidform is a space for first-time beginners, intermediate users, advanced movers and athletes. 
- Your very own personalised health and wellness platform, accessible anytime, anywhere in the world. Build strength and tone, feel energised and glow with confidence.
- Specialised pre & postnatal programs for expecting and new mother’s. Feel safe, supported and guided from conception through to your postnatal recovery. Experience personalised support, safe and effective workouts specific to each trimester and reconnecting your abdominal separation. Maintain your strength and confidence throughout your entire pregnancy. Rebuild your abdominal connection and realign your body.
WHAT ARE THE BENEFITS?
- New content released monthly.
- Enjoy high speed browsing and video streaming on your mobile.
- Chromecast workouts to your TV for the ultimate in-studio experience, at home.
- Download workouts to your device for a smooth playback experience in areas of poor mobile connection to move your body anytime, anywhere in the world.
- Track your workouts and reach your daily activity goals with Apple HealthKit integration.
- Save time scrolling and maximise your time spent on the mat with a personalised program of recommended workouts and challenges. Take the guesswork out of what comes next.
- Receive educational content specific to you and your body.
- Save all your favourite workouts, challenges, recipes and meal plans in one place.
- Search and filter your workouts, challenges, recipes and meal plans to find exactly what you’re looking for.
FLUIDFORM APP FEATURES 
Workouts
- Over 400 online workouts on-demand, ranging from 5 to 50 minutes including mat pilates, reformer, boxing, cardio, swiss ball, barre, stretch, relaxation and breathwork.
- Programmed and instructed by Kirsten King, experience effective and specific cueing to improve your form and enhance your technique.
- Filter and search based on your fitness level, duration, equipment and area of the body.
Challenges
- Over 150 exclusive Fluidform challenges designed to create change in your body and help you achieve your goals. 
- Ranging from 7 days to 6 weeks, including a full range of equipment and focus areas, there is something for everybody.
Recipes
- An extensive recipe database with over 400 nourishing and nutritious recipes for the entire family to enjoy. 
- Filter and search based on your preferences and relight your inspiration in the kitchen.
Meal Plans
- Seasonal meal plans with daily breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks to form healthy lifestyle habits both in and out of the kitchen. 
- Filter and search based on your dietary preferences to create change in your body and support your movement journey.
Wellness
- Stretch, relaxation and breathwork series to calm your mind, reset your body and feel present.
- Reduce stress, improve focus and mental clarity with specific breath and relaxation techniques.
Terms of Service:
https://www.fluidformpilates.com/terms/

bluejetty:00082516:ios.description:
Spot what's trending — then turn it into a post that can blow up, in seconds.
Viral AI Content Creator shows you what's blowing up right now and helps you create scroll-stopping content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and more — in seconds, not hours. Ride the trend while it's hot and give your posts a real shot at going viral.
WHAT'S TRENDING NOW
See trending topics and searches as they take off, with live volume. Tap any trend for ready-to-use hashtags and related searches — then turn it into a post with one tap. Save trends into folders to reuse later.
TRENDING HASHTAGS
Get the hashtags people are actually searching, pulled straight from each trend. Copy one or copy them all.
CAPTIONS & SCRIPTS
AI writes engaging captions, hooks, and video scripts for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts. Just describe your post — or start from a trend.
PHOTO QUOTES
Turn any image into a stunning quote post. Pick from your photos, search thousands of free stock photos, or generate unique AI backgrounds. Choose Classic mode (quote + author) or Branded mode (text + your @handle).
QUOTE CARDS
Beautiful gradient backgrounds with your quotes. Multiple color presets, custom fonts, export ready.
INSTAGRAM CAROUSELS
Enter a topic and AI creates a full carousel — title slide, content slides, and CTA. Multiple templates. Export all slides at once.
EVERY PLATFORM COVERED
> Instagram: Captions, Reels, Stories, Carousels, Hashtags
> TikTok: Scripts, Ideas, Captions, Hashtags
> YouTube: Titles, Descriptions, Outlines
> Twitter/X: Tweets, Threads
> Facebook: Posts, Ad Copy
MY CREATIONS
Everything you make is saved. Find, reuse, and reshare anytime.
No design skills needed. No watermarks. HD export.
Stop guessing what to post. Ride the trend.
SUBSCRIPTION
Unlock full access with a Weekly or Monthly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Free trials are available to eligible users on the Monthly plan.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase confirmation, or when an eligible free trial ends.
Cancel at least 24 hours before your free trial ends to avoid charges.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends.
Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Prices are shown before purchase.
Lifetime is a one-time purchase with no automatic renewal. Restore purchases using the same Apple Account.
Privacy Policy
https://socmedai.web.app/privacy.html
Terms of Service
https://socmedai.web.app/terms.html

bluejetty:00075145:ios.name: PJ Masks™: Power Heroes
bluejetty:00075145:ios.summary: It's time to be a hero and join the PJ Masks: Power Heroes for another moonlit adventure! Dash through the city, avoiding obstacles and defeat the Night-time Baddies. Tailored for pre-schoolers and fun for all ages, this action-packed endle
bluejetty:00075145:ios.description:
It's time to be a hero and join the PJ Masks: Power Heroes for another moonlit adventure! Dash through the city, avoiding obstacles and defeat the Night-time Baddies. Tailored for pre-schoolers and fun for all ages, this action-packed endless runner has exciting locations, mischievous villains, and an awesome range of PJ Masks heroes, both old and new!
Along with age-appropriate controls to dodge, jump and fly over obstacles, the PJ Masks endless runner game brings exciting adventure to every mission. Players will use superhero powers to collect Power Stars to unlock new goodies. PJ Masks: Power Heroes uses adaptive learning to automatically adjust the game’s difficulty to match your child’s ability.
FEATURES
• Tailored for pre-schoolers, with tons of free Superhero missions to play
• Take the PJ Masks with you and play offline or on-the-go
• Race through the city whilst avoiding obstacles
• Use your superhero's unique powers to blast obstacles and defeat the villains
• Collect stars to upgrade power-ups
• Complete different missions and earn items to customise your Hero Hideout
PJ MASKS POWERUPS 
• Choose from 5 all-time favorite PJ Masks characters and hit the streets for another moonlit adventure with their unique superpowers...
• Catboy uses his Super Cat Speed to gain invincibility at top speed, whilst his Super Furballs smash obstacles 
• Owlette’s Super Feather Shield makes her immune to injury and her Super Owl Wings let her take flight over the obstacles 
• Gekko’s Super Gekko Camouflage lets him dodge the Villain’s attempts to block him and his Lizard Tail Swipe protects him from obstacles in his path 
• Newton Star draws his powers from asteroids allowing him to take flight and blast obstacles with his Star Shields
• An Yu uses her Dragon Staff to Teleport and to fly above the night time streets
• Ice Cub glides effortlessly on his snowboard to find his way around the obstacles in his path
AGE-APPROPRIATE & KIDS SAFE 
Trusted by millions of families across the globe, PJ Masks: Power Heroes gives parents peace of mind:
• Age-appropriate action & adventure content tailored for pre-schoolers 
• A safe and secure kid’s environment
• Parental gate to stop your little ones making unauthorized purchases 
COPPA COMPLIANT
COPPA and kidSAFE certifications 
PJ MASKS
PJ Masks is a big favorite with families all around the world. Together the trio of heroes – Catboy, Owlette, and Gekko – embark on action-packed adventures, solving mysteries and learning valuable lessons along the way. Watch out Night-time Baddies – the PJ Masks are on their way, into the night to save the day! 
ABOUT Entertainment One 
Entertainment One (eOne) is a market leader in the creation, distribution, and marketing of award-winning kids' content that connects with families around the world. Inspiring smiles with the world's most beloved characters, from Peppa Pig to PJ Masks, eOne takes dynamic brands all the way from screens to stores
SUPPORT
• We currently support iOS 9.0 and up
• For the best PJ Masks runner game performance, we recommend iPad Air and above, or iPhone 6 / SE and above 
CONTACT US
Feedback or questions? We'd love to hear from you!
Email us at pjsupport@scarybeasties.com
MORE INFORMATION
Privacy Policy: http://scarybeasties.com/pjmasks-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00027180:ios.description:
Introducing the Ultimate QR Code and Barcode Scanner App – your one-stop solution for fast, accurate, and hassle-free code scanning! 
Upgrade your scanning experience with our powerful tool.
+ Scan with Ease: Effortlessly scan QR codes and barcodes instantly. Say goodbye to manual data entry – point your camera, and our advanced scanning technology does the rest. From product details to pricing, get the info you need in seconds.
+ Shop Smart: Discover a more innovative way to shop! Scan QR codes to access product reviews, compare prices, and find the best deals. Make informed decisions and never overpay again.
+ Generate Your Own: Need a QR code? Our app doubles as a powerful QR code generator. Create codes for websites, contact information, Wi-Fi access, and more. Share your codes with friends or customers or use them for personal or business purposes.
+ Business Boost: Seamlessly integrate QR codes into your business operations. Generate codes for products, services, or promotional materials. Enhance customer engagement, track inventory, and streamline your processes.
+ Web Links Made Easy: Share URLs without the hassle of typing. Generate QR codes for website links and drive traffic seamlessly. Simplify user experiences and bridge the gap between offline and online content.
+ Scan Anywhere, Anytime: Whether you're in a store, at an event, or browsing magazines, our app transforms your smartphone into a powerful scanner—capturing codes in low light, at odd angles, and even from a distance.
Information about the auto-renewal of subscription:
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase;
– Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually at the rate based on the subscription plan

- The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan;
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase;

Con la app BBVA Perú puedes consultar fácilmente todas tus cuentas, tarjetas y productos financieros c
bluejetty:00118797:ios.description:
¡Bienvenido a la aplicación móvil de BBVA Perú, la mejor app para gestionar todas tus finanzas personales y de negocio desde tu celular!
Con la app BBVA Perú puedes consultar fácilmente todas tus cuentas, tarjetas y productos financieros cuando quieras y desde donde estés. Puedes separar cómodamente tus cuentas personales de las de tu negocio en un solo lugar.
Si aún no eres cliente de BBVA, ahora puedes abrir tu cuenta digital directamente desde la app, en menos de 5 minutos, sin ir a oficina. Este nuevo flujo digital único en Perú te permite obtener inmediatamente una cuenta de ahorros digital con cero costo de mantenimiento, una tarjeta de débito digital para tus compras físicas y en línea, afiliación inmediata a Plin BBVA para transferencias rápidas, acceso completo a la banca por Internet y activación del Token Digital para operaciones seguras.
Gestiona tus finanzas de forma segura utilizando biometría facial y dactilar (huella digital) para ingresar a tu app y confirmar operaciones. Los datos de tus operaciones se transmiten protegidos y no se guardan en tu celular. Además, activa o bloquea tus tarjetas directamente desde la aplicación sin necesidad de realizar llamadas.
Envía dinero inmediatamente y sin comisiones utilizando Plin, solamente con el número celular del destinatario. También puedes realizar transferencias rápidas y seguras entre tus cuentas, otras cuentas BBVA o hacia otros bancos nacionales.
Paga fácilmente servicios como celular, luz, agua, universidad, Internet y más desde tu app, ahorrándote tiempo. También realiza retiros sin tarjeta desde cajeros o agentes BBVA.
Organiza tu dinero de manera simple con Apartados BBVA, una herramienta gratuita para separar dinero según tus necesidades.
Accede fácilmente a tus tarjetas de crédito o débito para consultar saldos, movimientos y transacciones. Además, administra diferentes productos financieros como cuentas de ahorros, tarjetas de crédito, préstamos personales, créditos rápidos y adelanto de sueldo desde tu smartphone.
Contrata seguros vehiculares fácilmente desde la app y protege tu vehículo con coberturas adaptadas a tus necesidades. Realiza cambios de soles a dólares con excelentes tipos de cambio sin hacer filas ni esperas.
Explora inversiones y fondos mutuos para monitorear tus ahorros y controlar tu futuro financiero desde tu teléfono.
Además, con la app BBVA Perú podrás monitorear tus gastos en tiempo real, recibir alertas sobre movimientos importantes y personalizar tus productos financieros según tus preferencias y necesidades.
¿Tienes un negocio? Desde el perfil "Mi Negocio", disponible en un solo clic desde el menú lateral, gestiona todas las finanzas de tu empresa, consulta ventas de tu POS afiliado a BBVA, abre cuentas de negocio 100% online, realiza pagos desde tu Tarjeta Capital de Trabajo, cotiza tipos de cambio preferenciales, transfiere rápidamente a proveedores y paga planillas fácilmente.
Además, nuestra aplicación está constantemente mejorando para brindarte nuevas funciones, facilidades y herramientas financieras que simplifiquen aún más tu día a día. Nos encanta escucharte y que seas parte de esta app. Si tienes dudas, contáctanos en nuestra Banca por teléfono llamando al 595 0000.
Descarga ahora la app BBVA Perú y descubre la manera más rápida, sencilla y segura de manejar todas tus finanzas.

bluejetty:00175505:ios.description:
Jigsawscapes - Jigsaw Puzzles is a fun and addictive jigsaw puzzle game designed for iPhone and iPad. With over 60,000 puzzles and 150+ new puzzles added every week, it's the perfect way to relax, train your brain, and improve concentration. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned puzzle solver, Jigsawscapes offers a rewarding and enjoyable journey.
Playing jigsaw puzzles daily boosts memory, logical thinking, and problem-solving skills, making it an excellent stress reliever and time killer. Our collection of puzzles for adults is especially great for relaxation and mindfulness.
Why You'll Love Jigsawscapes:
1. 60,000+ Stunning HD Images – Discover vibrant, high-quality images designed to elevate your puzzle experience.
2. Expansive Puzzle Library – Choose puzzles from over 20 diverse categories including animals, landscapes, food, landmarks, and more.
3. Zero Missing Pieces – Every puzzle includes all pieces for seamless and frustration-free solving.
4. Daily Puzzle Challenges – Tackle unique puzzles daily to earn special trophies and rewards.
5. My Puzzle Collection – Easily track and revisit completed puzzles in your personalized gallery.
6. Global Leaderboards – Compete against players worldwide and climb to the top ranks.
7. Journey Events – Participate in special-themed and limited-time events, and collect exclusive rewards.
How to Play:
1. Choose your puzzle and select your preferred difficulty level (number of pieces).
2. Personalize your puzzle environment with various custom backgrounds.
3. Drag and drop the puzzle pieces onto the board and match them precisely.
4. Easily zoom in and out for better viewing and accurate placement.
5. Assemble all the pieces correctly to complete the puzzle.
6. Solve daily challenges to unlock achievements and special rewards.
7. Experiment with Rotate Mode for an additional puzzle-solving layer of challenge.
8. Play anytime and anywhere, even offline—enjoy unlimited puzzle solving without restrictions.
Jigsaw puzzles have been a beloved activity for centuries, offering a blend of mental stimulation and relaxation. Whether you're solving a quick puzzle during a break or diving into an intricate challenge, every completed puzzle brings a sense of accomplishment.If you have any questions or feedback, contact us at support@oakevergames.com — we're always happy to help.

Are you in the mood for an adventure in the Metaverse? Are you on the lookout for brand-new fun games in Metaverse? There's an endless list of new exciting games in YAHAHA.

Adventure into stunning virtual spaces or just enjoy endless sceneries!

Have fun wherever you are with whatever device you have. YAHAHA features full cross-platform support, meaning you can join your friends and millions of other people connected with various computers, mobile devices or VR headsets.
SHARE THE FUN
Meet new people, team up with friends and share your own unique YAHAHA space.
Take part in activities, play games and party the night away!

bluejetty:00186897:ios.description:
Learn Eastern Armenian the easiest way through the AYOlingo app.
No matter your proficiency in the Armenian language, AYOlingo provides an easy and free learning experience for Armenian language learners.
The app currently has 90 modules, with 30 more to be released in the future. The app will help you learn Armenian and teach you:
- the basics of the Armenian language
- grammatical tenses
- animal names
- common phrases
- feeling expression
- numbers
- adjectives
- food
And much more.
The app also has a vocabulary section to help you look up the words in the Armenian language easier.
You can also follow your friends and see their progress in learning Armenian. Some friendly competition will, of course, help you learn more efficiently through our leaderboard.
The app teaches you Armenian through a variety of exercises:
• Fill in the blank in phrases
• Fill in the blank in the dialog
• Translate the phrases

bluejetty:00121674:ios.description:
Link monsters through hexagonal blocks to save gingerbreads and become a Hero of Ice Tower! New fun missions and features to be explored! Install now!
Join the adventure of adorable kids, Bruce, Boo and Namu, to the top of Ice Tower where poor Gingerbread friends are trapped! Let’s save them from bad monsters!
◆ Fun Twist on Classic Match-3 
Try something different from classic match-3 you already know!
Make a match by linking 3 or more monsters of the same color to each other in 6 directions on the boards composed of hexagons. You can even make cross-connections linking already connected monsters to get Super Bombs at the intersections!
◆ Unique rules of creating Special Bombs
Lots of special bombs can be created while playing! Moreover, you can choose the type of the bomb you get! Take advantage of this unique option to create the most beneficial special bombs and build your own strategy to clear missions! Change the direction of the ring by going back and forth! Connect as a line, make a loop, connect already linked monsters - totally different bombs will be made! So many options to be explored, you should definitely try them yourself!
◆ Little helpers will do the work for you
Amazing new feature, Snow Bomb, is newly introduced in Ice Slide. Longer links will help you get Snow Bombs attacking your mission target and helping you clear stages easier! Just link monsters near your target and see how Snow Bombs do the job for you! 
◆ Advanced Boss Fights
Find challenging yet exciting Boss levels behind the big doors as you progress in the tower. Attention, the Boss comes together with its babies, whom you need to attack in order to defeat the Boss! Look for the babies’ claws holding monsters tightly, you need to link as many monsters through those claws as you can to give the babies maximum damage! Ouch!
◆ Play with your friends
It’s so much more fun to play with your friends! Connect to Facebook and help each other whenever your friend is in trouble! Compete and see who’s taking the first place!
Join now! Bruce, Boo and Namu are eager to start this gingerbread-saving heroic adventure together with you! The real fun starts now!

If you don't want to collect, you can stop collecting in the way below.

bluejetty:00148925:ios.description:
Meet the Ultimate Package Tracker - Parcel!
Parcel is the perfect app for anyone who’s tired of wondering where their package is. All you need to get comprehensive info is to enter your Tracking Number and get all the updates in real-time. See your shipment’s location, status, and Estimated Delivery Date - all under one roof. 
- Track any Package Worldwide - with 650+ international postal and courier services supported, you can count on Parcel to help you track your order from FedEx, USPS Informed Delivery, UPS Mobile Delivery, DHL Express Mobile App, Amazon Tracking, China Post, Royal Mail, and more.
- Live Location Updates - check where your package is right now and use our Route Tracker to check where it’s heading next.
- Estimated Delivery Dates - find out when your Package is expected to arrive (if this info is provided by the Carrier).
Regardless of the package you’re tracking, Parcel is your go-to companion that will make the whole process as smooth as butter!
See where your package is and control the shipment process from A to Z!
IMPORTANT NOTE: 
The estimated arrival date comes from the Carrier, so any delays/inconsistencies also depend on the Carrier’s activity and not the app itself.
Upgrade to Premium to unlock scanner, unlimited number of shipments, enjoy an ad-free experience!

bluejetty:00087534:ios.name: Bite AI: Photo Calorie Scanner
bluejetty:00087534:ios.summary:

Bite AI is an AI food and nutrition tracker built around one simple idea: logging a meal should take a second, not a minute. Snap a photo and Bite AI re
bluejetty:00087534:ios.description:
Point your camera at your plate. Bite AI tells you the calories and macros in seconds.
Bite AI is an AI food and nutrition tracker built around one simple idea: logging a meal should take a second, not a minute. Snap a photo and Bite AI recognizes the food, estimates the portion, and fills in calories, protein, carbs and fat. Every number stays editable, so you are always in control of your day.
SCAN ANYTHING
• Photo scan — one snap turns any meal into calories and macros
• Barcode — scan packaged food for exact nutrition
• Nutrition label — point at the label and Bite AI reads it
• Describe it — say or type what you ate and it gets logged
TRACK EVERYTHING
• Calories, protein, carbs and fat on a home screen built for one glance
• Instant editing — fix portions, ingredients and macros in place, no re-scanning
• Progress screens for weight, trends and your daily goals
• Apple Health sync and a home screen widget for your remaining calories
STAY CONSISTENT
• Build your circle of friends and keep each other going
• Streak leaderboard and weekly buddy challenges
• Friends see your consistency, never your food
• 96 achievement badges to earn, with all-new medal artwork
A COACH THAT LEARNS YOU
• Chew, your AI coach, remembers your goals, preferences and history
• Ask what to eat, how to hit your protein, or what to do after a heavy day
• Onboarding builds a personalized plan: your calories, your macros, your pace
FAMILY PLAN
• One subscription shares Bite AI with your family
• Everyone keeps their own goals and their own private log
Bite AI 3.0 is a complete rebuild — a new design, a new camera, and dozens of performance improvements throughout.
Join thousands of people who log their food in seconds. Download Bite AI and scan your first meal today.
Bite AI is free to download. A subscription is required for AI photo analysis and premium features. Cancel anytime.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.getbiteai.com/privacy

bluejetty:00040175:ios.description:
تفسير الإنجيل بحسب أباء الكنيسة القبطية الأرثوذكسية 
البرنامج يحتوي علي تفسير الكتاب المقدس بعهديه + الاسفار الحذوفة مكتوب ومسموع
التفاسير المتاحة حاليا:
تفسير الإنجيل لابونا تادرس يعقوب ملطي
تفسير الإنجيل لابونا انطونيوس فكري
تفسيرالانجيل لكنيسة مارمرقس مصر الجديدة المعروف باسم تفسير ابونا داود لمعي
الجديد في هذه النسخة
- لتقليل حجم البرنامج، يمكنك الان تحميل كل تفسير بمفرده. بعد التحميل، يمكنك الاستمتاع بالقراءة دون الحاجة للإتصال بالانترنت
- الاستماع الى جميع اسفار الكتاب المقدس
- خاصية النسخ واللصق والشير
- خاصية تظليل الاَيات المفضلة
- بالإضافة للتفاسير، يمكنك الان قراءة الانجيل بدون تفسير
- البحث السريع عن اي كلمة او جملة في الانجيل
- تحديثات اخرى
المميزات الاساسية
- يمكنك التنقل بسهولة بين اسفار الكتاب المقدس و اصحاحاته
- يمكنك الذهاب الى الاية مباشرة في معظم الاسفار
- يمكنك تغيير حجم النص
- يمكنك تغيير لون الخط/الخلفية
Checkout the English commentaries here: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/coptic-commentaries/id6475151185

bluejetty:00122531:ios.name: Bitcoin Sentinel
bluejetty:00122531:ios.summary:
This app has as main characteristic the quick visualization of the value of Bitcoin that is being commercialized in the market, with some calculations based on the quantity of Bitcoins.
Coins: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Stellar (XLM),
bluejetty:00122531:ios.description:
This app has as main characteristic the quick visualization of the value of Bitcoin that is being commercialized in the market, with some calculations based on the quantity of Bitcoins.
Coins: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), Stellar (XLM), Ripple (XRP), Bitcoin Cash (BCH), Litecoin (LTC), Tether (USDT), Dogecoin, Dash, Miota, Bitcoin Gold (BTG), Ethereum Classic (ETC), Cardano (ADA), Polygon (MATIC), Pancakeswap (CAKE), Solana (SOL) and Polkadot (DOT).
Values in Dollar, Real, Euro, British Pounds.
Besides the last Ticker, you can see the Exchanges charts!
A tab dedicated to news, from sources so you can stay inside of what is happening in this world.
The app also allows you to create rules to monitor the values to be notified when a certain amount is above and / or below (per market).
The notifications are in the Settings, remembering that there is need to have logged in the App.
Note:
* As the value of Bitcoin tends to go up and down fast, you can be notified several times in a short period of time. Please send me an email if you find this behavior bad.
Developer's note:
* I know that advertisements can be nasty, but they enable development. Thanks for the support and understanding!
The data is updated from the Exchanges themselves.

bluejetty:00184451:ios.name: Perfect Hairstyle and Hair Cut
bluejetty:00184451:ios.summary:
Looking for a new hairstyle? Just not sure what will suit you?
Upload your picture and try on a new hairstyle, see if suits you? 
Option to compare your different hairstyles. You will know which one is better for you trough the Beauty Score
bluejetty:00184451:ios.description:
Looking for a new hairstyle? Just not sure what will suit you?
Upload your picture and try on a new hairstyle, see if suits you? 
Option to compare your different hairstyles. You will know which one is better for you trough the Beauty Score feature created with artificial intelligence.
Dye your hair with filters that instantly changes the color of your hair.
Check some real reviews:
Great fun *****
by The app reviewer
Good for hairstyle and color. Helps you see what style fits your shape face. Try it - it's fun!!
Great app! *****
by Jazmine907
Really helpful in trying different styles! Recommend to anyone!
Love it *****
by Meeeeeee98
The app is easy to use and the results look realistic.
Are you ready to revolutionize your look? With Perfect Hairstyle, you can try on countless haircuts and hairstyles 
from the comfort of your phone. Whether it’s long hair you’re longing for, or a chic short hair cut, our app offers endless possibilities to redefine your style.
Find Your Signature Haircut:
Curious about short hair but not ready to chop it off? Use our "Haircut Try On" feature to visualize how you’d look! 
Our diverse range of haircuts from elegant long hair layers to sassy short hair bobs ensures there’s something for everyone. 
Experiment with each hair cut using our sophisticated hair filter, designed to give you the most realistic preview.
Color & Style in a Snap:
Dive into a rainbow of possibilities with our hair style try on feature! Try different colors to complement your new haircut. 
Our hair filter allows you to mix and match color options with any hairstyle, transforming your look with just a few taps. 
Whether you want to enhance your long hair with sun-kissed highlights or give your short hair an edgy tint, Perfect Hairstyle makes it easy.
Hairstyles to Match Your Mood:
Thinking about bangs? Our "Bangs Filter" lets you experiment with various bang styles on any haircut. 
From fluffy bangs to sharp geometric shapes, our bangs filter helps you visualize how different bangs can transform any hairstyle. 
Switching between hairstyles is effortless, thanks to our hairstyle try on feature, enabling you to navigate through numerous options until you find your ideal look.
Explore, Experiment, and Express:
Perfect Hairstyle isn’t just about trying on a new haircut; it’s about discovering a whole new you! 
Choose a hairstyle, apply your favorite hair filter, and marvel at how different haircuts can dramatically alter your appearance.
 With both long hair and short hair options, our app caters to your every whim and fancy.
Step into Your Perfect Style:
Why stick to one look when you can explore hundreds? From sleek short hair cuts to flowing long hair curls, 
Perfect Hairstyle invites you to a world of hairstyling fun. Utilize our "Hairstyle Try On" and "Haircut Try On" features repeatedly to ensure you find that flawless style.
Download Perfect Hairstyle now and embark on a fabulous hair journey. It’s time to play with different haircuts, splash in some color, and experiment with new hairstyles. Let’s make every day a fabulous hair day with Perfect Hairstyle!
Features:
• More than fifty hairstyles for free.
• Free hairstyles in various lengths to try on.
• Take a photo, Use your photo album.
• Understand what suits your face shape.
• 8 packs with more than 450 hairstyles you can get trough in app-purchases. You can get the following packs:
 -Celebrity hairstyles.
 -Latest hairstyles.
 -Alternative hairstyles.
 -Most popular.
 -Celeb Inspiration hairstyles.
 -Hairstyles for mature women.
 -Men hairstyles.
 -Black hairstyles.
This new season is going to be an experimenting one. This year is rich with different hairstyle trends. 
Download and embark on a fabulous hair journey. It’s time to play with different haircuts, splash in some color, and experiment with new hairstyles. Let’s make every day a fabulous hair day with Perfect Hairstyle!
So, try on a new hairstyle and avoid a hairstyle disaster!

bluejetty:00122532:ios.name: Bitcoin Trading Signals
bluejetty:00122532:ios.summary: Trading4Pro's breakthrough product "Market Trends" is coming to cryptocurrency exchanges. Cryptocurrency trading has never been easier as our app finds the trend and provides you with trading signals. This app provides data from the Binance
bluejetty:00122532:ios.description:
Trading4Pro's breakthrough product "Market Trends" is coming to cryptocurrency exchanges. Cryptocurrency trading has never been easier as our app finds the trend and provides you with trading signals. This app provides data from the Binance cryptocurrency exchange, including the following symbols BTCUSDT (Bitcoin), ETHUSDT (Ethereum), BNBUSDT (Binance coin), SOLUSDT (Solana), DOGEUSDT (Dogecoin), XRPUSDT (XRP), SHIBUSDT (Shiba Inu), BCHUSDT (Bitcoin Cash), AVAXUSDT (Avalanche), LINKUSDT (Chainlink), BONKUSDT (Bonk), NEARUSDT (Near Protocol) and 200 more coins. The list of available coins is constantly updated to provide you with data on all popular cryptocoins.
The app consists of 4 independent analysis tools: Market Trends, Heatmaps, Highs-Lows and Algo Trends. Market Trends is a quick trend finder as the main algorithm is based on live data from 3 of the most popular technical analysis indicators: EMA, Stochastic and RSI. Each cryptocurrency price is processed by the algorithm and given a position on a 5 level scale: strong sell, sell, neutral, buy and strong buy. You will receive a notification on your device as soon as any coin generates a strong trend. Advanced traders can adjust the algorithm through the tool's "Settings".
A new tool will take your cryptocurrency trading analytics on Binance exchange to higher levels: Algo Trends is a simple platform for creating algorithmic alerts that does not require any programming skills. A number of indicators with different parameters are available for you to choose from, while you can include up to 5 indicators in an algorithm. When all the indicators are at the crossing point - a notification will be sent to your device. A direct trading option will be added in a future version! Get the best cryptocurrency signals and analysis for Binance with our app!
Heatmaps is a sliding time window calculation for 3 to 5 different time periods simultaneously. Each price change is given a different shade of either green or red color, so trending cryptocurrencies can be found in seconds. The color levels are customisable in the tool's “Settings”, while you can get a notification on your device for every price change (for example: adding 0.45% in 5 minutes).
Highs-Lows is a tool that displays the current price on an axis with a number of historical highs and lows at the same time. This will help you to understand the strength and future prospects of the current trend. More than 15 different time frames can be selected, from 1 week to 5 years. Receive an notification on your device when a new historical high or low is set, or when the price is within a certain percentage.
Terms of Use: https://trading4pro.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://trading4pro.com/privacy/
Risk Warning: https://trading4pro.com/investment/

bluejetty:00127753:ios.summary:

• You
bluejetty:00127753:ios.description:
RowingCoach, available also for the Apple Watch, allows you to track your rowing sessions, compare your workouts and see your overall progress – whether you train on land or on water. 
== RowingCoach displays the following metrics:
• Your current and overall stroke rate (SPM)
• The distance covered
• Your current and overall pace
• Your pulse
• Your calories burned
== Use the app as suits you best:
• Track your session on the iPhone
• Only use your Apple Watch to record the training (and leave your iPhone onshore!)
• Use the iPhone as display for your Apple Watch recording. Very useful for indoor rowing.
== RowingCoach also offers these features:
• Use Siri to start and stop your workout
• Automatic Stroke detection
• Get notified after a certain distance covered, strokes reached or time passed
• Display your workout on a map
• Speed/pulse shown in color-coding
• Share your rowing track with iMessage
• Weather conditions are recorded for outdoor workouts
• iCloud synchronisation: Have your workouts on all your devices.
• Apple Health App integration
• Watch Complication: See your weekly progress at a glance
• Use Force Touch in the Watch app to quickly start and stop a workout
• Today Widget: See your weekly and monthly progress from the Today screen
• Add notes (to remember who was cox for example)
== Export and upload your workouts to other platforms:
• Upload to Strava
• Export to RowsAndAll
• Upload to MapMyFitness
• Upload to TrainingPeaks
• Upload to Concept2 Logbook
• Upload to Intervals.icu
External bluetooth heart rate monitors are supported.
If you want to export your workouts via e-mail or want to record more than 3 workouts - you can get to a subscription right in the app.

Klutch is your personal AI betting analyst. Whether you're a casual fan or a sharp in training, Klutch gives you a real-time, expert-level read on any matchup in seconds.

bluejetty:00185154:ios.name: Minesweeper X: Classic Reboot
bluejetty:00185154:ios.summary:
The best new way to play the classic Minesweeper, fully optimized for iOS! Control, Graphics & Animation simply make "Minesweeper Original Reboot" a revolutionary remake of this classic.
The task is simple: mark and sweep all mines in the
bluejetty:00185154:ios.description:
The best new way to play the classic Minesweeper, fully optimized for iOS! Control, Graphics & Animation simply make "Minesweeper Original Reboot" a revolutionary remake of this classic.
The task is simple: mark and sweep all mines in the field. This classic game play is just that simple yet so exciting and challenging. "Minesweeper Original Reboot" is perfect for brain practicing and short time playing at any time. Play now to test your deduction skill as well as your finger speed!
What make "Minesweeper Original Reboot" special:
 - Optimized for guaranteeing fastest game play and best control experience: Careful designed just for touch devices with super fast and easy control (TAP to open square, TAP & HOLD to drop flags, DRAG to move board around, PINCH to zoom)
 - Auto save and load, never lose your current game even if it is completely quit or crashed
 - Elegant, beautiful graphics with lots of cool sound and animation effects
 - Support both portrait and landscape rotations on both iPhone and iPad devices
 - Auto resize board to take advantage of whole screen
 - Auto scrolling board after every touch (optionally enabled/disable) which is convenient to navigate the board without manually dragging
 - 3 zoom modes for board: 1x, 2x, 3x to suit any finger sizes. Note that the scale up does not effect the image quality
 - Quick overview mode which allow seeing the overall board and quick jumping, extremely helpful for large board sizes
 - Hint to open any given square at any time: very helpful for 50/50 situations or when getting stuck
 - SUPER HARD level + CUSTOM level allowing the max board size up to 72 x 72
 - Share your results via email or social networks
 - Step-by-step instructions for people who have never played Minesweeper before
Other common features:
 - 3 traditional levels: EASY, MEDIUM, HARD
 - First touch guaranteed not to hit a mine and always opens a range of squares
 - Flagging/Digging modes
 - Local statistics: best time, number of wins and losses
 - Game Center support
 - Natively, beautifully run on all iOS devices
Have fun and enjoy playing "Minesweeper Original Reboot"!
