bluejetty:00100737:ios.description:
Muslim Dawah is one of the top popular Muslim apps. It's very necessary for Pro Muslims all over the world.
Muslims around the world use the app for most accurate prayer time with Qibla direction and Quran with native translation, Arabic scripts and audio recitation. This is the best Islamic app for religious muslims. Muslim Dawah app which can be used as all in one as it contains Al Quran, Prayer Times, Supplication, Qibla compass, Tasbih, Duas, Kitab, Hadith and Zakat calculator.
MAIN FEATURES:
• Al Quran: The Holy Quran with audio recitations, phonetics, tafsir and translations in 60 languages.
• Salat Times: Accurate prayer times based on your current location. Alarm feature with Adhan audio.
• Tasbih: Beautifully animated counter to count your daily dhikr.
• Qibla Finder: Animated Qibla compass to show you the direction to Makkah.
• Masjid Finder.
• Rich collection of duas and supplications with audio.
• Vast collection of 55000+ Hadiths including Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Tirmidhi, Nasa'i, Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, Musnad Ahmad, Al-Muwatta by Imam Malik and other Al Hadith Books.
• 5200+ Islamic books.
• 99 Names of Allah
• Zakat Calculator.
• Watch live coverage of Makkah.
• Dark Mode
• Widget
Feature details:
Al Quran:
- Read Complete Quran Majeed 114 Surah and 30 para part by part.
- Listen Holy Al Qur'an Ayat in Arabic Audio with at least 15 Quran Reciters.
- Quran recitation with audio translation in English, Bangla, Hindi, Urdu, Bahasa Indonesia, German, Russian, Spanish, French and Turkish.
- 6 widely-used high quality Quranic prints (Hafizi-Quran).
- Verse selection, bookmark, share feature.
- Comprehensive search feature
- Word by Word Quran.
- World renowned reciters (Sheikh Abdul Basit Abdul Samad, Ali Abdur-Rahman Al Hudhaify, Maher Al-Mueaqly, Abdullah Ali Jabir, Abdul Rahman Al-Sudais, Mishary Rashid Alafasy, Saud Al-Shuraim, Saad Al-Ghamdi, Yasser Al-Dosari, Sheikh Ayman Suwayd, Raad Mohammad Al Kurdi, Muhammad Siddiq Al-Minshawi, Abdullah al Juhany etc.)
Salat Times:
- Shows Muslim Prayer Times: Tahajjud, Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Sunset, Maghrib, Isha, Ishraq, Duha (Chast), Iftar and Sahri.
- Four juristic methods (Mazhab): Hanafi, Shafii, Maliki, Hanbali.
- Options to adjust the prayer times.
Supplications:
- Shows supplication about death, house, eating, Toilet, sleep, Tour, Socialization, Marriage, Decor, Affliction, Danger, Thunderstorms, Durood, Istighfar, Rabbana, Mosjid, Salat Eid, Hajj, Ramadan, Surah, Special Salat and others.
- Don't forget to read Dua's daily, you can see in both Arabic and your language.
Qibla Finder:
Find the accurate Qibla direction Finder from the compass.
-Qibla direction app shows you where the Qibla is, even in an offline mode with the help of its compass feature.
- Find Kaaba/Makkah Direction from the any part of the world.
Tasbih:
- Very useful tool to count zikr.
-Keep tracking of Tasbih count and also calculate how many times and when you recited names of Allah.
99 Names of Allah:
- Read 99 Names of Allah (Asma Ul Husna) in Arabic and meanings in your native language.
- Listen to the audio for each name and easy to play/pause
Language:
- This app is translated in 61 languages: English, عربى, Shqip, Amharic, azərbaycan, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Bangla (Bengali), Amazigh (Berber), Bosanski, български, 中文, čeština, Nederlands, Español, فارسی , Français, Deutsch, Hausa, हिन्दी / हिंदी (Hindi), Italiano, 한국어, Kurdî / کوردی, Malayalam, Dhivehi, Norwegian Bokmål, Polski, Português, Română, русский, سنڌي ( Sindhi ), Soomaaliga, Kiswahili, Svenska, тоҷикӣ / toçikī / تاجیکی‎ ( Tajik ), Tamil, Татарча, ไทย, Türkçe, اردو , ئۇيغۇرچە‎ ( Uyghur ), O'zbek / Ўзбек, Assamese, עִבְרִית‎, 日本語, қазақша, پښتو etc.

bluejetty:00017684:ios.description:
Canara Bank launches “Canara ai1” Mobile Banking Super App with more than 250 features integrated with the futuristic vision of “One Bank, One App”. 
An intuitive app with enhanced User Interface & User Experience, “Canara ai1” Mobile Banking Super App offers a host of customer centric functionalities such as multi-mode funds transfer viz. UPI, RTGS,NEFT & IMPS, Fixed and Recurring Deposit opening, Fastag Recharge, Pay EMI / loans, scheduled payments, Nomination, Integrated Bill Pay, Integrated UPI etc., as additional features.
The app gives unique experience by providing option to customize the dashboard and choose the application theme of user choice (light/dark). App also features SCAN & PAY facility in the pre login screen. 
Canara ai1 Features:
1. Fund Transfer using IMPS, UPI, RTGS & NEFT.
2. Invest in Fixed Deposits & build wealth.
3. Start Recurring Deposits & meet your goals.
4. Add Nominee & care for your loved ones.
5. Pay EMIs/Repay Loans.
6. Schedule payments on your own. 
7. View Balance in a click & download statement.
8. Compare & Shop.
9. Apply for IPO (ASBA).
10. Insurance & Demat .
11. Public Provident Fund (PPF), Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana, Senior Citizen Saving Scheme. 
12. Manage Debit & Credit Cards.
13. Block/Unblock Financial Transaction facility.
14. Bharat Bill Payment.
15. Check Credit Score.
16. UPI 
17. Scan & Pay facility in Pre & Post Login.
18. Hotel, Bus, Train, Cab & Flight Booking.
19. Register & track Complaints.
20. Block Internet Banking Usage.
For feedback and suggestions, email us at hoditmb@canarabank.com https://canarabank.com or call us on 1800 1030
Steps to install:
1. Install Canara ai1 mobile app.
2. After successful installation open app by clicking new Canara ai1 icon.
3. Click on next button to continue after selecting the SIM having Registered Mobile Number with the Bank. SMS will be initiated from the selected SIM; Ensure balance is available to send the SMS successfully.
4. After successful Mobile Number validation, an OTP will be sent to your Registered Mobile Number. 
5. Enter the OTP received and continue.
6. You will be redirected to create and confirm your 5 digits numeric PASSCODE for login to the application.
7. Accept the Terms & Conditions after successfully creating the PASSCODE.
8. Grant the permissions requested during the registration process to access all application features.
9. Before initiating any mobile Banking transactions, you need to create and confirm new 6 digits numeric MPIN for authenticating transactions.
10. Click on ‘SET NOW’ to activate your Mobile Banking facility using active debit card details/activation code (Visit home branch for generating the activation code).
Welcome, you’re all set to explore the new Canara Bank Mobile Banking Super App, Canara ai1.
"Together We Can"

bluejetty:00152514:ios.description:
RepairBuddy turns a broken appliance, a car fault or a leaking pipe into a repair plan you can follow at home.
Describe the problem in your own words, or add a photo or a short video of the item. RepairBuddy works out the most likely cause and writes step-by-step instructions for someone standing in front of the thing that is broken.
WHAT YOU CAN FIX
• Home appliances. A washing machine that will not spin. A fridge that stops cooling. An oven that will not heat.
• Cars and vehicles. A warning light on the dash. Fluid dripping under the car. A noise that started this week.
• Plumbing. A dripping kitchen faucet. A slow drain. A toilet that keeps running.
• Phones, PCs and tablets. A cracked screen. A battery that drains by lunchtime. A device that will not charge.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Start a repair and describe the issue in plain words.
2. Add a photo or a short video of the broken part, so nothing is lost in description.
3. Read the most likely cause, then work through the repair steps in order.
4. Mark the repair as fixed when it is done, or start a new one.
SAFETY FIRST
Every repair opens with the precautions for that specific job. Unplug the appliance. Shut off the water supply. Park on a flat surface and engage the handbrake. Clear the area and wear gloves. You see them before step one, not buried at the bottom.
YOUR REPAIR HISTORY
Every repair you start is saved. Come back a month later and the diagnosis and the steps are still there, so a fix that worked once is a fix you can repeat.
WHO IT IS FOR
People who would rather understand the problem than guess at it. A video shows you someone else's washing machine. A forum thread answers someone else's question. RepairBuddy answers yours, and you decide what you take on and what is worth a call-out.
RepairBuddy gives you guidance, not a guarantee. Stop and call a qualified professional for gas, mains electricity, or any job you are not comfortable doing.
Subscription Details
Some features are available for free, while full access requires a subscription. The subscription renews automatically at the end of the period unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before renewal. Manage or turn off auto-renewal anytime via your App Store account settings. Payment is charged at the time of purchase.

bluejetty:00083305:ios.summary:
EpiPal is designed to detect generalized tonic-clonic (grand mal) seizures, which involve strong rhythmic physical movement. It does not detect focal/partial seizures that occur without significant full-body movement.
Epipal is the Epileps
bluejetty:00083305:ios.description:
EpiPal is designed to detect generalized tonic-clonic (grand mal) seizures, which involve strong rhythmic physical movement. It does not detect focal/partial seizures that occur without significant full-body movement.
Epipal is the Epilepsy Foundation award winning seizure detection and epilepsy management app. Detect Seizures, Get Alerts, and Manage Epilepsy Effectively with an Epipal subscription. Epipal is you and your family's companion for managing epilepsy and living safe with epilepsy safe. Epipal works for you or your money back guaranteed!
SAFETY AND PEACE OF MIND WITH CUSTOMIZABLE SEIZURE DETECTION 
Epipal is the ultimate epilepsy tracker and seizure safety companion. Epipal runs in the background and monitors sensors in your loved one's phone and/or watch and attempts to detect convulsions associated with tonic clonic seizures, and different types of falls. When an emergency situation is suspected, an alarm is triggered, and if not disarmed within a preset time, an alert notification is automatically sent to members of your emergency contacts. Epipal uses a combination of motion related sensors as well as API integration with Apple's Health App to gather heart rate data to monitor for different types of seizures. 
CONFIDENCE WITH SHARED MEDICATION REMINDERS 
Use Epipal to get shared medicine reminders. As a team you and your family can stay on top of your medications and monitor and log if they have been taken. Over time, Epipal will help you understand how effective different medicines are for you. 
MANAGE EPILEPSY WITH A COLLABORATIVE JOURNAL
A shared journal allows you to log seizures and events. Anyone in the Epipal family circle can add events to this shared journal, or add triggers or details to a logged event, making for an easy and collaborative seizure diary process.
CONNECTION WITH EMERGENCY BUTTON
An emergency button is provided so with two simple taps your loved one can send an alert to the entire Epipal family circle. 
We get it, Epilepsy Management is a family effort. With Epipal you can group someone living with epilepsy with their family and close caregivers so together you can manage epilepsy as a team and stay safe, confident and connected! With Epipal you can help Protect and Connect Your Family. Try it out for seven days absolutely free!
Our epilepsy family management specialists are standing by to help answer any questions you may have. Email epipalapp@gmail.com or visit epipalapp.com to get answers and advice from the Epipal team. Feel free to schedule a call with our developers to learn more, ask questions or give suggestions here: https://epipalapp.com/call
Please note that Epipal is not a medical device and we do not give any clinical recommendations or make any diagnoses. We detect abnormal patterns using the sensors in the devices and send alarms, but Epipal should not be used as a substitute for a medical device or clinical treatment. Disclaimer: any users of Epipal should get their health advice from a doctor. To unlock access to the Epipal platform for you and your family purchase of an Epipal subscription is required.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00079053:ios.description:
*Try Loop Hero for free and unlock the full game for the whole adventure!*
The Lich has thrown the world into a timeless loop and plunged its inhabitants into never ending chaos.
In this roguelike RPG, wield an expanding deck of mystical cards to place enemies, buildings, and terrain along each unique expedition loop for the brave hero.
Recover and equip powerful loot for each class of hero for their battles and expand the survivors' camp to reinforce each adventure through the loop.
Unlock new classes, new cards, and devious guardians on your quest to shatter the endless cycle of despair.

- Explore an endless number of paths: bring your hero on randomly generated loops and never experience the same run twice.
- Shape your expeditions into darkness: build your deck and place your cards to script your hero’s trials and tribulations.
- Loot as you loop to rebuild the world: recover your memories as you collect equipment and resources to become stronger, reconstruct your camp and get your reality back.
- Plunge into a gloomy universe: discover a melancholic dark fantasy story told through a retro pixel art direction and recollect the memories of this world.
- Break the cycle: triumph over mighty bosses to free the world from the Lich’s neverending time loop.
CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 15 Optimization (including Pro Max)

bluejetty:00131305:ios.description:
Know more about San Francisco and the Bay Area with the San Francisco Chronicle app. Stay informed with trusted journalism wherever you are. 
- Get San Francisco news alerts and notifications, customized by preferred topics 
- Catch college sports and Giants, 49ers and Warriors coverage 
- Explore food coverage: reviews, local spots, Top 100 Bay Area Restaurants
- Stay on top of Bay Area news, California politics, business, food and development stories
- Page through the e-Edition, a digital replica of the newspaper
- Stay sharp with Puzzmo’s reimagined favorites and brand-new puzzles
- Listen to Chronicle stories with Everlit, a text-to-audio tool 
- Check out exclusive guides and compelling columns and commentary
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS:
Subscribe for unlimited digital access to the app, SFChronicle.com, e-Edition and newsletters. Get 1 month free, then $14.99 per month. Cancel anytime. 
Current digital and print subscribers have unlimited access to the app. 
- Digital subscribers: Sign in to the app to access your benefit. 
- Print subscribers: If you haven’t activated your digital access yet, look for “Activate Access” at the bottom of the app welcome screen. 
PAYMENT: Payment will be charged to your iTunes account with the confirmation of your purchase and will automatically renew each month unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of your monthly period.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
PRIVACY POLICY: https://www.SFChronicle.com/privacy_policy/
TERMS OF SERVICE: https://www.SFChronicle.com/terms_of_use/
FEEDBACK: We want to hear from you! Let us know if you have questions or suggestions: appsupport@sfchronicle.com.

bluejetty:00022037:ios.description:
O Brasil está onde você estiver!
Com o Globoplay, você leva o melhor do entretenimento brasileiro para onde estiver. Assista a novelas, acompanhe canais ao vivo, esportes, jornalismo, realities, conteúdos infantis e produções originais brasileiras.
Aqui, você encontra histórias para se emocionar, se divertir, torcer e se sentir mais perto do Brasil.
NOVELAS PARA MARATONAR E SE APAIXONAR
Relembre grandes sucessos e descubra novas histórias. No Globoplay, as novelas brasileiras estão sempre prontas para fazer parte da sua rotina, com personagens inesquecíveis, romances, dramas e muita emoção.
Além de grandes clássicos, descubra novas produções brasileiras e acompanhe histórias que conquistam o público dentro e fora do Brasil.
CANAIS AO VIVO PARA VOCÊ ACOMPANHAR O BRASIL
Acompanhe conteúdos ao vivo e fique por dentro do que acontece no Brasil.
Assista a conteúdos dos canais TV Globo, GloboNews, SporTV, GNT, Globoplay Novelas, Multishow, Premiere e CBN, com entretenimento, jornalismo, esportes, cultura, música e muito mais.
ESPORTE É NO GLOBOPLAY
Acompanhe o futebol e outros grandes eventos esportivos para viver cada lance, vibrar com cada gol e torcer de onde estiver.
ORIGINAIS BRASILEIROS E HISTÓRIAS QUE SÓ O BRASIL CONTA
Descubra produções originais, séries, documentários e conteúdos exclusivos que mostram a diversidade, a criatividade e as histórias do Brasil.
CONTEÚDOS PARA VOCÊ CONHECER O GLOBOPLAY
Descubra conteúdos selecionados para conhecer o universo do Globoplay, incluindo a degustação de primeiros episódios de séries e novelas, conteúdos infantis, realities e muito mais.
MAIS DE 2.500 TÍTULOS PARA TODOS OS GOSTOS
Encontre séries, filmes, novelas, documentários, realities, programas, conteúdos infantis e produções originais brasileiras para assistir quando quiser.
Seja para matar a saudade de casa, acompanhar suas histórias favoritas, torcer pelo seu time ou descobrir novos conteúdos, o Globoplay é o seu lugar para viver o Brasil de onde você estiver.
Baixe o app e aproveite o melhor do streaming brasileiro.
*A disponibilidade dos conteúdos e programação estão sujeitos aos direitos de exibição em seu território.

bluejetty:00126804:ios.description:
Guiding your child’s behavior is hard at times, you’ve tried, we know, you’ve tried a lot, we get it! So as parents ourselves, we’ve created this application based on the Behaviour Management – Positive Reinforcement Strategy. It attempts to teach your child that good behaviour will be rewarded, and therefore good behavior is most desirable. It also acts as an accountability coach too, because once they get started, they just might be the ones reminding you of the activities they need to do.
The Reward Chart App is designed to help foster positive behavior development. A parent, guardian, supervisor or teacher can list activities, set goals and progressively reinforce favorable behavior by allocating stickers to satisfactory actions that accumulate to a defined reward.
Reward chart has the ability to have multiple children, with multiple charts per child, multiple rewards per chart, and a flexible way of recording behavior. A user can present their tracking via text, emoji, or user captured photo, with the ability to add additional comments to the tracked activity for future reference.
Exclusive to iOS.
Features:
- Like a paper reward chart, but next level 
– mobile, sharable & customisable
- iPhone & iPad
- One place to keep track of all children
- Record multiple charts per child
- Use collection of stickers or create custom photo stickers
- Customise Activities
- Customise Columns
- Customise Color Themes
Watch the "Getting started" video for a quick intro to the basic functions at rewardchart.io/getting-started
Follow us on instagram @rewardchart.io

bluejetty:00068861:ios.description:
Why not record your daily dietary protein intake and aim to improve your muscle strength?
This app is an app that allows you to easily record your protein intake.
Enter the food name and protein amount on the home screen and tap it to record the protein intake for the day.
If you tap the favorite icon, you will be able to enter the protein intake immediately from your favorite from the next time.
The History screen shows the food name and protein amount for the date selected on the calendar. You can modify the data by double-tapping the data. If you forget to record the data, you can add the data by clicking the "Add" button.
The Analysis screen displays weekly, monthly, and annual protein intake graphs. It also shows the average daily protein intake for that period.
On the Settings screen, you can set your daily target protein intake and the first day of the week on your calendar. You can choose to start on Monday or Sunday.
In the free version, you can create up to 10 favorites and check the history for one week. If you want to create unlimited favorites or see all your history, please consider purchasing the premium version in the app.
----------------------
Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: https://akikibai-labolatory.jimdofree.com/privacy-policy/

2. Redeem Rewards: Exchange your Coins for exciting gift cards and exclusive rewards from our shop.
3. Win Big: Accumulate XP to unlock opportunities for prize draws, boosting your chances of earning more while supporting global reforestation initiatives.

bluejetty:00132077:ios.description:
The sound-therapy app studied by university researchers - reset stress and sleep better in 25 minutes. Just press play.
Trusted by 10 million+ listeners, with 200,000+ five-star reviews.
Beginning is built for everyone who can't sit still long enough to meditate. No lessons, no streaks, no discipline required. Put on your headphones, close your eyes, and let immersive 3D sound do the work - deep sleep tonight, a fresh start tomorrow.
WHAT MAKES BEGINNING DIFFERENT
Every audio journey blends binaural beats, calming sound frequencies, and nature sounds captured in real locations with three-dimensional recording technology. The result is sound so vivid and enveloping that racing thoughts quiet down on their own. If you can listen, you can do this.
3D SOUND JOURNEYS - NOW 10 LEVELS DEEP
Progress through ten levels of immersive 25-minute journeys, each one deeper and more personal than the last. NEW: Level 10 has arrived - six of our most advanced journeys yet, crafted for the deepest relaxation we've ever produced.
SLEEP SOUNDS & SOUND THERAPY
Drift off faster with soothing soundscapes made for deep sleep, stress relief, and anxious minds. Binaural beats, ASMR, gentle rain, ocean waves - your perfect night is in here.
BACKGROUND MUSIC
Set the ambience for any moment: focus while working or studying, unwind after a long day, or create a calm space at home with continuous relaxing music and white noise.
CLARITY TEST
How clear is your mind today? Answer a short series of questions and get your personal clarity score - then watch it climb as you listen.
BACKED BY UNIVERSITY RESEARCH
Our sound technology was studied by researchers at Rutgers University School of Nursing, with results published in a peer-reviewed journal (The Journal for Nurse Practitioners, 2023). In the study of 100 healthcare workers, perceived stress was reduced by 75% after 30 days of daily listening - a statistically significant drop from moderate to low stress. New independent sleep research is now underway.
WHAT LISTENERS SAY
"It's so much more than an app. It's a powerful and life-changing experience!"
"I was skeptical at first. But once I started listening, my thoughts stopped racing and the binaural music transported me to another world."
"I look forward to going to sleep every night - 25 minutes of pure bliss."
SUBSCRIPTION, PRICING & TERMS
Beginning is free to try with a 7-day trial, then available as a yearly subscription. After confirmation of purchase, payment is charged to your Apple ID account. Your subscription renews automatically unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. You can manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of use: https://beginning.com/terms-of-use Privacy policy: https://beginning.com/privacy-policy
Tonight, sleep. Tomorrow, begin.

Move to the countryside, and cultivate a new life in this award-winning open-ended farming RPG! With over 50+ hours of gameplay content and new Mobile-specific features, such as auto-save and multiple controls options.
**Winner of the Gold
bluejetty:00064155:ios.description:
Move to the countryside, and cultivate a new life in this award-winning open-ended farming RPG! With over 50+ hours of gameplay content and new Mobile-specific features, such as auto-save and multiple controls options.
**Winner of the Golden Joysticks' Breakthrough Award**
**Nominee of Game of the Year 2017 - BAFTA Games Awards**
---
BUILD THE FARM OF YOUR DREAMS:
■ Turn your overgrown fields into a lively and bountiful farm
■ Raise and breed happy animals, grow a variety of seasonal crops and design your farm, your way
■ Customize your farmer and home! With hundreds of options to choose from
■ Settle down and start a family with 12 potential marriage candidates
■ Become part of the community by taking part in seasonal festivals and villager quests
■ Explore vast, mysterious caves, encountering dangerous monsters and valuable treasure
■ Spend a relaxing afternoon at one of the local fishing spots or go crabbing by the seaside
■ Forage, grow crops and produce artisan goods to cook up as a delicious meal
■ Rebuilt for touch-screen gameplay on iOS with mobile-specific features, such as auto-select to toggle quickly between your farming tools and auto-attack to swiftly take down fiendish monsters in the mines
■ Continue farming from where you last left off with auto-save (even if you close the app!)
■ Play the game your way with multiple controls options, such as touch-screen and virtual joystick
■ Newly Updated Single Player Content - Including new town upgrades, dating events, crops, fishing ponds, hats, clothing, and new pets! Plus more to be discovered...
---
“The best version of Stardew Valley is the one you have with you … This game is absolutely incredible, and will not disappoint.” - TouchArcade
"Stardew Valley beautifully combines farm simulation with RPG elements to create an intriguing, absorbing rural world." - IGN
“Far more than just a farming game... filled with seemingly endless content and heart.” Giant Bomb
"Village life has never been so accessible and satisfying" - The Telegraph
“Stardew Valley has been the most rich and heartwarming experience I’ve had in a game in years.” CG Magazine
---
Note: Features new 1.6 update story content, multiplayer functionality not supported. No in-app purchases.

Watch every shot. Live or on your time
bluejetty:00172529:ios.description:
The official app of LIV Golf. Watch your way
With the LIV Golf app, you can watch every shot live or on demand, follow your favorite players and teams, and experience the season beyond the broadcast.
Watch every shot. Live or on your time
Jump into live play as it happens or go straight to on-demand replays. No waiting for highlight shows. No missing the moments that matter to you.
Follow the players and teams you care about
Track the world’s best golfers as individuals and as part of 13 teams competing all season long. Stay up to date with leaderboards, standings, and evolving rivalries as championships take shape.
A new way to experience golf
LIV Golf combines elite competition with team dynamics, faster formats, and nonstop action. The app puts you in control of how you watch, who you follow, and what you focus on.
Exclusive access beyond the broadcast
Get closer with behind-the-scenes moments, highlights, photos, and updates you won’t find anywhere else — during events and between tournaments.
A truly global season
Follow LIV Golf as it travels across the world, delivering live competition and stories from every stop on the calendar. Whether you’re watching live or catching up later, the league is always within reach.
From first tee shot to final putt, the LIV Golf app is the home of the league — all season long.
LIV Golf Subscription
 • Subscriptions: LIV Golf Season Pass (season access) and Event Pass (single event access).
 • Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase.
 • Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
 • Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
 • You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID Account Settings.
LIV Golf Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.livgolf.com/terms-of-use
LIV Golf Privacy Policy: https://www.livgolf.com/privacy-policy
Long LIV Golf

bluejetty:00028107:ios.name: Witch Arcana: Magic School
bluejetty:00028107:ios.summary:
A portal opens - forbidden darkness spills forth. The magical world of Witch Arcana awakens, needing your power.
Embark on an unforgettable journey full of enchanting characters, choices and stories - not to forget strategy! Adventure game
bluejetty:00028107:ios.description:
A portal opens - forbidden darkness spills forth. The magical world of Witch Arcana awakens, needing your power.
Embark on an unforgettable journey full of enchanting characters, choices and stories - not to forget strategy! Adventure games meets RTS Strategy with just the right amount of witchcraft and wizardry!
Meet exciting characters with unique personalities that match their unique narrative storylines as much as their retro chic outfits! It's sorcery meets style or vintage fashion meets fantasy! Become part of their next chapter by joining forces against your enemies in this visually stunning adventure game. The world of Dwimmer and Wake Hollow is, after all, where Heroes come to survive - we mean play! Definitely play...or maybe slay.
Solve the mystery of the dark rift portals and who is behind their nefarious schemes to engulf the vast world of the Arcane in darkness! 
Start the day with spells or potion class and end with becoming champion of a witch or wizard's war! Did someone say spell royale..?
The Arcane possibilities are endless.
FEATURES of Witch Arcana - Magic School
CHOOSE your House sprung from the great Chimera. Awaken yourself to your House specific powers - unlocking your House's forbidden secrets to your advantage!
DISCOVER an enchanted realtime, open world map filled with magical rift beasts, mythical monsters and dark rift creatures.
RECRUIT witches, wizards, sorcerers, summoners and every form of hero or heroine in the book! Forge immortal friendships and heroic alliances with these characters to learn their unique stories.
COMPLETE perilous Quests to gain mystic realm treasures issued by a powerful yet shadowy headmaster who runs the school with an unknown, mystery agenda.
BUILD up your Campus to be the best arcane kingdom or sorcerers castle in the entire Magic School. Run your enchanted empire to one day rule above all!
RISE to the challenge and through the Leaderboard ranks with dynamic Event schedules! Your strategy game better be as elite as your grades to rise above the competition. We're talking SLG style Events combined with 4x level of gameplay!
MASTER the might and magic of the Arcana! Upgrade your magic card game - SUMMON powerful, mythical rift beasts to aid you in your Quests as you battle enemy classmates, forming rivalries in a vast, worldwide multiplayer PvP arena map.
DUEL other players in intense wand versus wand showdowns or form powerful classmate Clubs and Alliances to upgrade your PvP battle tactics. 
ENTER Tournaments with evolving PVP mechanics such as magical Lethality ensuring this magic wizard MMO will constantly challenge your skills!
BATTLE fantastic beasts inspired by dark forbidden myths then experience challenging RAIDS, clashing with dangerous Fury titans for magical treasure loot!
MEET people from around the world, full of character, to form real relationships! Who knows, maybe LOVE spells aren't needed if you form romances with allies...
Become a student of LEGEND! May they write YOUR immortal name upon the scrolls of Witch Arcana for an eternity!
Join our Discord for support and to share feedback!
Discord - https://discord.gg/pvB7stxJ5M
Instagram - Coming Soon!
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/WitchArcana
Website - https://www.witcharcana.com
For more information:
Terms of Use: https://www.witcharcana.com/tos.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.witcharcana.com/privacy.html

Timed rewards in the fight will help you on your way. Use them to overcome the challenge ahead.

Make and sell crepes out of your own customizable food truck.
Dress up your pixel Shiba Inu, Retrievers, and Beagles in whatever outfits you choose!
How to Play:
Work with your pups to open crepe shops around the globe.
Buy furniture and clothes with your profits and decorate the crepe shop food truck and vacation homes!
Gather Ingredients:
Collect essential crepe ingredients like strawberries, bananas, and eggs.
Promote Your Shop:
Attract customers by handing out flyers to passing animals.
Cooking Mode:
Cook and sell crepes to customers in Cooking Mode.
Hire Helpers:
Employ pups to help around your shop.
Your employees will automatically gather ingredients and deal with customers.
Work together to expand your crepe business!
Furniture:
Buy furniture like benches and tables from a cat-managed store
to decorate your food truck and vacation homes.
Clothing:
Buy clothes on the 2nd floor of the cat's store.
Change clothes and dress up your pups to match each other or the crepe shop.

bluejetty:00187940:ios.name: Candlestick Charting
bluejetty:00187940:ios.summary:
Fundamentals matter, but prices also move as investors’ perceptions of those fundamentals change. Fear and greed influence those perceptions, and candlestick charts provide a visual display of the resulting bullish and bearish sentiment.
C
bluejetty:00187940:ios.description:
Fundamentals matter, but prices also move as investors’ perceptions of those fundamentals change. Fear and greed influence those perceptions, and candlestick charts provide a visual display of the resulting bullish and bearish sentiment.
Candlestick Charting brings Japanese candlestick patterns, technical indicators, stock screening, and signal systems together to help you understand the psychology behind market reversals. Follow your stocks, recognize patterns, and use technicals to study the buying and selling pressure behind them.
READ THE CHART
• Detect more than 70 candlestick patterns and candle shapes.
• Explore stocks, ETFs, commodities, and forex.
• Combine patterns with moving averages, Bollinger Bands, volume, Intraday Intensity, Stochastics, RSI, ADX, Parabolic SAR, and other technical indicators.
• Choose Red/Green or Black/White candles, highlight patterns, and expand charts for a closer look.
• Use chart-header shortcuts for research, notes, and signal history.
FIND AND FOLLOW SETUPS
Screen for bullish and bearish patterns, trends, momentum, and breakouts. Combine named preset choices for price, volume, trend strength, and other independent categories; each choice explains its criteria. Follow stocks and receive signal notifications. Compare named systems, read their rules, and examine their historical trades, statistics, and equity curves.
NEW: EXPERIMENTAL S&P 500 PAPER PORTFOLIO
Not sure where to start? Explore a focused daily plan built around six selected bullish candlestick patterns in the S&P 500 universe.
Four visual lanes show setups Waiting for confirmation, Today’s Buys, Holding, and Today’s Exits. Open a stock block to see its setup, confirmation and guard prices, rank, allocation, trade chart, and protection. Detail screens explain estimated dollar risk at the active stop and potential reward to a specified Bollinger middle-band reference. Paper purchases lock at 3:55 PM Eastern and are labeled PURCHASED when the model records an entry.
Change the model’s start date and starting capital, explore realized results in Performance, browse the Signal Table, and review monthly and yearly profit/loss. Tap a recorded trade to inspect its full setup-to-exit cycle. Open-position gains and losses are shown separately on the Board. The illustrated How It Works guide explains pattern selection, ranking, volatility-based sizing, and exits.
LEARN AS YOU EXPLORE
The native Help guide includes candle diagrams, bullish and bearish pattern catalogs, practical indicator lessons, and further-reading links. Learn why patterns need trend context and confirmation, and how technical indicators can help you evaluate them.
CHOOSE YOUR ACCESS
Free: Limited portfolios, followed symbols, screens, and chart overlays. The S&P portfolio includes holdings, exits, Performance, and How It Works.
Essential/Basic: Expanded access to portfolios, charting, pattern screening, and followed-stock notifications. Includes the Candlesticks signal system in the Systems tab.
Premium: Includes Basic, the other signal systems and custom overlays, plus the experimental S&P portfolio’s Waiting setups, ranked planned buys, allocations, and opt-in portfolio alerts. The S&P portfolio is separate from the Candlesticks signal system included with Basic. Changing the portfolio’s start date or capital turns its alerts off; subscribe again for the new model.
Eligible introductory trials provide Premium access during the trial. Availability and renewal prices are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your App Store subscription settings.

bluejetty:00157954:ios.description:
Interfaith FCU Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with Interfaith FCU Mobile:
• Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
• Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
• Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
• Transfer money between your accounts.
• Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
• Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it.
• View and save your monthly statements.
• Find branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the Interfaith FCU Mobile app, you must be enrolled as an Interfaith FCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00120734:ios.description:
Make vocabulary growth a daily habit with Word of the Day, a vocabulary-building companion created by humans, for humans. With daily words, games, and quizzes all in one app, it’s learning that actually sticks.
Built in collaboration with leading language experts, our vocabulary database intelligently ranks words based on real-world usage patterns. After you take our vocabulary assessment and answer a few questions about your goals, we’ll create a personalized learning plan tailored to your needs, ensuring the words you see are ones you’ll want to use.
With our unique combination of expert curation and smart design, Word of the Day transforms the simple act of growing your vocabulary into a powerful tool for self-improvement. 
WORD INSIGHTS 
- Each daily word is hand-selected by our editors and presented in a rich format with everything you need to understand and remember it.
- Clear examples that show how the word lives in real sentences
- Audio pronunciation so you can use the word with confidence
- Thoughtful illustration to deepen your understanding and boost recall
STOP SAYING COLLECTIONS
Explore our Stop Saying feature to find stronger alternatives to common words and express yourself with greater precision.
DAILY QUIZZES & CHALLENGES
Harness the power of spaced repetition with 1-minute daily quizzes that move new vocabulary into long-term memory. Review saved words and track your progress over time.
WORD GAMES
Expand your vocabulary further with games designed around language and pattern recognition.
- Hangman: reveal the hidden word before you lose all your hearts
- Gaps: guess the hidden 5-letter word in a limited number of tries
- Word Relay: link related words to form a chain. 
CROSSWORDS
Solve themed puzzles across 15+ topics, including Entertainment, Technology, Travel, Idioms, and more.
PERSONALIZED LEARNING
Word of the Day adapts to your learning style and schedule.
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets keep your daily word visible all day
- Custom notifications help you build a consistent learning habit
- Vocabulary quizzes help tailor the experience to your level
- Save favorite words to review anytime
BUILT TO KEEP YOU MOTIVATED
- Small daily habits lead to real progress. 
- Streaks and progress tracking help you stay consistent
- Daily challenges keep learning fresh
- Engaging visuals and interactive features make vocabulary fun
AWARD-WINNING AND TRUSTED 
- Over 7 million downloads worldwide
- Best Mobile App Awards (August 2025) 
- Language expertise featured in Inc.
Whether you’re preparing for exams like the SAT, GRE, IELTS, or TOEFL, working to improve your writing and speaking skills, or simply someone who loves words, Word of the Day helps you build vocabulary in a way that fits into your daily life.
Read more confidently. Write with precision. Speak with clarity.
Educate yourself in a small yet profound way with Word of the Day. Start your daily word habit today.
Visit our website to learn more about the team and the app: https://vocabulous.us/
Please note that Word of the Day is a subscription-based app. 
Some features are available to Premium subscribers only.

bluejetty:00016092:ios.description:
Watch all of your favorite Bravo shows straight from the Bravo app! Stream full episodes and live TV from The Real Housewives, Below Deck, Vanderpump Rules, Project Runway, Million Dollar Listing AND MUCH MORE.
Watch the most recent episodes of your favorite shows or watch live TV with the Bravo app. Catch up with live TV and past seasons anytime, anywhere!
Live stream TV from your phone or tablet and catch up on the latest seasons of your favorite shows. Get started by signing in with your TV provider (cable, satellite or digital). The Bravo app supports most TV providers, including DirecTV, Xfinity, Spectrum, AT&T and Verizon.
Sign up for an NBCUniversal Profile within the app using your Google, Apple ID or email account and receive three credits to watch shows for free before signing in with your TV provider. Live stream your favorite shows and sync them across all your devices to continue watching right where you left off.
Watch now to catch the latest episodes of your favorite shows on the Bravo app today!
BRAVO APP FEATURES:
Watch Bravo Shows
• Stream full episodes of your favorite Bravo shows.
• Watch episodes of The Real Housewives of Potomac and The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City
• Live stream your favorite shows like Below Deck, Watch What Happens Live and so much more!
Stream Episodes Your Way
• Watch episodes of new Bravo shows the day after they air on TV.
• Watch shows by signing in with your TV provider and access the entire catalog of VOD and live content.
• Live stream TV and access schedule 24/7.
• Chromecast and AirPlay compatible! Start episodes in the app and stream to your TV.
• TV on the go! If you can't finish an episode in one sitting, the Bravo app saves your place so you can resume watching later.
• Watch TV and mark shows as your Favorites for quick access to the latest episodes.
NBCUniversal Content
• Watch NBC shows on demand from the NBCUniversal family of networks (including NBC, NBC Sports, Universo and Telemundo).
• Live stream NBCUniversal networks within the app.
• Watch shows and filter by network and genre while browsing.
NBCUniversal Profile
• Create an NBCUniversal Profile to save shows across all your devices.
• Live stream your favorite shows and continue where you left off on any device.
• Watch shows for FREE with three credits when you sign up!
COMMENTS OR QUESTIONS?
Please reach out to iOS@nbcuapps.zendesk.com for assistance.

bluejetty:00072433:ios.description:
The ABV Calculator is a valuable tool designed to help you effortlessly determine the Alcohol By Volume (ABV) of your homemade brews or other alcoholic concoctions. It serves as your go-to solution for gauging the potency of your libations, relying on the Original Gravity (OG) and Final Gravity (FG) readings to establish the alcohol content percentage. You can also measure gravity by Plato.
To utilize this handy tool, simply input the OG and FG values, and the ABV Calculator will swiftly provide you with the ABV percentage. Whether you're a passionate homebrewer or merely curious about the alcohol content of your favorite beverage, our ABV Calculator simplifies the process, allowing you to obtain precise results in terms of Gravity or Plato measurement.
Additionally, you can optimize your calculations by employing the refractometer correction factor for gravity assessments and referring to specific gravity standards for various beer styles.
Moreover, our versatile Conversion Tool is at your disposal, enabling you to effortlessly switch between various units of measurement for liquids and weights. Whether you're working in the kitchen, a laboratory, or any other field requiring precise conversions, our tool has got you covered.
Supported conversions in the Conversion Tool include:
- BBL
- Gallons
- Liters
- Ounces
- Fluid Ounces
- Pounds
- Kilograms
- Grams
For a glimpse of the products we endorse and use, navigate to the "Products We Use" section. You can find books, yeasts, fermentation, legging, mashing storage, and water products.
Should you wish to share your feedback or ideas, simply access the menu and tap on "Send a Suggestion."
It's important to note that our ABV Calculator provides approximate results, and the outcomes generated may not be entirely precise. We hold no liability for any decisions or actions made based on the information provided by this calculator, and we are not responsible for any human or mechanical errors or omissions that may occur as a result.
You may choose to donate any amount between $1.99 and $99.99. Donations are one-time payments processed through your app store account.

Ahoy there sailor! Are you looking for adventure? Well, prepare the sails and raise the anchor, we're sailing out to search for the Golden Pix, the greatest treasure in all the 7 seas!
THE SPOILS AWAIT YOU
The legend of Golden Pix tells of challenges with enchanted stones. When these stones are brought together they cause explosions that will take you to the true treasure. 
HOW TO WIN THE CHALLENGES
It's easy! No cannons. No swords. With Golden Pix you merely need to connect as many stones of the same kind on the board as you can. Simply slide your finger over them. But be careful!
Pay attention to exactly what the challenges ask you to do.
You can only make a limited amount of moves. If you use up all your moves your boat will take on water.
If you lose all your lives, you will need to wait for your boat to be repaired until setting sail again.

bluejetty:00064495:ios.description:
iMobile is ICICI Bank’s official Mobile Banking app that offers 400+ banking services. 
It is accessible to both ICICI Bank & non-ICICI Bank customers for availing Loans, managing Savings Accounts, transferring funds, managing Cards, and investments. iMobile brings the power of Net Banking to your fingertips!
iMobile offers: 
 • Instant Loans such as Personal Loans, Home Loans, Car Loans, and more
 • Online Digital Savings Account
 • Apply for Credit Cards
 • Open Fixed Deposits (FDs), Recurring Deposits (RDs) or iWish Deposits
 • Scan QR Codes for easy UPI Payments
 • Hassle-free utility & electricity bill payments
 • Instant online mobile recharge, DTH service, and FASTag recharge
 • Flight, train, and hotel bookings. 
With iMobile, you can enjoy the following benefits: 
● Pre-approved RuPay Credit Cards:
RuPay Credit Cards provide instant access to RuPay benefits, allowing seamless payments and UPI transactions. 
● Manage multiple Cards:
Through iMobile, you can manage multiple Cards such as Debit Cards, Credit Cards, and Forex Cards. You can also pay Credit Card bills for other banks, by scheduling reminders for due dates. 
● Investments made simple:
iMobile offers a hassle-free solution for investing and stock market trading. You can also invest in various Mutual Fund schemes, without opening a Demat Account.
● iScore & Discover:
Use the 'Discover' feature on iMobile to review your income and expenses. The 'Budget' feature helps you create and manage a budget, allowing you to practice financial discipline. 
● iFinance: All your Bank Accounts in one place:
With iFinance, experience a new and innovative way to view all your Bank Accounts in one place. Review your income and expenses, easily. 
● Unlock rewards & personalised offers:
Earn Reward Points and avail of exclusive offers by conducting transactions or paying utility bills through your Credit Card.
● Customised notifications:
Get updates regarding your bills, Cards, Loans, Bank Accounts and more. 
● SmartLock:
Control access to banking services such as Net Banking, UPI, and Credit and Debit Cards in one swipe. 
● SmartScan 
With the new 'SmartScan' feature, log in to iMobile and directly scan any QR Code within the first 10 seconds, without opening your scanner. 
● Global UPI:
NRI customers can conduct UPI payments with their international mobile number. 
● Chatbot assistance 
Enjoy 24x7 chatbot assistance with iPal.     
Personal Loan highlights:
 • Loan Amount: Minimum: ₹ 50,000 and Maximum (based on the customer’s eligibility).
 • Repayment Tenure: (36 months(Min)) to (based on the customer’s eligibility).
 • Rate of Interest: 10.80% to 16.00%
 • Processing Fee: Can go up to 2% of loan amount.
For example: For a Loan of ₹ 5 lakh, borrowed at an interest rate of 0.89% per month for 60 months, the payable amount would be Rs 10,809 per month. 
Processing Fee: * ₹ 1,770, Other charges: ₹ 0, Interest: ₹ 1,48,539. 
The total amount to be repaid after 5 years will be ₹ 6,48,540. 
Note: Interest rate and Processing Fee vary as per the products.
Other offerings by iMobile : Forex Prepaid Cards, Companion Cards, SIPs, IPO Applications, Tap to Pay, Scan to Pay, Pay to Contact, PPF (Public Provident Fund), NPS (National Pension System), Gold Loan, Sovereign Gold Bonds, Term Life Insurance, Cancer Cover, Health/Travel/Motor Cover, 24-hour Top Up and PayLater.
Pre-approved Loans: Home Loan Balance Transfer, Education Loan, Loan against Property, Commercial Property Loan, Consumer EMI, Home Loan Overdraft, Insta FlexiCash Loan, and Personal Loan on Credit Card.
For any feedback, queries, or concerns regarding iMobile, write to imobileapps@icicibank.com

ICICI Bank Tower, Near Chakli Circle, Old Padra Road, Vadodara 390007, Gujarat, India.

bluejetty:00098434:ios.description:
EarthMiner 3D – Dig, Explore, Build!
Get ready to dig deep and uncover the secrets of the underground world in EarthMiner 3D – the ultimate mining and exploration adventure.
In EarthMiner 3D, you are a fearless miner equipped with powerful tools, advanced machinery, and an unquenchable thirst for discovery. Travel through layers of rock, lava, and hidden biomes as you collect rare gems, valuable ores, and ancient artifacts buried beneath the surface of a vast 3D planet.
Gameplay Highlights:
Mine & Dig Deep:
Use a variety of pickaxes, drills, and explosives to dig through rock, soil, and even ice. The deeper you go, the more treasures you’ll uncover.
Collect Rare Resources:
Discover hidden gems, gold, diamonds, fossils, and mysterious relics. Sell your finds or craft them into powerful tools and upgrades.
Build & Upgrade:
Use your resources to upgrade your mining gear, unlock faster drills, build support structures, and even create your own underground mining base.
Survive Harsh Environments:
Face underground challenges like toxic gas, lava pits, cave-ins, and wild creatures. Stay alert, or risk losing your loot.
Explore Procedural 3D Worlds:
No two mines are the same. Each world is procedurally generated, with unique caves, hidden chambers, underground lakes, and rare zones waiting to be discovered.
Unlock Power Tools & Vehicles:
Access high-tech gear like laser cutters, auto-mining bots, and powerful mining vehicles that help you dig faster and explore further.
Customize Your Miner:
Equip your character with different outfits, helmets, and mining tools. Look the part as you dominate the depths.
Discover Hidden Secrets:
Legend speaks of ancient civilizations buried deep below Earth’s crust. Can you find the lost temple or the mythical core crystal?
Why Play EarthMiner 3D?
Addictive progression system with upgrades and power-ups
Realistic mining mechanics in a fully 3D environment
Challenging yet rewarding gameplay loop
Endless fun for fans of digging, building, and exploring
Beautiful low-poly voxel art style with dynamic lighting and shadows
Start Your Mining Journey Now
Whether you're a casual player looking for a relaxing dig or a hardcore explorer aiming to uncover every hidden chamber, EarthMiner 3D offers a rich, immersive mining experience like no other.
Download EarthMiner 3D and dig your way into history – the treasures of the Earth await.

bluejetty:00039144:ios.description:
Checkers is a classic well-known board game. The rules are simple: white checkers move first, then black checkers, then they move in turns. Checkers are moved diagonally. To eat your opponent's checker, you need to jump over it. And for this there must be an empty cell behind it.
There is a game mode against a smartphone bot, which includes three game difficulty levels. And there is a game mode for two players on one device.
In the game settings, you can choose which color checkers to play as, white or black. There is also a “must hit” setting. If it says “Yes”, it means that the checker must be hit under fire.

bluejetty:00066485:ios.description:
Search "longlobal" on Facebook and follow us to get the latest news and exclusive mount.
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/LONGLOBAL
Discord: https://discord.gg/tlonglobal
In the world of The Legend of Neverland, the fantasy kingdom, Cabala, is waiting for all adventurers to explore! Here’s a warm reminder from our Miru, “Go as far as possible to every corner of the world, you will get unexpected fun!”
The Legend of Neverland is an MMORPG fantasy adventure game in the style of Japanese anime.
In the game, under the protection of the ancestors and flower fairies, you will fight with friends from all over the world, crusading the dark creature together, so as to resolve the crisis of Cabala. Except during battle, this vast and beautiful world is open for you to travel. Enjoy fishing, cooking, and building your own homeland in your leisure time.
※Explore the World and Reveal the Mysteries※
An adventure game of high freedom degree, you can cross this mysterious world,
Explore and discover numerous well-designed quests and surprises,
Every encounter and battle makes you stronger.
※Fight Together with Flower Fairies※
In the journey of adventure, recruit powerful and lovely flower fairies through the Links to assist yourself in battle,
Join this adventure and uncover the mysteries of the world with Marigold, Balloon Flower, Chestnut Rose and many other flower fairies.
※Various Classes, Free Fighting※
Create your own look by customizing the shape and color of your face, hair, eyes and fashion,
You can switch between swordsman, ranger, scholar, craftsman and other classes at any time, and use different weapons to crusade the enemy.
Collaborate with teammates to attack PVE dungeons and defeat powerful bosses
Compete with other adventurers in PVP matches and challenge for the highest honor!
※Rich Life and Joy Creation※
A variety of interesting leisure games for you. No matter you want to go fishing or cook food today,
Or go to the forest to catch insects, you can choose as you like,
While you are taking a rest, you can also get a variety of equipment materials,
Go and level up your life skills!
※Adorable Fantasy Beasts, Multi-Grade Evolution※
Explore the mysterious Fantasy Beast Forest and form bonds with creatures such as Little Flame Dragon, Heavenly Fox, Gem Bunny, and many more.
Throughout your adventure, your Fantasy Beasts will be able to undergo multiple steps of evolution, greatly enhancing their combat power.
Join the time-limited event Fantasy Beast Frontline, challenge powerful enemies and earn generous rewards!
【VIP Auto-Subscription Service Description】
 1. Subscription Service Description: The Legend of Neverland offers a VIP subscription package. By becoming a VIP member, you can enjoy exclusive VIP benefits.
 2. Subscription Period and Price:
 a) Continuous 31-day subscription – $4.99 – Monthly Fashion (Auto-renew)
 3. Payment Method: After the user confirms the purchase and payment, the purchase amount will be charged to the iTunes account.
 4. Auto-Renewal: Unless the subscription is canceled, it will automatically renew 24 hours before the start of each new period, at the price of the continuous 31-day subscription.
 5. Canceling the Subscription: On Apple devices, you can manage your subscriptions or disable auto-renewal by going to Settings → iTunes & App Store → Apple ID → View Apple ID → Subscription Management. Please complete the cancellation at least 24 hours before the end of each billing cycle. No charges will be made within 24 hours prior to expiration.
 6. Service Agreements:
 a) You can visit http://www.arkgames.net/?act=services.privacy to read our Privacy Policy.
 b) You can visit http://www.arkgames.net/?act=services.terms to read our Terms of Service.

bluejetty:00017942:ios.description:
FTChinese is the Financial Times' Chinese language website, providing unrivaled news and information to China's top business executives and decision makers.
The FT’s international team of journalists has access to senior corporate executives and politicians both in China and around the world, making it a must-read for China's business leaders.
Starting from version 3.0, we have a totally new app. 
- Faster: after you successfully launched the app for the first time, later launches only take 0.99 second. 
- Cleaner: the redesigned app supports High Definition perfectly and get rid of all distraction so that you can focus on FT’s world-class journalism. 
- More Features: you can now resize, share, clip, use bilingual mode, switch to night mode, search for articles, check archives by day, watch video and see what’s hot. 
- My FT: you can subscribe content based on topic, industry, area and column.
About the auto-renewable subscriptions
1. Auto-renewal
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. 
2. Price and Service
There are three subscriptions for the FTChinese iOS app: The Standard Anniual Subscription, the Premium Subscription and the Standard Monthly Subscription. The price for the Standard Annual Subscription is $28.99 per year. It unlocks exclusive articles and allows you to listen to English audio for bilingual articles. The price for Premium Subscription is $294.99 per year.It unlocks all the features in Standard Subscription, as well as a weekly magazine called Editor’s Choice. The price for Standard Monthly Subscription is $3.99. It unlocks exclusive articles and allows you to listen to English audio for bilingual articles for a month. 
3. Payment
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable. 
4. Cross Platform
You can use the services on both iPhone and iPad. If you buy on an iPhone, you can tap the “restore my subscription” button on your iPad. And vice versa. 
5. Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
Privacy Policy: http://www.ftchinese.com/m/corp/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: http://www.ftchinese.com/m/corp/service.html
Contact: customer.service@ftchinese.com

bluejetty:00016514:ios.name: Harmony: Relaxing Music Puzzle
bluejetty:00016514:ios.summary:
Features:
Tap and Glow:
Harmony app is very easy to play: take the line as a reference to tap the squares and mirror the music notes. The squares will glow when you tap on them!
Anxiety antidote:
The relaxed melodies created on Harmony
bluejetty:00016514:ios.description:
Features:
Tap and Glow:
Harmony app is very easy to play: take the line as a reference to tap the squares and mirror the music notes. The squares will glow when you tap on them!
Anxiety antidote:
The relaxed melodies created on Harmony are perfect to kill anxiety or OCD problems. In fact, Infinity Games are known for slowing a player's heart rate after 10 levels played. Free of timers and other stress features, this game feels like a yoga session in paradise! 
Different instruments:
There are several instruments available on Harmony. You start with a piano, but you can go for a different melody later if you prefer wind instruments or string instruments. 
Music, Maestro:
Tapping the squares on the right tempo is the only thing you need to create smart music on this calm and minimalist IQ test. Can you play with different instruments?
Just like paradise:
Like a mirror of relaxing sounds, the Harmony app provides you a calm IQ test to feed your soul and tease your brain. You must get the same look on both sides of the line. Just tap the right polygon and the shapes will glow!
Boss levels:
Besides the classical music and the tacit IQ test present, the boss levels featured on the Harmony app will relax your soul! Check how many relaxed melodies can you create during a boss level! Music, Maestro!
Harmony: Relax Melodies is a smart music game reminiscent of a guitar hero, where you must reflect the music notes by tapping the free squares. To be successful, you need to take the white line as a reference and create asymmetry. 
You will finish some levels in a heartbeat. Others will demand more concentration. Each tap will produce a minimalist melody, providing the illusion you are a real maestro!
Like a guitar hero, you will feel like a real musician in paradise when you tap the music notes on the right tempo. The major difference between guitar hero and the Harmony app is the classical music: the relaxing sounds featured in the game are calm and minimalist.
Playing Harmony is very easy: just reflect each polygon and the symmetry will glow. If a polygon is three spaces on the right, you must tap an empty polygon three spaces on the left. Once you reflect every symmetry, the squares will glow, and… it’s done! 
By tapping the music notes on the right tempo, you will be the maestro of relaxing melodies. Merging the brain exercise of an IQ test and the slow heartbeat of a yoga session, we could say you are smartly relaxing.
Just look at it as a mirror: your brain will be pleased for each melody you reflect! 
The chapter names are based on classical music composers – like Sibelius or Vivaldi – and each chapter has its own relaxing sounds palette. Each chapter will bring a different polygon, melody, and symmetry. Your soul will rejoice with the 24 different relax melodies and more than minimalist 1000 levels! Vivaldi built his legacy with the Four Seasons, you can start yours with Harmony!
Feel free to activate your guitar hero mode and tap the music notes as fast as you can! 
Go from mid-tempo to up-tempo! Music, Maestro!
The smart music combined with a calm IQ test will create a paradise environment. Players who suffer from anxiety or OCD problems praise our games. The Harmony app works as a yoga class and will keep you calm, slowing your heartbeat. The relaxing sounds and the guitar hero gameplay will numb your soul and help you deal with anxiety or OCD, while you become a classical music maestro. 
Harmony: Relax Melodies is a smart music odyssey through an abstract and a minimalist paradise, where tapping a polygon and reflecting asymmetry is all you need to do to get rid of anxiety or OCD symptoms.
Terms of Use: https://infinitygames.io/tos/

bluejetty:00196151:android.description:
Now you can collect heroes and upgrade the various knight’s skills to become the most powerful knight captain.
Let’s take a look at the game.
1. Story
In the age of the Great Binge, the Broccoli, Potato and Ginger have all fallen to the enemy empire of Curry and now only the Onion Kingdom is left.
But just as curry cannot be complete without onions, the Curry Empire keeps attacking the Onion Kingdom. To guard their kingdom, their greatest army has been sent into battle - the Onion Knights.
2. Play System
The main game play consists of using a combination of a cannon and skills of three knights and several heroes to defeat the endless hordes of enemies.
Users will be able to enjoy the beginning stages through their simple game play system and their special design. Later in the game, they will enjoy collecting heroes and making them stronger through upgrades.
3. Game Modes
 1) Stage Mode: Try to conquer the 300stages that are divided into easy and hard ones!
 2) Extreme Mode: Encounter your own control limits when more than 600 extreme waves are coming at you! 
4. Make good use of your heroes
Collect hero cards in the stage mode for your own strategy.
You can upgrade them to use special skills and give the game even more depth.
By collecting cards and materials to upgrade your heroes, you can decorate your cabinet with hero figures.
Try to collect heroes in your own cabinet and then upgrade them!
5. Your own playing pattern
You can use your collected heroes in various ways in the game, kick those incoming enemies by combining your own skills with use your own controls for fierce battles without the use of a single item.
Users can enjoy the game in their very own way.
6. You’ve become tired while playing the game?
If you collect the puzzle pieces that you received by clearing a stage, you can complete pretty puzzle pictures.
Sometimes you’ll be able to see part of the daily lives of the knights when you complete a puzzle.
Become part of the Onion Knights and protect the Onion Kingdom together with players from all over the world.

apple-macos:6792892065.name: Reeltone: Music for Jellyfin
apple-macos:6792892065.description:
Reeltone turns your Jellyfin server into a native iPhone and iPad music player — background playback that keeps going when you lock the phone, offline downloads, lock-screen and Control Center controls, AirPlay, and synced lyrics.
Point it at your server, sign in, and your whole library is in your pocket.
WHAT YOU GET
• True background audio — music keeps playing when you leave the app or lock your phone. No more silence when the screen turns off.
• Lock screen & Control Center — play, pause, skip, and scrub without opening the app. Album art on your lock screen.
• Offline downloads — save albums and tracks and play them with no connection, on a plane or underground.
• Synced lyrics — sing along line by line, pulled from your server or fetched automatically from LRCLIB when your server has none.
• AirPlay — send audio to HomePod, Apple TV, or any AirPlay speaker.
• Fast, native browsing — artists, albums, playlists, and search, with a library that loads instantly and works offline.
• A retro cassette-deck look — tape reels that spin as you listen and a waveform you can scrub.
REQUIREMENTS
Reeltone connects to your own Jellyfin server (jellyfin.org) — a free, open-source media server you host yourself. You'll need a server and an account on it. For lyrics, Jellyfin 10.9 or newer is recommended.
Reeltone is an independent client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Jellyfin project.
